* Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
* Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
* Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
* Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.

* Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
* Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
* Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.

* Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - Website Sales & Digital Services
jobs.description:

We are looking for a Business Development Manager with strong experience in selling IT services including website development, app development, software solutions, SEO, and digital marketing services.  
The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in client acquisition, proposal development, corporate sales, cold calling, outreach, and managing the entire sales cycle from lead generation to lead closure.  
This role also requires team leadership capabilities, including mentoring junior BDEs, tracking their performance, and driving collective revenue goals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Lead Generation & Prospecting**
* Generate leads using LinkedIn, Apollo.io, Lusha, Sales Navigator, SalesQL, email outreach, databases, cold calling.
* Identify prospects for website development, app development, software solutions, digital marketing services.
* Maintain a strong B2B pipeline across Indian and global markets (US/UK/Gulf).
* Develop and implement a structured lead-generation strategy for the team to follow.
* Monitor team performance on lead research, outreach quality, and lead qualification.
* **IT Services Sales**
* Conduct discovery calls, requirement discussions, and sales presentations.
* Pitch services and convert prospects into long-term clients.
* Handle IT services sales:
* Website Development
* Mobile Apps
* Software Solutions
* Digital Marketing (SEO, SMM, Ads)

* Guide junior BDEs on service pitching, value selling, objection handling, and client communication.
* **Proposal Creation**
* Prepare professional proposals, quotations, and commercial offers.
* Coordinate with technical teams for pricing & solution details.
* Present proposals to clients and handle objections.
* Review and approve proposals made by junior team members before sharing with clients.

* Convert leads into paying clients.
* Negotiate commercials and final terms.
* Maintain healthy conversion ratios.
* Manage self-generated + marketing-generated leads.
* Own the complete sales funnel from lead generation qualification follow-up closure.

* Set daily/weekly outreach and conversion targets for the team.
* Conduct weekly sales review meetings and performance check-ins.
* Assist team members in negotiations, closure calls, and difficult prospects.
* Build a positive, high-performance sales culture with accountability and ownership.
* Ensure the team maintains CRM hygiene and follows structured sales processes.
* **Target Achievement & Revenue Growth**
* Meet monthly/quarterly revenue targets.
* Handle both self-generated and marketing-generated leads.
* Track KPIs: outreach, conversions, pipeline value, proposal win rate.
* Maintain funnel, forecast, and weekly sales reporting.
* Help the team achieve collective and individual sales targets.
* **Client Relationship Management**
* Build long-term relationships ensuring repeat business.
* Coordinate with project delivery teams to ensure quality and timely execution.
* Manage escalations and ensure high client satisfaction.
* Maintain CRM entries in Zoho/HubSpot/Salesforce.
* **Market Research & Strategy**
* Study industry trends, competitor offerings, and new service opportunities.
* Provide strategic inputs to improve conversions, pricing, and positioning.
* Contribute ideas to improve team performance and sales process automation.\* B2B Sales, IT Services Sales, Digital Agency Sales, Website Sales, App Development Sales, UI/UX Services Sales, Lead Generation, Cold Calling, Inside Sales, SEO Sales, Online Marketing Sales, Proposals, Revenue Growth, Negotiation, Hubspot, Zoho, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, Email Outreach, Pipeline, Closures, White Label Partnerships, Digital Marketing Projects.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelors degree in Business, Marketing, IT, or a related field
* 4-7 years of proven B2B sales experience in an IT services or digital agency environment
* Experience selling website/app development, UI/UX design, digital marketing, SEO, and software solutions
* Hands-on experience with Apollo.io, Hub Spot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms
* Strong working knowledge of CRMs (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce)
* Proven track record of achieving revenue targets consistently
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Ability to work independently and lead a small team
* Strong understanding of technology and digital services.

jobs.title: Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Digital Marketing Intern to join our team. This role will provide hands-on exposure to multiple areas of digital marketing, including SEO, off-page SEO, AI-powered marketing, LLMO, and GEO.

The intern will work closely with the marketing team on live projects and will be expected to actively support day-to-day execution, particularly across SEO and off-page optimization activities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Digital Marketing Intern, you will support the team across multiple digital channels and campaigns, including:

* Assist with digital marketing campaigns across social media, email marketing, SEO, SEM, and PPC
* Support the team with hands-on SEO and off-page SEO activities to improve website authority, organic visibility, and search rankings
* Identify relevant websites, industry platforms, directories, and other opportunities for quality backlink building
* Assist with manual outreach for backlinks, guest posts, link insertions, partnerships, and content promotion opportunities
* Conduct competitor backlink analysis to identify potential link-building opportunities
* Work on business listings, local citations, directory submissions, profile creation, and other relevant off-page SEO activities
* Research and identify opportunities for brand mentions, unlinked mentions, and referral links
* Support digital PR and outreach initiatives aimed at increasing brand visibility and earning high-quality backlinks
* Track backlinks, referring domains, domain authority metrics, and other relevant off-page SEO performance indicators
* Assist the team in reviewing backlink profiles and identifying low-quality, irrelevant, or potentially harmful links
* Maintain trackers and reports for outreach, backlinks, submissions, placements, and SEO activities
* Conduct keyword research, market research, and competitor analysis to support SEO and overall marketing strategies
* Create engaging content for social media platforms, blogs, website pages, outreach campaigns, and other digital channels
* Help manage, update, and optimize the company website, including basic on-page SEO improvements
* Support content optimization activities including meta titles, meta descriptions, internal linking, keyword placement, and content updates
* Monitor basic website and campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms
* Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, SEO updates, tools, algorithms, and best practices

  

**Emergent Technologies and AI Focus**

You will also get exposure to next-generation marketing practices and emerging technologies, including:

* Work on AI-powered marketing initiatives and AI-assisted content workflows
* Support activities related to LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) and AI-first brand discoverability
* Assist in the research and implementation of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies
* Explore how traditional SEO, content authority, backlinks, brand mentions, and digital PR contribute to visibility across AI-powered search and generative platforms
* Research and test tools related to AI, automation, SEO, content intelligence, and emerging marketing technologies
* Help identify opportunities where automation, AI, and smart insights can improve marketing performance and team productivity
* Assist in testing new approaches for improving brand presence across search engines, AI assistants, and generative search experiences

  

**Requirements**

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, proactive, and ready to learn. You should have:

* Studying or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
* Basic understanding of digital marketing concepts
* Basic understanding of SEO, including on-page and off-page SEO
* Interest in gaining hands-on experience with link building, backlink research, outreach, and SEO execution
* Familiarity with major social media platforms
* Basic knowledge of SEO, SEM, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console is preferred
* An interest in AI, automation, emerging technologies, LLMO, and GEO
* Good written and verbal communication skills, particularly for outreach and content-related activities
* Good research and analytical skills
* A creative mindset with strong attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively with the team and manage multiple tasks
* Willingness to learn new tools, techniques, and digital marketing practices

  

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on experience working on real-world digital marketing, SEO, and off-page SEO projects
* Practical exposure to backlink building, outreach, competitor research, SEO tools, and campaign execution
* Opportunity to work on emerging areas such as AI-powered marketing, LLMO, GEO, and marketing automation
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals
* Exposure to different digital marketing channels and technologies
* A collaborative and supportive work environment
* Opportunities to learn through live projects and experimentation

The Senior Manager, IT Delivery leads globally distributed technology teams responsible for delivering and operating business-critical platforms, products, and digital experiences supporting Financial Advisor Services. The role partners with Product, Business, Architecture, Operations, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, and translate strategy into reliable, scalable business outcomes.

This leader is accountable for end-to-end software delivery, engineering excellence, operational resilience, security, talent development, and vendor performance. The role will support the continued evolution of advisor and model-portfolio capabilities while preparing teams to adopt modern cloud, automation, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

As the organization evolves, the role is expected to expand its leadership scope across advisor-facing digital experiences, including modern front-end technologies and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Experience in this area is preferred and strongly recommended.

**Leadership opportunity:** Build high-performing teams, modernize advisor-facing technology, and help shape the next generation of scalable digital and AI-enabled capabilities within FAST.

Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing engineering and technology teams responsible for delivering business-critical platforms, products, and services supporting advisor and investment solutions.

Oversee end-to-end delivery across the software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered with quality, reliability, scalability, accessibility, and strong operational readiness.
Partner with Product, Business, Architecture, User Experience, Operations, Risk, and Technology leaders to shape demand, establish priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver measurable business value.
Establish and monitor delivery, service-health, reliability, security, and engineering-effectiveness measures while driving continuous improvement across teams.
Build and manage globally distributed teams by hiring, coaching, mentoring, and developing technology professionals while fostering accountability, inclusion, innovation, and continuous learning.
Lead platform and digital-experience modernization focused on cloud adoption, APIs, automation, observability, resiliency, simplified architecture, and reusable engineering patterns.
Guide the evolution of modern front-end and content-management capabilities, including future expansion into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), in partnership with architecture, product, design, and engineering leaders.
Drive operational excellence by improving controls, reducing technology risk, strengthening release readiness, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with security, privacy, risk, and governance expectations.
Provide oversight for incident response, production health, root-cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions for business-critical services.
Manage vendor and third-party relationships, ensuring clear accountability, effective capacity planning, quality execution, knowledge transfer, and delivery against contractual commitments.
Identify opportunities to apply Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven capabilities to improve engineering productivity, operations, and business outcomes.
Communicate strategy, delivery progress, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior technology and business leaders.

**Must Have Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
* Progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering teams, software delivery, production operations, and complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience leading globally distributed teams and developing technical talent across multiple roles and experience levels.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, APIs, distributed systems, DevSecOps, observability, resiliency, and secure development practices.
* Experience partnering with product and business leaders to shape technology strategy, manage priorities, and deliver measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, cross-team dependencies, organizational change, and vendor or third-party relationships.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience leading modern front-end and digital-experience technology teams, with exposure to Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
Familiarity with modern web frameworks, content-management platforms, design systems, accessibility standards, and scalable digital-experience architectures. This capability is strongly recommended because the role is expected to expand into the AEM and front-end technology space within FAST.
Experience delivering client- or advisor-facing digital products in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Experience with AWS or comparable cloud platforms, serverless architecture, API-led integration, data platforms, and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience applying AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation within software engineering, operations, or digital product delivery.
Experience leading platform modernization, operating-model evolution, or transformation across multiple products and teams.   

**Location**

This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

  

**Our mission**

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

**Our commitment to you**

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success-at work and in life-with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

**Financial wellness**   
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

  

**Physical wellness**  
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

  

**Personal wellness**   
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

  

**How we work**

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a seasoned **Senior Engineering Lead Analyst** to architect and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise integration ecosystems across microservices, cloud platforms (Openshift/AWS/GCP), APIs, and hybrid database environments (Oracle & NoSQL).

  
  

In this role, you will serve as a technical domain expert bridging architecture, engineering, and data governance—driving API and event-driven data pipelines, privacy-by-design automation (data masking, synthetic data, consent management), and technical build-vs-buy evaluations for enterprise SaaS integrations.

  
  

You will translate complex regulatory and data risk frameworks into actionable engineering deliverables while ensuring adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and architectural standards.

**Responsibilities:**
=====================

  
  

* Collaborate with architects and product managers to build system integration, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and secure.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and Core Engineering teams to design resilient, scalable, and secure API integrations, event-driven pipelines, and data sync workflows.
* Build ecosystems spanning front-end, backend, APIs, microservices, cloud services and platform components.
* Design, develop, and optimize robust database solutions across relational (Oracle PL/SQL, schema design, query optimization) and distributed NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB), creating scalable data access layers, indexing strategies, and automated data synchronization pipelines.
* Engineer RESTful API consumption/creation, data mapping, identity integration (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC), and telemetry/observability.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance on privacy automation within CI/CD pipelines, SDK integrations, and synthetic/masked data generation.
* Participate in technical product discovery through collection, detailed technical build vs buy analysis, review to understand requirements and align these to Data Governance and/or Data Risk and Controls standards to drive appropriate solutions.
* Act as the central Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Privacy by Design, automated data discovery and consent management.
* Translate complex regulatory frameworks, enterprise data governance policies, and data risk taxonomies into actionable technical user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Conduct technical build-vs-buy analyses and architecture evaluations for incoming SaaS platforms, ensuring compatibility with enterprise microservices, cloud infra (OpenShift/AWS/GCP), and hybrid environments.
  

  

**Qualifications:**
===================

  
  

* 6+ years of experience, Banking or Finance industry preferably in Data Engineering or a development area.
* Hands-on background in software development with proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g. Java).
* Proven hands-on expertise with RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, distributed systems, and integration middleware (Kafka, MQ, API Gateways).
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in database development with Oracle and enterprise NoSQL technologies, including designing high-availability, low-latency, and distributed data architectures.
* Strong grasp of cloud native paradigms (Kubernetes/OpenShift, AWS/GCP, Docker) and enterprise security/auth protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML, mTLS).
* In-depth knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns.
* Proven expertise in Excel, PowerPoint, JIRA, Confluence and SharePoint.
* Communicates effectively, develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences; able to drive consensus, and influence relationships at all levels.
* Collaborate effectively by building partnerships and working well with others to meet shared objectives.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance frameworks, metadata management, automated data discovery and classification.
* Optimizes work processes by balancing effective / efficient processes with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Demonstrates ability to balance between seeing the “big picture” while paying close attention to detail.
* **Organizational savvy:** understands systems, management processes, knows where to go for information and how to interpret the data.
* Working knowledge of Data Operating Model practices, Data Governance and Data Compliance & Security laws within large, financial services firms will be a plus.

**Education:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform CCR exposure analysis across a wide variety of asset classes.
* Support trading desks with pre trade live support through hotline or other approved channels on live trading activity providing indicative estimates of PFE and assessing headroom within existing limits.
* Identify, analyse and manage limit excesses across product/counterparty portfolios to understand drivers and find an appropriate resolution by co-ordinating with RSU, Operations, Legal, Front Office, RMG, etc. as required.
* Contribute to the development of model components, execute the tests, discuss results with stakeholders, and present the approach and findings.
* Perform ad-hoc quantitative market or portfolio risk analysis to inform key model methodology choices across IMM, Risk Appetite, Stress Testing, Economic Capital models where required.
* Helping to set up, prepare and deliver periodic internal governance meetings and forums, and their related follow-up.
* Helping update CCR model risk procedures, keeping up to date with Group Model Risk policies and associated standards.
* Provide broader support to CCR colleagues in the context of period reporting, Annual Model Reviews (AMRs) and Validation, model (re)documentation, periodic model monitoring activities, or other governance and control activities.

**Stakeholder Management and Leadership**

* Working with key stakeholders across all the teams, including other parts of the CCR and MR teams, Quantitative Analytics (QA), Credit Risk Technology (IT), Risk Information Services (RIS), Risk Sanctioning Unit (RSU), Model Control Office (MCO), Model Validation (IVU), Model Risk Management (MRM).

* Providing updates to various internal governance committees.

* The role will have daily interactions with various teams in Asia, London and the US. For instance, this role would discuss risk exposures and analysis with a variety of stakeholders in Risk to discuss the counterparty risk profile.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with day-to-day counterparty risk management related activities or counterparty exposure stress testing. Key responsibilities across these activities include assistance in generation, analysis, review, monitoring, controls, and reporting of various Counterparty Risk metrics such as: Potential Future Exposure (PFE), Stressed Expected Loss (SEL), Economic Capital (EC), Risk Weighted Assets (RWA), etc. based on a suite of models spanning, IMM, Risk Appetite, Scenarios/Stress Testing.

  
  

This role will be based out of Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To assess, monitor, and manage the potential for financial loss due to the default of a bank's trading partners

**Accountabilities**

* Monitoring the bank's exposure to each counterparty across different product lines and asset classes.
* Analysis of the financial condition and creditworthiness of the bank's counterparties, including corporations, financial institutions, and sovereign entities.
* Development and implementation of credit scoring models to quantify counterparty risk.
* Conducting stress testing to assess the impact of potential counterparty defaults on the bank's capital and liquidity.
* Negotiation and management of collateral agreements with counterparties to mitigate potential losses in case of default.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.

* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.description:
**VP of Product, Tokenized Deposits**

Full-time

**About DCM**

DCM Corp Limited builds interbank infrastructure for tokenized deposits in emerging markets. Our entry point is the payment itself: ISO 20022-native messaging with tokenized settlement, running alongside banks' existing core systems rather than replacing them. Our technology already runs a national interbank payment network in production. DCM is the exclusive implementation provider of tokenized deposit solutions for the ADI Foundation, the Abu Dhabi-based foundation backed by IHC, bringing these solutions to banks across MENA and sub-Saharan Africa.

**The role**

You will own the product: strategy, roadmap, and the way we implement it with banks. You will build and lead the product function, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for our two products: Side-core, a layer that runs alongside a bank's core, and PMP (Payment Messaging Processing), an ISO 20022-native messaging and settlement platform
* Watch the market and shape where the product goes next: regulation, competing platforms, bank demand, and initiatives like CBDC and interbank ledger projects
* Develop the product line beyond current deployments (new capabilities, new deployment models, new markets) with a clear case for each
* Decide what is standard product and what is customization, and hold that line with clients
* Define our standard implementation approach with banks, from first workshop to pilot to production
* Turn what we learn at each client into product, with one prioritized backlog across all projects
* Work with engineering and partners to deliver, and take responsibility for acceptance

**What you bring**

* Tokenized money shipped to production (tokenized deposits, stablecoins or DLT-based settlement) in a regulated setting
* A product delivered to banks or payment operators as clients: workshops, scoping, pilot, production, security reviews
* Strong command of payments infrastructure and ISO 20022
* A record of growing a product line: finding what the market needs next and shipping it, not only running an existing roadmap
* 12+ years of experience, at least 5 leading products for B2B infrastructure
* Experience owning a product when engineering sits in another organization
* Comfortable acting as solution architect on early client projects
* Fluent English; based in the UAE or willing to travel

**Nice to have**

* MENA or African market experience, Arabic
* Familiarity with interbank ledger initiatives (Swift, regional networks) and EVM chains
* Product experience under SOC 2 or ISO 27001/27017/27018
* Public speaking or published work on tokenization

**What we offer**

* Real ownership of the product of a company bringing tokenized deposits to banks in new markets
* A competitive package for a senior hire
* A seat in decisions about what we build and who we build it for.

The

* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.

* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager located (or ready for relocation) in the UAE to lead the development and growth of our P2P and local transfer products in Tabby Cash. Since our vision is to become a financial service for daily use, we need a passionate, driven individual to make sending money to friends and family a daily habit for millions of Tabby customers.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.

* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.

If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Experienced Permanent ID: 101458

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for the bank’s business banking asset portfolio. The role drives sustainable growth, profitability, customer value, and portfolio quality across lending solutions, including working capital, term finance, trade-related facilities, and secured and unsecured business loans. It leads the end-to-end product lifecycle, using market and customer insights to develop competitive propositions while ensuring effective risk, regulatory, operational, and digital delivery.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Growth**

Define and execute the business banking assets product strategy, roadmap, and annual business plan in line with the bank’s objectives and risk appetite.

Identify market opportunities and customer needs across working capital, term lending, trade-related finance, and secured and unsecured business loans.

Own portfolio KPIs covering origination, utilization, balances, revenue, margin, risk-adjusted returns, customer penetration, and portfolio quality.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

Lead the end-to-end design, approval, launch, enhancement, and rationalization of asset products and propositions.

Develop product features, pricing, eligibility, collateral, tenor, and channel propositions that balance customer value, competitiveness, profitability, and risk.

Maintain product programmes, policies, procedures, customer documentation, and governance approvals.

**Commercial Performance & Distribution**

Partner with relationship management, sales, segments, and channels to build pipelines, improve conversion, and deepen customer relationships.

Develop campaigns, sales tools, training, and performance insights to support disciplined portfolio growth.

Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback and translate insights into product actions.

**Risk, Compliance & Portfolio Quality**

Work with Credit Risk to define credit parameters, underwriting criteria, portfolio limits, and risk-based pricing.

Monitor arrears, delinquency, concentration, early-warning indicators, and emerging risks, and implement corrective actions.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, conduct standards, internal policies, and product-governance frameworks.

**Digital, Process & Customer Experience**

Lead digitization and process-improvement initiatives across origination, fulfilment, servicing, and renewals.

Use customer journeys and operational data to reduce turnaround time, remove friction, and improve service quality.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management**

Lead cross-functional delivery with Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Distribution.

Prepare business cases, requirements, implementation plans, and management updates, ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes.

Manage relevant external partners and vendors and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.

Minimum 8 years of relevant banking experience, including at least 5 years in business banking, SME or commercial lending product management.

Demonstrated experience managing asset products across the full lifecycle, from proposition design and governance through launch and performance optimization.

Strong knowledge of lending structures, pricing, credit assessment, collateral, portfolio risk, and the regulatory environment.

Proven ability to develop business cases and interpret financial, customer, market, and portfolio data.

Strong stakeholder leadership, communication, negotiation, and programme-delivery capabilities.

Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization tools; knowledge of SQL or other analytics tools is an advantage.

Job Description

  

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

**JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION**

To support the Global Treasury, Trade & Tokenization Client Solutions team in originating, structuring and delivering transaction banking solutions for Wholesale Banking Group clients, with primary focus on Real Estate & Hospitality clients. The role will partner with Coverage, Product and control functions to analyze client needs, prepare and execute Cash Management, Liquidity, Trade Finance and digital-channel solutions, and contribute to revenue, CASA, wallet-share and client-experience objectives within First Abu Dhabi Bank’s risk appetite and governance framework.
  
The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Client and opportunity analysis: Analyze client business models, project and operating cash flows, transaction journeys, working-capital cycles, existing bank utilization and competitor positioning to identify Cash, Trade, Liquidity and digital opportunities.
* Sector-focused origination: Support calling plans and account strategies for Real Estate & Hospitality clients, including developers, contractors, property managers, hotel owners and operators, within the assigned Real Estate & Hospitality portfolio.
* Solution development: Work with Coverage and Product teams to design customer-focused solutions across payments, collections, virtual accounts, escrow and project accounts, liquidity and liabilities, host-to-host/API connectivity, cards, core trade, guarantees, open-account trade, Supply Chain Finance and Receivables Finance.
* Client engagement: Prepare client briefs, presentations, proposals, product comparisons, meeting materials and call reports; participate in client meetings, product demonstrations and solution workshops, and maintain disciplined follow-up on agreed actions.
* RFP and proposal management: Coordinate timely, accurate and commercially compelling responses to RFPs, service enquiries and pricing requests, ensuring that solution design, operational readiness, legal terms, economics and implementation requirements are aligned.
* Pipeline and portfolio discipline: Maintain opportunity pipelines, client activity records and management information; track mandates, revenue, CASA, facility utilization, digital penetration, implementation progress and outstanding actions, escalating gaps or delays.
* Transaction execution: Coordinate credit, pricing and product approvals, documentation, implementation readiness and hand-offs with Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and other stakeholders.
* Onboarding and service delivery: Support account opening, KYC and due-diligence requirements, documentation follow-up, implementation and resolution of client issues to deliver a timely and high-quality client experience.
* Commercial outcomes: Contribute to growth in transaction banking revenue, CASA and operating balances, trade utilisation, fee income, digital adoption and overall GTx wallet share, with appropriate attention to risk-adjusted returns and pricing discipline.
* Risk and control: Comply with applicable Credit, Compliance, AML, sanctions, fraud, operational-risk, conduct, data-privacy and information-security requirements; identify and escalate exceptions, control issues and client concerns promptly.
* Market and product insight: Monitor sector developments, competitor activity and client trends; share practical insights and identify opportunities for new products, improved structures and better client journeys.
Process improvement and learning: Build strong technical and sector knowledge, support improvements to workflows and reporting, and complete required learning, coaching and on-the-job development activities.  

**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
* Transaction banking knowledge: Basic understanding of cash management, payments, collections, liquidity management, trade finance and digital banking solutions, with the ability and commitment to develop deeper technical knowledge. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Client orientation: Professional, responsive and service-focused, with the confidence to support client meetings and follow through with reliably on commitments.
* Communication and presentation: Strong written and verbal English, with the ability to prepare concise proposals, presentations and management updates.
* Stakeholder management: Collaborative and able to coordinate effectively across Coverage, Product, Implementation, Operations, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external client stakeholders.
* Execution discipline: Organised, attentive to detail and able to prioritise multiple tasks, maintain accurate records and deliver against deadlines in a controlled environment.
* Digital and systems capability: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM, workflow, digital-banking, pipeline and reporting systems. The role is developmental and is expected to progress greater ownership as technical and client capability develops.
* Curious, accountable, adaptable and commercially minded, with a willingness to learn and operate under pressure while maintaining strong conduct and control standards.
* Must be a strong team player who is eager to learn and has good communication skills.
Must be organized, reliable, and able to work under a manager's guidance.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience: Graduate or early career profile; 0-2 years of relevant experience in banking, transaction banking, client service, sales support, operations or a related area is preferred.
* Arabic capability is advantageous.

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

  

**Life at FAB:**

  

Working at FAB means being part of a team of talented and passionate individuals with a shared vision to support the ambitions of our stakeholders to "Grow Stronger." We embrace the needs of our customers across the globe with a sense of responsibility and confidence driven by extensive expertise that can only be delivered by an ambitious world-class organization

  

**Career Development:**

  

FAB offers unique career choices, a chance to innovate, craft solutions for the future, and express yourself in a performance-based culture that will unleash the best in you. Whether you are an experienced professional or just starting your career, FAB provides a range of learning and development initiatives to support all employees through training and skill development.

  

**Our Values:**

  

At FAB, we place our customers at the core of our activities, live our values each day in every way, celebrate achievements, and empower each other to deliver leading solutions. We have structured plans for the recruitment and career progression of Emirati talent to enable them to make a mark in the financial and banking sector both regionally and globaly that rewards your hard work and dedication.

  

Join our team and be part of a journey to shape the future of banking.

11/25/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Private sector financial development is essential to the promotion of successful and sustainable economies in low- and middle-income countries around the world. Infrastructure plays a key role in sustained economic growth by providing critical public services to the citizens in a country as well as a platform for efficient operation of businesses that create jobs. The private sector plays an increasingly important role in the financing and delivery of infrastructure and public services, including through Corporate Finance Services.

IFC’s transaction advisory services department (CTA) is housed in the World Bank Group’s Client’s and Products Vice Presidency (CCPVP) and consists of two business lines:

* PPP Transaction Advisory (C3P) offers transaction advisory services to governments design, structure PPP transactions in infrastructure to help client governments partner with the private sector to deliver affordable and high-quality infrastructure.
* Corporate Finance Services (CFS) has three key product offerings: (1) M&A Advisory: supporting investment departments in business development and creating investment opportunities; (2) Equity Mobilization Program (EMP): supporting third party equity mobilization alongside IFC investment; (3) Asset monetization involving listed or listing public entities.

CTA has mobilized $6.6B for FY25 which translates into around 17% of IFC’s total core mobilization, of which CFS mobilized over $1.5B of this amount. The department is expected to continue playing a leading role in mobilizing private capital for the WBG.

CFS is seeking a (Senior) Investment Officer with strong M&A experience to help support the execution of our business strategy in the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia Region. The position will be based in Dubai, UAE and will report to the Global Manager, CFS. The (Senior) Investment Officer will support the CFS regional teams with global capacity, with the objective of facilitating business development and executing transactions

**Duties and accountabilities:**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of CFS’s strategy, working closely with regional and World Bank Group teams to advance business priorities and support delivery against WBG strategic objectives, with a particular focus on the MCA region.
* Collaborating with regional leads to originate, structure, and execute EMP and M&A advisory mandates across the MCA region, including buy-side and sell-side transactions, restructuring advisory, and EMP services.
* Lead the origination and execution of strategic pre-IPO advisory mandates across the five regions, working closely with relevant regional, industry, and advisory teams.
* Advise clients on listing readiness, process, timing, and regulatory considerations, including the assessment of corporate and balance sheet structures, valuation and business plans; development of listing roadmaps and timetables; broker selection and prospectus review; preparation of management teams and Boards for listing; and coordination with relevant corporate governance advisory teams, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and industry counterparts, identifying opportunities for collaboration that strengthen business development, enhance transaction delivery, and support IFC’s corporate and regional objectives.
* Develop and manage strong client relationships, working closely with multi-regional clients and relevant IFC teams to develop transaction strategies and provide advice on bankability, funding feasibility, financial modeling, business planning, and restructuring.
* Provide senior-level oversight and guidance on the preparation of key transaction materials and project documentation, including transaction marketing materials, information memoranda, due diligence and transaction structuring reports, and transaction contracts and agreements, ensuring high-quality analytical and transaction outputs.
* Mentor and support junior colleagues, providing guidance on transaction execution, client engagement, and business development, and helping strengthen team capabilities and delivery against business objectives.
* Contribute to strengthening IFC’s positioning and visibility in the CFS space, leveraging IFC’s regional presence, client relationships, and broader communications strategy to support market development and business origination.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or another relevant field, with at least 8 years of relevant professional experience, preferably 12 or more years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance, M&A advisory, or other relevant areas.
* Seasoned in equity transactions, as a principal investor, an advisor, or underwriter, including in an investment bank, VC, PE type institution.
* Transaction advisory experience in buy side mandates, sell side mandates, restructuring mandates, preferably in the disruptive technology space.
* Track record of delivering targeted results on M&A, Restructuring and IPO mandates under stressful timetables and environment.
* Proven success in developing strong client relationships and executing mandates across-borders and in difficult environments.
* Experience taking companies public on major international stock exchanges such as the New York stock exchange, London Stock exchange etc, is plus.
* Strong track record of business delivery, demonstrated investment experience, superior business judgment and established professional credibility.
* Excellent team player and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a dispersed team in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with superior facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills. English is mandatory, and Arabic and/or Russian would be an asset
* Ability to represent IFC externally and to develop and manage relationships with clients, media, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to use commercially available LLM tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot for research, analysis, and drafting in investment, validate outputs against primary sources, and remain accountable for recommendations
* Commitment to development and alignment with the World Bank Group and IFC's mission, strategy, and values.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience work

jobs.title: Technology - Application Development, Full Time Analyst, Bahrain - Seef 2027
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**You are the brain behind our work …**

At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward-thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact on the most global financial institution!

Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…**

We’re committed to teaching you the ropes. The 2-year Analyst Program starts in July and begins with a robust training program. Here at Citi, rotational programs are intended to help you build a broad skillset and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to more than one team. Our rotational program will help you discover the best fit for your skills and long-term career goals at Citi.

**Your time here will look like this...**

You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.

  
  

While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:

* **Back-End Development:** Java, Python, Spring Framework
* **Front-End Development:** Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
* **Generative AI & AI Agents****:** GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
* **Data Analytics:** Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
  

  

No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:

* **Global Exposure**: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.

* **Continuous Learning:** Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.

* **Real Impact**: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.

**To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:**

* Graduation between Dec 2026 and July 2027.

* Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.

* A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.

* Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.

* Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.

* Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.

* Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.

* Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Bahrain without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.

**Who we think will be a great fit...**

A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.

This program is ideal for those who:

* Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.

* Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-

jobs.title: Head Of Product
jobs.description:
PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 700 million registered users and 50 million registered merchants. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. PhonePe is one of the leading payments providers for merchants in India. PhonePe provides digital payments for offline merchants as well as online merchants.
  
  
**Job Description**
PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Head of Product at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our payment solutions products for international merchants. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  

* Define a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
* Identify and deliver multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently make correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shift business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
* Design pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shape cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevent bottlenecks before they form.
* Build a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establish pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
* Design and evolve the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 15+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Senior Accountant to join our Finance team. The Senior Accountant will manage end-to-end accounting operations, statutory compliance, project-wise Profitability reporting, and management information systems (MIS). The role requires strong ownership of monthly financial closing, project P&L analysis, dashboards, and automated reporting using Power BI and AI-enabled tools.

  

**Primary Roles & Responsibilities:**

A. Accounting and Financial Operations

* Manage the general ledger, journal entries, accruals, provisions, depreciation, fixed assets, and intercompany accounting.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor reconciliations, customer reconciliations, and bank reconciliation statements.
* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Prepare accurate financial statements, including Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and supporting schedules.
* Review ledger balances, investigate exceptions, and ensure proper accounting classification.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, and variance analysis.

  

B. Project-wise P&L Management

* Maintain project-wise cost centres and ensure accurate allocation of direct and indirect expenses.
* Prepare and monitor project-wise P&L, revenue recognition, gross margin, budget-versus-actual analysis, and profitability reports.
* Track project costs, unbilled revenue, advances, receivables, payables, and work-in-progress where applicable.
* Work closely with project managers and business teams to validate costs, revenue, project budgets, and forecast margins.
* Identify cost overruns, revenue leakages, margin risks, and recommend corrective actions.

  

C. Statutory Compliance

* Ensure timely and accurate compliance with GST, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns, input tax credit reconciliation, e-invoicing, and e-way bill requirements.
* Manage TDS/TCS calculation, deduction, payment, quarterly returns, Form 16/16A, and reconciliation with the income-tax portal.
* Coordinate compliance relating to Professional Tax, PF, ESI, Labour Welfare Fund, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Support income-tax assessments, notices, GST audits, and regulatory queries in coordination with tax consultants.
* Maintain statutory registers, compliance calendars, challans, returns, and supporting documentation.
* Liaise with internal auditors, statutory auditors, tax auditors, banks, and external consultants. Senior-accountant roles in India commonly include GST/TDS filings, audit support, reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.

  

D. Reporting, MIS, and Dashboards

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports for management.
* Develop dashboards for revenue, project profitability, budget versus actuals, cash flow, receivables ageing, payables ageing, collections, and expense trends.
* Build interactive Power BI reports using accounting, ERP, CRM, payroll, and project-management data.
* Create data models, refresh schedules, report templates, and validation controls to ensure dashboard accuracy.
* Use advanced Excel tools such as Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, formulas, and charts for analysis and reporting.
* Present key financial insights, trends, variances, and risks clearly to senior management. Management dashboards often focus on receivables, revenue analysis, ageing, DSO, and variance reporting.

  

E. AI and Process Automation

* Use AI-enabled reporting tools responsibly to accelerate data cleaning, report drafting, variance analysis, and management commentary.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine reconciliations, report generation, invoice processing, and compliance trackers.
* Ensure that all AI-generated outputs are reviewed, reconciled to source records, and handled in line with company data-security and confidentiality requirements.
* Partner with IT, ERP, and business teams to improve data quality and reporting workflows.

  

F. Controls and Audit

* Strengthen internal controls across accounting, payments, approvals, revenue recognition, and expense booking.
* Maintain complete supporting documents and audit trails for financial transactions.
* Assist with statutory audit, internal audit, tax audit, and management audit requirements.
* Recommend process improvements to reduce errors, improve turnaround time, and enhance compliance.

  

**Qualifications & Skills:**

• Bachelors degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification is preferred.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in accounting, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and MIS.

• Strong practical knowledge of Indian statutory requirements: GST, TDS/TCS, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Companies Act requirements, and income-tax compliance.

• Experience with ERP/accounting systems such as Odoo, Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho Books, or similar.

• Strong Power BI capability, including dashboards, data modelling, Power Query, DAX, and scheduled refreshes.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and strong analytical skills.

• Experience with project accounting, cost-centre accounting, budget control, and project-wise P&L analysis.

• High attention to detail, ownership, confidentiality, and ability to meet statutory deadlines.
