jobs.description:
**Company:** Gokaldas Exports Limited  
**Department:** Commercial / Supply Chain  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 812 Years  
**Designation:** Manager – Imports

About Gokaldas Exports

Gokaldas Exports Limited is one of India's leading apparel manufacturers and exporters, with a legacy spanning over four decades. The company operates multiple manufacturing facilities and has a strong global presence, serving leading international fashion and retail brands.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Manager – Imports to manage and oversee end-to-end import operations, ensuring timely procurement, shipment coordination, customs clearance, regulatory compliance and cost optimisation.

The role requires strong expertise in import documentation, customs procedures, EXIM regulations, import banking and logistics management. The incumbent will work closely with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, banks and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless import operations and uninterrupted material availability for business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Import Operations & Shipment Management

* Manage end-to-end import operations, from purchase order confirmation and shipment planning to customs clearance and final delivery.
* Coordinate with overseas suppliers to ensure timely shipment dispatch and adherence to agreed delivery schedules.
* Monitor import shipments and ensure timely clearance and delivery to the respective manufacturing locations.
* Manage imports of fabrics, raw materials, trims, accessories, machinery and other business-related materials, as applicable.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping lines, customs brokers and transport agencies.

2. Customs Clearance & EXIM Documentation

* Oversee import documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, Bills of Lading, Airway Bills and Certificates of Origin.
* Ensure accurate HS/ITC-HS classification and applicable customs duty assessment.
* Manage customs clearance activities, including Bill of Entry filing and assessment.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Customs Act, DGFT regulations, import policies and other statutory requirements.
* Identify applicable duty exemptions, concessions and schemes to optimise import costs.

3. Import Finance & Banking Operations

* Coordinate with banks for import-related transactions, documentation and payment settlements.
* Manage import Letters of Credit (LC), advance remittances and Documents Against Payment (DP) / Documents Against Acceptance (DA) transactions.
* Coordinate foreign currency payments and ensure timely settlement of overseas supplier invoices.
* Monitor and ensure timely closure of import transactions under the Import Data Processing and Monitoring System (IDPMS).
* Work closely with Finance and Treasury teams on import payments, bank documentation and reconciliation.

4. Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure adherence to applicable Customs, DGFT, RBI and other regulatory guidelines governing imports.
* Maintain accurate import records, statutory documents and transaction details for audit purposes.
* Monitor changes in import regulations and ensure timely implementation of compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors for import-related audits.
* Identify operational and regulatory risks and implement appropriate controls.

5. Cost Optimisation & Vendor Management

* Monitor freight costs, customs duties, clearance charges, insurance and other import-related expenses.
* Identify opportunities to optimise logistics and import costs.
* Manage and evaluate the performance of freight forwarders, customs brokers and logistics partners.
* Negotiate service agreements and commercial terms with logistics service providers.
* Monitor and minimise demurrage, detention and other avoidable shipment-related costs.

6. MIS & Stakeholder Management

* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering shipment status, import costs, clearance timelines and pending documentation.
* Track import lead times and ensure adherence to business and production requirements.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial and Manufacturing teams.
* Provide regular updates on shipment delays, clearance issues and potential supply chain disruptions.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of end-to-end import operations and EXIM procedures.
* Hands-on experience in customs clearance and import documentation.
* Good understanding of Customs Act, DGFT regulations and RBI guidelines applicable to import transactions.
* Knowledge of HS/ITC-HS classification, customs duty assessment and applicable exemption schemes.
* Practical exposure to import LC, advance payments, DP/DA and foreign exchange transactions.
* Knowledge of IDPMS and import transaction closure.
* Experience in managing overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers and banking partners.
* Strong negotiation, vendor management and cost optimisation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Supply Chain Management or International Business.
* MBA in Supply Chain Management / International Business will be an added advantage.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in Import Operations, EXIM, International Trade or Commercial Operations.
* Experience in apparel, textile, garment manufacturing or export-oriented organisations will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely customs clearance and delivery of imported shipments.
* Accuracy of import documentation and regulatory compliance.
* Reduction in freight, customs and other import-related costs.
* Minimisation of demurrage and detention charges.
* Timely closure of IDPMS entries.
* Improvement in import shipment turnaround time.
* Effective management of logistics partners and service providers.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
**Role:Account Executive Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services**

**Location:** Bengaluru, India

**Work Model:** Hybrid

**Experience: 5+years**

If you've been selling into carriers, hospitals, banks or wealth managers and hitting your number for someone else, come own the territory here.

**About Engineersmind**

Engineersmind builds AI-powered products and delivers digital engineering for regulated industries. We are a team of 150+ engineers, product and delivery people across Jersey City, Dublin, Dubai, Noida and Bengaluru. We are profitable and growing without outside capital.

**Our Products**

Our five products are built for the buyers you already know:

* **CXHealth:** A remote patient monitoring and care-coordination platform in production with health systems and payers, and our most-referenced deployment.
* **InsuredDesk:** AI-powered policyholder engagement and agency automation for US independent insurance agencies, built TCPA-first and integrated with the agency management systems agencies already run.
* **Fylix:** An enterprise wealth management and advisory platform for RIAs, broker-dealers and private banks. It includes an advisor workspace, client portal, portfolio and account aggregation with custodian integrations, and embedded analytics, with role-based access for advisors, assistants, clients and leadership.
* **XCSM:** A client engagement and governance platform for wealth managers and banks, designed around the AI-governance guidance regulators are now issuing to licensed financial institutions.
* **PollenX:** Our private AI layer: models, guardrails and audit trails deployed inside a client's own cloud or data center, for institutions that will not send data to public models.

**Our Engagements**

Around the products, we deliver fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements:

* AI Readiness & Governance Review (3 weeks)
* Six-Week AI Pilot
* Compliance-Readiness Sprint against a named regulation
* Data Foundations Assessment
* Private AI Landing Zone

These are the doors. Multi-year platform work is what is behind them. Our marketing is already producing the signal: senior buyers engaging with our campaigns, attending our webinars and visiting our site. What we need is a closer who turns that signal into meetings, and meetings into contracts.

**The Role**

You'll work a defined book of named Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across the target markets.

**Target industries include:**

* Carriers and MGAs
* Health systems and health plans
* Regional and mid-market banks
* RIAs and wealth managers

**What you'll own:**

* A six-month ramp, with a stepped quota and a non-recoverable draw
* An annual quota based on first-year contract value
* Intent data and account engagement signals to identify potential opportunities
* Entry engagements designed to expand into larger platform deals
* Enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders

**What You'll Do**

* Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, run discovery, build the business case, negotiate, close. No handoffs.
* Lead with a packaged offer. Every first conversation opens with one of our fixed-scope engagements, so the buyer gets a short, priced, low-risk yes. You expand from there.
* Get in front of the people who own the problem. Heads of Claims and Underwriting at insurers. CIOs, CMIOs and VPs of Revenue Cycle at health systems. Heads of Digital Transformation at banks. COOs, Chief Compliance Officers and Heads of Advisory at wealth firms.
* Be first on the trigger. New executives, funding rounds, regulatory deadlines, enforcement actions, revealing job posts. Marketing surfaces them; you are in the inbox within 48 hours with something specific to say.
* Multi-thread every account using Sales Navigator, webinars and executive content, so you never depend on a single champion.
* Mine your network. Five named introduction asks a week into customers, partners and former colleagues. Referrals convert at several times the rate of anything cold, and we protect the time for them.
* Run a disciplined pipeline in HubSpot. Every lead accepted or rejected with a reason, every touch logged, every opportunity with a dated next step. If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.
* Partner with Marketing weekly to sharpen campaigns, case studies and targeting based on what you hear in the field.
* Travel as needed to close, including occasional overnight regional trips.

**Who you are**

* 4+ years closing B2B SaaS or technology-services deals.
* 2+ years selling into at least one of our verticals: insurance, healthcare, banking or wealth management. You don't need all four; deep expertise in one is what matters.
* A consistent record of hitting or exceeding quota on high-value deals, and at least one seven-figure deal you can walk us through.
* **Experience working with customers and markets in both India and the Middle East.**
* Comfortable selling AI and data products to compliance-conscious buyers. You can talk human-in-the-loop workflows, audit trails, model inventories and regulatory exposure with confidence, and you know when to bring in the product expert.
* Experienced with account-based selling, Sales Navigator and a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred).
* A strong writer and presenter. Your first email to a new CRO gets read because it is about them, not about us.
* Self-directed and hungry. You would rather be measured on outcomes than watched on activity.

**Why here**

You won't be one of 400 reps dialing the same list. You'll be one of a handful of sellers building the go-to-market for five products that are already generating senior-level demand, with a founder-led company behind you that has been shipping production software to regulated clients for years.

The accounts are identified, the content is running, the intent data is live, and a partnerships lead is opening doors with the carriers' and health plans' own technology vendors.

The gap between our pipeline and our revenue is a closer.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Step into the role of Engineering Manager at Barclays, we are more than a Bank, we are force of progress. As an Engineering Manager you will lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
To be successful as an Engineering Manager, you must have experience with:
  
  
  

* Knowledge of ‘Micro-Service’ driven approach to design, build, test and deployment of a major system.
* Experience in Software development consisting of the languages and technologies like Spring, Springboot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, React and Node.js
* Recognising, selecting and applying appropriate Design patterns, frameworks according to business benefit, maintainability and delivery priorities and constrains.
* Writes and review code in adherence to the well-defined acceptance criteria and definition of done.
* Applies product development & engineering best practices.
* Participate in design reviews and provides feedback to the team.
* Creates and Maintains architecture, framework, technical documentation.
* Good knowledge about Test Driven Development (TDD) and/or Behavior Driven Development (BDD) to improve the test coverage and automation of unit and integration test along with the extended testing teams.
* Support best practices and proactively takes measures to empower support teams to resolve issues with agility.
* Clear & concise verbal and written communication skills
* Analytical with a structured approach
* Experience of Cloud technologies.
* Understand DevOps principles and Tools

**Additional Relevant Skills Given Below Are Highly Valued**

* Knowledge of integrating testing into the DevOps pipeline for automated build and deployment using tools like Jenkins, Travis CI and similar tools.
* Support, monitoring and troubleshooting of both production and non-production environments
* Source code repository management and tools like Git, GitHub, Bitbucket and Gitlab.
* Owns and runs with release tasks and collaborates with Release/BA/QA teams to make sure production releases are performed with high levels accuracy.
* Assist L2 Support teams to resolve user queries and production issues

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.

jobs.title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
jobs.description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production app

jobs.description:
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
**Head of Business Technology Intelligence**
.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:
  
  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;
* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and
* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What You Will Do**
As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.
  
  
Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.
  
  
The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.
  
  
The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****Key Responsibilities****
**Enterprise Data Model Ownership:**

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.
* Establish a strategic target-state data architecture aligned to business, technology, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.
* Govern data model design decisions and oversee implementation across programmes and change initiatives.

**Data Management and Governance:**

* Drive adoption of data management best practices across all technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between data strategy, architecture standards, and delivery programmes.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage data-related risks across the technology estate.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure integrity, accuracy, completeness, and traceability of data.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements through effective data governance and management practices.
* Ensure remediation plans are implemented and tracked where control weaknesses are identified.

**What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role**

* Director-level leadership experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in Banking or Financial services
* Proven experience defining and executing an Enterprise Data Strategy, roadmap and target operating model aligned with business, technology, risk and regulatory objectives.
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Management, data architecture and data modelling, including ownership of end-to-end enterprise data models and target-state architecture.
* Extensive experience in data governance, data risk and controls, including data quality, lineage, ownership, audit, regulatory requirements and remediation.
* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

:

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills (using programming or AI tools), tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.
  
  
The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.
  
  

* Ownership of the Product backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.

* Leada culture of innovation, “test and learn” experiments to create platform products that increase customer value. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.

* Work with Data: Data analysis to document business requirements at the right level, draw meaningful insights, and visualize conceptual and logical data models and flows. Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.
* Stay ahead of AI. This space moves fast. We need someone who follows it seriously, brings new ideas back to the team, and actively applies what they're learning to the products we build. If you've been experimenting with new models, new tooling, or new patterns, that's exactly the kind of thinking we want in the room.
* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.
* Communicate like it matters. We're distributed across three continents. Clear, direct, proactive communication isn't a soft skill here. It's how the work gets done.
* Keep safety non-negotiable. We're building AI systems inside a global bank. Security, compliance, and AI safety aren't afterthoughts. You'll build with all of it in mind from the start. Report control gaps with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services use our unique and proprietary data, technology, insights and expertise to deliver solutions that meet the needs of our customers. Services is critical for the sustained, long-term growth of Mastercard.
  
  
Within the Services organization, this role sits within the Business & Markets Insights (BMI) organization. The Business & Market Insights vertical is focused on creating products and solutions that create value for customers through Analytics, Insights, Business Experimentation, and Payment Consulting & Innovation.
  
  
Under BMI, Payment Performance Intelligence Program's Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products to include AI intelligence. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the AI product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management team including data scientists to support development of Gen AI chatbot use cases & agentic services and ensuring product priorities are well-aligned with strategic objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Support the definition and execution of the AI product roadmap for Payment Performance Intelligence, contributing to strategy and investment discussions led by senior product leadership.
* Own delivery of assigned AI product areas end to end, from discovery and requirements through development, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Help identify and validate high-value use cases for GenAI, chatbots, agentic services, predictive insights, and self-service analytics.
* Translate customer needs, market inputs, and business objectives into clear user stories, technical requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Work day to day with Data Science, Engineering, and Platform teams to groom the backlog, unblock dependencies, and maintain sprint velocity.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance partners to ensure products meet regulatory and responsible AI requirements.
* Recommend prioritization based on customer value, commercial impact, technical feasibility, and effort, escalating trade-offs where needed.
* Define and track success metrics for owned features, reporting progress, risks, and adoption to stakeholders.
* Prepare and present roadmap updates, demos, and release communications to internal stakeholders and customer-facing teams.
* Mentor junior product managers and associates, and contribute to improving agile practices and product documentation standards across the team.

**All About You**

* Solid experience in agile product management for analytics, data insights, AI-enabled, or financial services products.
* Working knowledge of GenAI use cases, predictive insights, self-service analytics, and the data foundations required to support them.
* Demonstrated ability to convert customer problems into requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Experience collaborating across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Risk, Legal, Security, and Compliance teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving execution in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience mentoring or guiding peers and junior team members is preferred; formal people management experience is not required.
* Highly organized and analytical, with strong attention to detail in backlog management and delivery tracking.
* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or equivalent experience required; technical background, payments experience, or product certification preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Manager / Engineer - Pooling Substation/Switchyard (Wind Power Plant)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Manager / Engineer PSS** for Operations & Maintenance of **Pooling Substations associated with Wind Power Plants**.

  

The candidate will be responsible for safe and reliable operation, preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance and monitoring of **substation equipment, transformers, switchgear, protection systems and power evacuation systems**.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

1. **Pooling Substation Operations & Maintenance:** Manage complete day-to-day operations and maintenance activities of the Pooling Substation (PSS), ensuring safe, reliable and efficient electrical operations.

  

2. **Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance:** Plan and execute preventive, predictive, corrective and breakdown maintenance of substation electrical equipment to minimize failures and operational downtime.

  

3. **HT/EHV Electrical Equipment Maintenance:** Operate and maintain power transformers, HT/EHV switchgear, circuit breakers, isolators, CTs, PTs/CVTs, lightning arresters and associated substation equipment.

  

4. **33kV Collection & Power Evacuation Systems:** Monitor and maintain 33kV collection networks, HT/EHV switchyards and associated power evacuation systems to ensure reliable energy transmission.

  

5. **Transformer & Switchyard Equipment Inspection:** Conduct routine inspections of power transformers, switchyard equipment, electrical panels, batteries, auxiliary systems and associated electrical installations.

  

6. **Protection, Control & SCADA System Monitoring:** Monitor control and relay panels, protection relays, SCADA systems, DC supply systems, battery banks and battery chargers to ensure operational reliability.

  

7. **Electrical Testing & Maintenance Coordination:** Coordinate protection relay testing, circuit breaker testing, transformer testing, insulation testing and other scheduled electrical maintenance activities.

  

8. **Electrical Fault Diagnosis & Supply Restoration:** Investigate electrical faults, equipment trips and system abnormalities, coordinate troubleshooting and ensure safe and timely restoration of power supply.

  

9. **Shutdown Planning & Electrical Isolation:** Coordinate planned shutdowns, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), equipment isolation, earthing and maintenance clearances with authorized personnel.

  

10. **Substation Performance & Equipment Health Monitoring:** Monitor voltage, current, power factor, transformer loading, equipment condition, energy evacuation and other operational parameters to maintain substation reliability.

  

11. **Maintenance Records & Technical Documentation:** Maintain operational logbooks, preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, breakdown records, inspection checklists, electrical test reports and O&M documentation.

  

12. **Electrical Safety & Statutory Compliance:** Ensure strict compliance with PTW, LOTO, electrical isolation, earthing procedures, EHV safety requirements and applicable statutory regulations.

  

13. **Maintenance Team & Contractor Management:** Supervise Engineers, Technicians and contractor manpower, ensuring effective work allocation, maintenance productivity, technical quality and safe execution.

  

14. **PSS Operations & Performance Reporting:** Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering substation operations, equipment maintenance, tripping incidents, breakdowns, energy evacuation, manpower utilization and overall PSS performance.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

Candidates should have hands-on experience in **Wind/Solar Pooling Substation, Electrical Substation, Switchyard or Power Evacuation O&M**, with strong knowledge of transformers, switchgear, protection systems and HT/EHV electrical equipment.

jobs.title: Business Head – Mortgages (PSS08142)
jobs.description:
**About The Company**
A well-established financial services organization specializing in secured lending solutions, with a focus on sustainable growth, operational excellence and strong governance. The organization is expanding its presence across multiple markets while strengthening its position through innovation and customer-centric financial solutions.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
A senior leadership position within a financial services organization, responsible for driving and scaling its mortgage business across Home Loans, Loan Against Property (LAP), and Affordable Housing Loans. The role oversees business strategy, sales, credit, risk management, operations, collections, compliance and team leadership, while working closely with the organization’s top leadership.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and execute the mortgage business strategy aligned with organizational goals to drive growth and profitability.
* Drive AUM growth, disbursement volumes, and profitability across Home Loans, LAP, and Affordable Housing segments.
* Identify and develop new geographies, builder tie-ups, DSAs, digital channels, and strategic partnerships.
* Build and manage branch-led, DSA, builder, and alternate channel networks to enhance sourcing productivity.
* Monitor sales KPIs including login-to-disbursement ratio, ticket size, yield, and turnaround time (TAT) to ensure high-quality sourcing.
* Own mortgage credit policies, underwriting standards, and approval matrices ensuring robust property due diligence and legal evaluations.
* Monitor portfolio health metrics such as delinquencies, GNPA/NNPA, roll-backs, and early warning signals balancing growth with asset quality.
* Drive operational excellence through seamless loan origination, documentation, disbursement, and post-disbursement processes with a focus on automation and digitization.
* Oversee collections strategy across early, bucket, and recovery stages ensuring compliance with fair practices and regulatory guidelines.
* Ensure adherence to RBI/NHB guidelines, internal policies, and audit standards, coordinating with Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams.
* Build and lead a high-performing leadership team across sales, credit, operations, and collections with clear KRAs and performance metrics.
* Drive training, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives to build organizational capability.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Education: Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* Experience: 18–25+ years in Mortgage, Housing Finance, NBFC, or Banking with proven success in scaling Home Loans and LAP businesses.
* Leadership: Experience managing large, multi-location teams and pan-India operations with direct reporting to senior executives.
* Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of mortgage products, credit underwriting, property due diligence, SARFAESI, collections, and regulatory frameworks.
* Soft Skills: Strong strategic and commercial acumen, excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills, data-driven and customer-focused mindset, with high integrity and compliance orientation.

Why Consider this Opportunity?
  
  

* Lead and shape the end-to-end mortgage business with significant strategic impact on growth and profitability.
* Drive innovation and operational excellence across multiple mortgage product segments and distribution channels.
* Build and mentor a high-caliber leadership team influencing pan-India operations.
* Operate at the intersection of business strategy, risk management, and regulatory compliance in a dynamic market.
* Engage directly with executive leadership, reporting to the MD & CEO, ensuring visibility and influence at the highest level.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

* **Experience:** 2-3 Years
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Department:** Corporate Finance & Accounts

  

**About PiLog Group**

PiLog Group is a global provider of Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality, and Digital Governance solutions with operational entities across India, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia (KSA). We are expanding our Hyderabad finance team and looking for an agile **Accounts Executive** to support multi-entity accounting operations across domestic and international books.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a meticulous **Accounts Executive** with 2-3 years of hands-on experience in journal entries, reconciliations, and multi-platform accounting. You will work directly with **Tally Prime** (India operations) as well as **Zoho Books and QuickBooks** (international/subsidiary entities), requiring strong spoken and written English to coordinate seamlessly with internal teams across **India, UAE, and KSA, alongside vendors and auditors.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Multi-Platform Journal Entries & Bookkeeping:** Record daily financial transactionsincluding sales, purchases, receipts, payments, inter-company entries, accruals, provisions, and adjustment journal entriesacross **Tally Prime, Zoho Books, and QuickBooks**.

  

* **Accounts Payable & Receivable:** Process vendor invoices, manage employee expense claim verifications, generate client billings, track AR/AP aging schedules, and follow up on overdue receivables.

  

* **Bank & Ledger Reconciliations:** Perform daily/weekly Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS), corporate credit card reconciliations, and vendor/customer/inter-company ledger reconciliations.

* **Month-End Closing & Audit Readiness:** Assist in monthly and annual book closing, maintain organized digital voucher trails, and support internal, statutory, and tax audits.

  

* **MIS & Cash Flow Reporting:** Prepare weekly payables/receivables trackers, expense summaries, and variance schedules in MS Excel for finance leadership.

  

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

  

* **Education:** Bachelors degree in commerce (B.Com), Accounting, or Finance (M.Com / MBA Finance / CA-Inter is an advantage).

  

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of proven experience in corporate accounting or a mid-sized CA firm handling end-to-end bookkeeping.

  

* **Accounting Software:** Practical working knowledge of **Tally Prime**, **Zoho Books**, and **QuickBooks**.

  

* **Communication:** **Fluency in spoken and written English is mandatory** for coordinating with international colleagues, vendors, and auditors.

  

* **Technical & Analytical Skills:** Strong command of double-entry accounting,Indian GST & TDS fundamentals, and intermediate MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS).

  

* **Behavioural Traits:** High attention to detail, strict adherence to closing timelines, discretion with confidential financial data, and ownership mindset.

jobs.title: Fixed Income Testing Analyst
jobs.description:
**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Fixed Income Testing Analyst with strong knowledge of fixed income products, investment analytics, and data validation. The role will support testing, analysis, and validation of fixed income data, risk measures, performance calculations, and portfolio analytics within investment management platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience with investigating data discrepancies, and an understanding of fixed income instruments, performance attribution, performance and risk analytics.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Design, execute, and maintain functional, integration, regression, and data-validation test scenarios for fixed income investment management platforms.

Validate fixed income data, portfolio attributes, returns, benchmarks, attribution outputs, risk metrics, and reporting results.

Test and validate bonds, structured products, swaps, and fixed income derivatives, including pricing, cash flows, accrued interest, duration, convexity, yield, spread, and sensitivity measures.

Analyze fixed income risk, attribution, and analytics outputs to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Investigate data discrepancies, calculation issues, and testing exceptions through root cause analysis and defect resolution.

Perform data quality reviews and collaborate with Performance Management, Fund Operations, Technology, and Data teams to resolve issues.

Support user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, production checks, and issue triage activities.

Prepare test plans, test cases, defect reports, execution summaries, and supporting documentation.

Communicate testing progress, risks, findings, and recommendations to business and technology stakeholders.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

35 years of relevant hands-on experience in fixed income analytics, performance measurement, testing, and reporting.

*Business analysis and platform-testing experience within investment management. Experience validating calculation engines, market and reference data, security-level and portfolio-level results, and upstream/downstream interfaces is highly desirable. Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Agile delivery, requirements traceability, UAT, regression testing, reconciliation and defect management is preferred.*

Strong understanding of return calculations, performance attribution, benchmarks, risk measures, and portfolio reporting.

Strong understanding of fixed income products including government bonds, corporate bonds, agency securities, structured products, swaps, futures, options, and other fixed income derivatives.

Experience testing investment-performance or fund-operations applications, data flows, calculations, and reports.

Expertise in one or more leading performance measurement platforms.

Strong analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and expected results.

  

**Preferred Experience**

Fixed Income Attribution

Fixed Income Risk Analytics

Performance Measurement

Investment Analytics

Portfolio Analytics

Data Quality Validation

Reconciliation & Exception Analysis

Investment Management Platforms (Aladdin, FactSet, Eagle, SimCorp, etc.)

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with Aladdin is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong fixed income analytics, attribution, risk, or performance measurement experience on other investment platforms will also be considered.

Familiarity with SQL, data-query tools, test-management tools, and defect-tracking platforms.

Knowledge of fund accounting, portfolio accounting, market data, and investment operations.

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline; relevant investment or testing certifications are advantageous.

jobs.title: Senior Accounts Executive Project Budgets, HR & Purchase Admin
jobs.description:
**Senior Accounts Executive Project Budgets, HR & Purchase Administration**

  

**Location** Hyderabad  
**Employment** Full-time  
**Experience** Preferably 5–8 years  
**Salary** — 40,000–60,000 gross per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability

  

**About the role**

We are hiring a hands-on Senior Accounts Executive to manage project-wise accounts, budgeting, expense control, financial reporting, HR administration and purchase administration for our construction and project-delivery business.

  

The most important responsibility is to create and maintain financial budgets, work closely with site teams to track expenses, and produce accurate weekly and monthly reports showing actual performance against budget, reasons for deviations and corrective actions.

  

You should be capable of maintaining separate accounts and financial visibility across multiple projects while working within a lean team.

  

Construction, contracting, interiors, real estate development or other project-based business experience is strongly preferred.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

**Project budgeting and financial control**

1. Prepare project-wise financial budgets and cash-flow plans using estimates, quantities, rates and schedules supplied by the QS and project team.
2. Budget payroll, site establishment, logistics, administration and other project overheads.
3. Establish project codes, cost centres and expense categories for consistent accounting and reporting.
4. Maintain original budgets, approved revisions and supporting approval records.
5. Work closely with site engineers, storekeepers and project managers to capture expenses, receipts, consumption and outstanding liabilities.
6. Prepare weekly and monthly actual-versus-budget reports, explaining material deviations and identifying corrective actions, responsible persons and deadlines.
7. Track purchase commitments, incurred costs, unpaid bills, advances and cash payments separately.
8. Reconcile the financial records with the QS’s cost-to-complete forecast and highlight potential overruns or funding gaps.
9. Follow up on agreed corrective actions and escalate unresolved issues.

  

**Accounts, cash flow and collections**

1. Maintain accurate project-wise books, ledgers, purchase entries, sales invoices, receipts, payments and journal entries.
2. Track client collections, vendor balances, subcontractor payments, advances, retention and overdue amounts.
3. Prepare rolling cash-flow forecasts and payment-priority reports.
4. Complete bank, vendor, customer and inter-project reconciliations where applicable.
5. Allocate shared expenses between projects using an approved, documented basis.
6. Complete monthly closing and prepare project-wise financial summaries and profitability reports using appropriate accounting policies.

  

**Purchase administration and payment controls**

1. Issue approved purchase orders with the correct project code, scope, value, delivery terms and payment conditions.
2. Follow up on deliveries with vendors and site teams.
3. Match invoices against purchase orders, goods-receipt records and certified work bills, as applicable.
4. Identify duplicate bills, missing documents, quantity/rate discrepancies and unapproved purchases before payment.
5. Prepare payment requests for authorisation and maintain payment records.
6. Maintain vendor records, purchase registers and organised supporting documentation.

  

**Payroll and HR administration**

1. Maintain attendance, leave, employee records, reimbursements and salary advances.
2. Prepare payroll and allocate employee costs to the appropriate projects.
3. Coordinate recruitment administration, interviews, onboarding and exit documentation.
4. Coordinate applicable payroll compliance with external advisers.

  

**Filings, compliance and audit support**

1. Maintain organised project-wise records and entity-wise compliance calendars.
2. Prepare reconciliations and supporting information for applicable GST, TDS and other filings.
3. Coordinate with the external CA and compliance advisers to complete filings, payments, audits and year-end closing.
4. Track filing acknowledgements, unresolved queries and upcoming deadlines.

  

**Candidate requirements**

* B.Com, M.Com or a relevant accounting qualification. CA Intermediate is an advantage.
* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant accounting experience.
* Demonstrated experience in project-wise budgeting, expense monitoring and actual-versus-budget reporting.
* Experience managing accounts for multiple projects or cost centres.
* Construction, interiors, contracting or real estate experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Tally Prime or a comparable accounting system.
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFS and reconciliations.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, payroll and audit documentation.
* Ability to distinguish accounting costs, purchase commitments, advances and cash payments.
* Confidence following up with site staff and vendors for accurate documentation.
* Willingness to visit sites when required.

  

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment, followed by an interview.

  

**How to apply**

Apply through Naukri with your CV, expected monthly gross salary and notice period.

  

Include a brief description of the projects or cost centres you have handled and the budgeting and reporting work you personally performed.

**Assistant Vice President – Settlement Operations**

**Department:** Business Operations
  
**Location:** Mumbai
  
**Employment type:** Full-time, Permanent
  
**Reports to:** Head of Operations / SVP, Business Operations

**About HSBC**

Some careers open more doors than others.

International Wealth and Premier Banking helps deliver HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing customers with borderless banking and wealth management through mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people.

**Role purpose**

The Assistant Vice President – Settlement Operations will manage securities clearing and settlement across cash, Futures & Options and currency segments, where applicable.

The role will oversee securities pay-in and payout, early pay-in, NSDL and CDSL operations, collateral pledging and re-pledging, settlement reconciliations, auction and shortage management, client and stakeholder queries, regulatory reporting, audit support, UAT and process improvement.

The role will ensure accurate and timely settlement within exchange and clearing-corporation deadlines, while maintaining effective controls, operational resilience and compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, clearing-corporation and depository requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Clearing and settlement**

* Manage daily clearing and settlement activities for NSE and BSE cash-market, F&O and currency segments, as applicable.
* Process trades from settlement validation through securities pay-in, payout and final reconciliation.
* Execute normal and early pay-in and payout within prescribed cut-off times.
* Prepare, review and process exchange and clearing obligations.
* Monitor settlement calendars, exchange timelines and operational dependencies.
* Coordinate with exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories and internal teams to complete settlement on time.
* Monitor failed, delayed, rejected and unmatched settlement transactions.
* Maintain settlement trackers, exception logs and management updates.
* Ensure all activities follow approved procedures and regulatory requirements.

**2. Securities pay-in, payout and depository operations**

* Process securities pay-in and payout through NSDL and CDSL.
* Manage securities movement through pool, clearing, beneficiary and client demat accounts.
* Reconcile balances across exchange, clearing, depository, pool and beneficiary accounts.
* Process and confirm normal and early pay-in transactions.
* Support direct payout and other approved delivery models for POA and non-POA clients.
* Process authorised off-market transfer instructions.
* Coordinate with depositories and internal teams on failed, pending or rejected instructions.
* Maintain records of securities movements, approvals and confirmations.
* Support corporate-action processing, including dividends, bonus issues, stock splits and other securities entitlements where applicable.

**3. Shortage and auction management**

* Identify securities shortages arising from trading and settlement.
* Coordinate with branches, clients, sub-brokers and internal teams to resolve shortages within prescribed timelines.
* Prepare provisional auction reports and provide details to relevant teams.
* Manage NSE and BSE auction processes, including auction obligations and auction bills.
* Track auction items through closure and escalate unresolved issues.
* Maintain records of shortages, client communication, auction processing and resolution.
* Analyse recurring shortages and recommend preventive controls.

**4. Collateral and pledge operations**

* Manage client securities pledging, unpledging and re-pledging activities.
* Process authorised instructions through approved channels and systems.
* Manage collateral workflows through CCPledge or an equivalent platform.
* Reconcile pledged securities with depository, client and internal records.
* Support MTF-related securities reconciliation, including comparison of MTF positions with client pledge balances.
* Process early pay-in activities to reduce margin requirements.
* Monitor collateral exceptions, margin mismatches and incomplete instructions.
* Coordinate with Risk, Technology, depositories and clearing teams on collateral matters.
* Maintain pledge instructions, approvals, confirmations and reconciliation evidence.

**5. Reconciliations and controls**

* Oversee daily reconciliations for:
* + Exchange and clearing records
  + Pool and beneficiary demat accounts
  + NSDL and CDSL balances
  + Securities pay-in and payout
  + Client holdings
  + MTF and pledged securities
  + Auction and shortage records
  + Settlement-related operational accounts
* Investigate breaks, identify root causes and complete corrective action within agreed timelines.
* Escalate aged, material or recurring breaks through appropriate governance channels.
* Validate exchange records, depository statements, settlement confirmations and internal reports.
* Ensure all reconciling items are supported by appropriate evidence.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation summaries.
* Maintain maker-checker, access-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Ensure records are complete and available for audit or regulatory inspection.

**6. Reporting and regulatory support**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly settlement MIS.
* Provide accurate data for reporting client securities holdings to NSE, BSE, MCX and other applicable exchanges.
* Prepare reports covering pay-in, payout, shortages, auctions, collateral, reconciliations and exceptions.
* Support exchange, clearing-corporation and depository reporting requirements.
* Provide management with timely information on settlement status, operational risks and open items.
* Maintain reporting evidence, review records and approval trails.
* Update reporting processes when exchange or regulatory requirements change.
* Support preparation of regulatory information and responses within prescribed timelines.

**7. Audit, risk and compliance**

* Support internal, statutory, exchange and regulatory audits.
* Prepare evidence packs containing exchange and clearing reports, depository statements, reconciliations, pay-in and payout records, auction reports, collateral records, SOPs and exception logs.
* Respond to audit and inspection queries within agreed timelines.
* Track observations, action owners, remediation plans and closure dates.
* Identify operational risks, control weaknesses and client-impacting issues.
* Maintain incident logs, root-cause analyses and corrective-action plans.
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEB

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.
