jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING

SALES MANAGER

Corporate Funding & Financial Services Division

JV Financial and Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd.

Career Opportunity for Experienced Financial Professionals

1. Position Details

Particulars| Details

Designation| Sales Manager

Department| Corporate Funding & Financial Services

Work Location| Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh

Annual CTC| ₹9,00,000 (9.00 LPA)

Minimum Experience| 12 Years in Financial Sector

Age Criteria| 35–50 Years

Capacity Assessment| 10 Days

Employment Type| Full-Time

Reporting Authority| Senior Management

2. Job Overview

JV Financial and Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd. invites applications from experienced, dynamic and result-oriented financial professionals for the position of Sales Manager.

The selected candidate will be responsible for corporate client acquisition, business development, financial product sales, relationship management and generating qualified business funding opportunities.

The role requires strong industry knowledge, proven sales capabilities, excellent communication skills and the ability to independently engage with business owners, company directors and senior financial decision-makers.

3. Essential Eligibility Criteria

Professional Experience

Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following sectors:

- Banking and Financial Services

- NBFC and Loan Distribution

- Corporate Funding and Project Finance

- MSME and Business Loan Sales

- Corporate Relationship Management

- Financial Products and Institutional Sales

- Credit, Investment and Business Development

Educational Qualification

Graduate from a recognized university. MBA/PGDM in Finance or Marketing, or relevant professional qualifications, will be preferred.

Professional Competencies

Candidates must demonstrate excellent corporate communication, financial product knowledge, negotiation skills, client acquisition capability, CRM proficiency and a proven record of achieving sales targets.

4. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Business Development and Client Acquisition

Identify prospective corporate clients, startups, MSMEs, entrepreneurs and business organizations requiring financial advisory or funding solutions.

Develop a qualified pipeline of prospective clients through corporate meetings, referrals, professional networking and systematic business outreach.

B. Corporate Funding Sales

Understand clients' financial requirements and coordinate preliminary eligibility assessment, documentation and appropriate funding solutions.

Work closely with authorized banks, NBFCs, financial institutions and internal advisory teams.

C. Sales Target Achievement

Develop monthly sales plans, monitor business opportunities, maintain CRM records and work toward assigned revenue and business development targets.

D. Corporate Relationship Management

Establish professional relationships with business owners, promoters, Directors, CFOs, financial consultants and institutional stakeholders.

E. Team Management

Guide Business Development Executives and authorized DSA/Channel Partners, monitor their activities and support improvements in sales productivity.

F. Management Reporting

Submit daily activity reports, weekly business pipeline updates and monthly performance reviews to senior management.

5. Mandatory 10-Day Capacity Assessment

Shortlisted candidates must be willing to participate in a 10-Day Practical Capacity Assessment before final appointment.

During this assessment, candidates will be required to demonstrate their practical capabilities in the following areas:

1. Financial Expertise: Demonstrate sound knowledge of business loans, corporate funding, financial products and funding procedures.

2. Client Identification: Identify suitable prospective business clients and prepare a structured prospect pipeline.

3. Corporate Communication: Demonstrate the ability to professionally communicate with company Directors, CFOs and business promoters.

4. Business Development: Prepare and execute an approved business development action plan.

5. Client Meetings: Demonstrate the ability to arrange and conduct professional business discussions with genuine prospective clients.

6. Financial Assessment: Understand client funding requirements and prepare preliminary client profiles.

7. Negotiation Skills: Demonstrate effective professional negotiation, relationship management and follow-up.

8. Sales Leadership: Demonstrate the ability to organize sales activities and guide junior business development personnel.

9. Documentation and Reporting: Prepare accurate daily reports and maintain professional client records.

10. Final Business Presentation: Present a realistic 30-day and 90-day business development strategy to company management.

6. Capacity Assessment Evaluation

Evaluation Parameter| Weightage

Financial Industry Knowledge| 20%

Client Identification and Qualification| 20%

Corporate Communication and Meetings| 20%

Business Development Planning| 15%

Negotiation and Relationship Management| 10%

Reporting and Documentation| 10%

Professional Conduct| 5%

Total| 100%

The company may use a proposed qualifying benchmark of 80%, subject to its approved recruitment policy.

The assessment will focus on demonstrated professional competence and genuine business opportunities. Loan disbursement or funding approval will not be guaranteed or treated as solely within the candidate's control.

Assessment remuneration, expenses, working hours and other conditions will be communicated in writing before commencement and will comply with applicable law.

7. Compensation

Annual CTC: ₹9,00,000 (Rupees Nine Lakh Only)

The detailed salary structure, applicable statutory benefits, deductions and employment conditions will be specified in the formal appointment letter.

8. Selection Process

Stage 1: Resume Screening and Eligibility Verification

Stage 2: Professional and Technical Interview

Stage 3: 10-Day Practical Capacity Assessment

Stage 4: Performance Evaluation and Management Interview

Stage 5: Final Selection and Appointment Letter

9. How to Apply

Interested candidates should email their updated CV, including details of their financial-sector experience, previous designations, major achievements and professional expertise.

Email: hr@jvficpl.in

Email Subject: Application for Sales Manager – Varanasi

Company: JV Financial and Investment Consultant Pvt. Ltd.

Registered & Head Office:

JV Bhawan, Nahar Road, Veerbhanpur, Rajatalab, Varanasi – 221311, Uttar Pradesh, India

Website: www.jvficpl.in

Join Our Corporate Funding Business Development Team

Final selection is subject to eligibility verification, satisfactory assessment performance, management approval and applicable employment regulations.

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and

* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What you will do:**

  

As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

  

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

  

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Data Model Ownership:

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.
* Establish a strategic target-state data architecture aligned to business, technology, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.
* Govern data model design decisions and oversee implementation across programmes and change initiatives.

Data Management and Governance:

* Drive adoption of data management best practices across all technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between data strategy, architecture standards, and delivery programmes.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage data-related risks across the technology estate.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure integrity, accuracy, completeness, and traceability of data.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements through effective data governance and management practices.
* Ensure remediation plans are implemented and tracked where control weaknesses are identified.
  

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* Director-level leadership experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in Banking or Financial services
* Proven experience defining and executing an Enterprise Data Strategy, roadmap and target operating model aligned with business, technology, risk and regulatory objectives.
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Management, data architecture and data modelling, including ownership of end-to-end enterprise data models and target-state architecture.
* Extensive experience in data governance, data risk and controls, including data quality, lineage, ownership, audit, regulatory requirements and remediation.
* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

jobs.description:
**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About This Role**

You'll help us build a platform that works for One — the individual, whether that's a business owner, an artist, or a freelancer, not a segment or a balance. We focus on individuals, not numbers. You'll take ownership of our global product ecosystem from zero to one: first the minimal licensable product, then the agentic financial platform we build on top of it. You'll partner directly with the founders on strategic direction, operate with full autonomy, and build shared understanding across the organization.

**You'll Take Ownership Of**

* **Zero-to-One Product Delivery:**
  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for regulated financial products, from initial concept to launch, prioritizing value delivery over premature optimization.
* **Product & People Leadership:**
  Build and lead the product organization — hire, mentor, and grow product talent, and establish a culture of high performance, data literacy, and low ego. This is core to the role, not an adjunct to it.
* **Agentic Banking Architecture:**
  Architect a financial ecosystem built for autonomous agents from the ground up, treating AI as an operating model for the organization rather than a bolt-on feature.
* **Scope Discipline:**
  Maintain control over delivery timelines under pressure. Cut scope deliberately rather than sacrifice quality, keeping focus on the minimal licensable product.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture:**
  Treat regulatory, compliance, and audit obligations as first-class product inputs, turning friction into intuitive product features.
* **Cross-Functional Feasibility:**
  Partner with the CTO to co-own technical feasibility and organizational commitments, separating what the product does from how it's engineered.
* **Context & Alignment:**
  Act as the primary bridge for shared understanding across the company — communicating product vision, customer needs, and strategic rationale through multiple channels.

**About You**

* **Regulated Startup Background:**
  You've built and shipped regulated financial products from zero to one within a fintech, crypto exchange, custodian, or digital banking environment, with proven exposure to compliance frameworks such as VARA, MiCA, EMI, or PI, and to strict licensing processes.
* **Comfort with Shifting Landscapes:**
  You thrive in continuous-delivery setups with agile teams, staying resilient and decisive under regulatory, investor, and shifting deadline pressures.
* **Agentic Framework Literacy:**
  You have practical understanding of agentic capabilities, architectural pitfalls, and the agentic-deterministic bridge, so deterministic safety holds on the money path.
* **Cross-Domain Fluency:**
  You're comfortable across crypto systems, traditional banking, and modern neobank infrastructure, rather than specialized in a single domain.
* **Outcome Ownership:**
  You own outcomes end-to-end rather than running a feature factory. You commit to measurable results and core OKRs, and you value autonomy while building a collaborative, non-siloed organization.
* **Clarity & Conviction:**
  You reduce ambiguity across teams and argue from data with conviction, but disagree and commit when it's time to align the organization.
* **Language Skills:**
  You speak and write English at a professional level, to support clean communication across global offices.

**This Is Not For You If**

* You're looking for a mature product to optimize. We're building from zero — there's no existing user base to A/B-test against.
* You're a product manager from a large bank who needs six committees to change a button. We move fast, fail fast on wrong calls, and decide from data.
* You know crypto well but see banking regulation as an outdated formality. For us, regulation is part of the product architecture, not an obstacle.
* You want to run a feature factory and just execute roadmaps. We need someone who will fight for the right scope, even if that means shipping less.
* You need the founders to make every product call. You'll have real autonomy here — and the responsibility that comes with it, including owning your own mistakes.

**Can Get You a Few Bonus Points**

* **Founder Roots:**
  Prior experience as a founder or early product leader of a regulated fintech startup, building the organization from the ground up.
* **Agentic Shipping History:**
  Direct experience bringing a live, agentic-first product to market.
* **Augmented Operations:**
  Active daily use of AI agents, personal documentation systems, or a "second brain" to streamline your own operational delivery.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Mandate & Ownership:**
  Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* **Equity:**
  A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* **Location & Flexibility:**
  Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

Position reports to : CEO Multipass

**Role Overview**

The Branch CEO / Senior Executive Officer is the accountable executive for MultiPass's DIFC branch and the leader of its next stage of UAE growth. The role combines regulated executive leadership, delivery of a mainland licensing programme, and direct commercial ownership. The successful candidate will protect the branch's regulatory standing, build trusted relationships with regulators and local banking partners, originate revenue personally, and create a high-performing Sales and Business Development organisation.

**The Three Core Mandates**

1.
**Lead the DIFC branch.**
Act as Branch CEO and, subject to regulatory approval, Senior Executive

Officer; own governance, regulatory engagement, compliance, local banking relationships,

operational performance, and the branch's reputation.

2.
**Deliver mainland authorisation.**
Lead the end-to-end programme to identify and obtain the

appropriate UAE mainland electronic-money and/or payment-services licence or authorisation,

working with the relevant federal and mainland authorities and external advisers.

3.
**Grow the revenue base.**
Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Branch Leadership, Regulation and Banking Relationships**

* Serve as the senior accountable executive for the DIFC branch and provide coordination for
* strategy, governance, culture, risk, compliance, operations, and financial performance.
* Maintain a proactive, transparent, and credible relationship with the Dubai Financial Services
* Authority (DFSA), including timely regulatory engagement, notifications, returns, remediation, and responses to supervisory requests.
* Ensure the branch operates within its permissions, policies, risk appetite, and applicable DIFC/DFSA requirements, with particular attention to AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct, safeguarding, prudential oversight, outsourcing, and financial-crime controls.
* Chair or participate in branch governance forums; ensure decisions, delegated authorities, management information, incident escalation, and board or group reporting are clear and effective.
* Own senior relationships with local banks, safeguarding or settlement partners, payment providers, professional advisers, and other critical counterparties; negotiate resilient and commercially sound arrangements.

**2. UAE Mainland Licensing Programme**

* Define the target regulated business model and licensing strategy for mainland UAE, aligned with MultiPass's products, client segments, risk appetite, capital plan, and growth ambitions.
* Lead the feasibility study and business case for the mainland licence.
* Coordinate internal Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Treasury, and People teams, together with external legal and regulatory advisers.
* Oversee preparation of the business plan, governance and ownership materials, financial projections, capital and liquidity plans, policies, control frameworks, technology and outsourcing documentation, and evidence of operational readiness.
* Build constructive relationships with the relevant UAE authorities, including the Central Bank of the UAE where applicable, and ensure all submissions are accurate, consistent, and delivered to the agreed standard and timetable.
* Translate licensing conditions into an executable mobilisation plan and ensure the mainland entity or operation is ready to launch without weakening the DIFC branch's controls or service quality.

**3. Revenue Growth and Commercial Team Build**

* Own the UAE branch revenue plan, client-acquisition strategy, commercial pipeline, and contribution to profitability, with clear monthly and quarterly targets.
* Personally originate, negotiate, and close high-value clients and strategic partnerships, particularly among internationally active businesses requiring multi-currency accounts, cross-border payments, and FX services.
* Develop a strong network across the UAE business, banking, professional-services, investment, and fintech communities and represent MultiPass at relevant market and industry forums.
* Recruit and lead the Sales and Business Development team; define coverage, roles, incentives, targets, account ownership, onboarding standards, and performance-management routines.
* Implement a disciplined commercial operating system covering CRM hygiene, lead qualification, pipeline reviews, conversion, pricing governance, revenue attribution, forecasting, client retention, and cross-sell.
* Work closely with Compliance, Product, Operations, Treasury, and Group leadership to ensure commercial growth remains within risk appetite and that client feedback informs product and service development.

**4. People, Operations and Profitability**

* Build a high-accountability, client-focused branch culture in line with DYNINNO Corporate Values.
* Own the branch operating plan and budget; manage cost, headcount, vendor performance, revenue quality, and progress toward sustainable profitability.
* Ensure the branch has appropriate business-continuity, operational-resilience, information-security, complaints, and incident-management arrangements.
* Provide concise, decision-useful reporting to Group leadership and the Board.

**Requirements**

* Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head or equivalent within regulated payments, electronic money, B2B fintech or transaction banking.
* Strong UAE market knowledge, including practical experience engaging with regulators and understanding DIFC/DFSA requirements and the UAE mainland regulatory environment.
* Experience leading licensing or authorisation programmes, including regulatory submissions, coordination with external advisers and preparation for operational launch. UAE payments or electronic-money licensing experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven personal track record in B2B client acquisition, negotiating and closing high-value corporate clients and strategic partnerships, ideally in cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts or FX.
* An established UAE business and banking network, with the ability to develop relationships with corporate clients, local banks, payment providers and referral partners.
* Experience building and leading Sales and Business Development teams, with clear revenue targets, pipeline management, forecasting and performance accountability.
* Strong governance, risk and compliance expertise, including AML/CFT, sanctions, financial-crime controls and operational resilience.
* P&L and operational leadership experience, covering business planning, budgeting, cost management and sustainable revenue growth.
* Ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, working closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Technology and Operations, and reporting effectively to Group leadership and the Board.

At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.

**Who You'll Be Joining**

We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**

Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners , always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners , treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**  
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**  
As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Executive Stakeholder Management: Report performance metrics, expansion milestones, and revenue updates directly to the ExCo and senior leadership.

Infrastructure, Launch Execution & Risk

* Cross-Functional Delivery: Lead the alignment between Business Development, Launch, Product, and Tech teams to ensure new market rails, APIs, and commercial features are brought to market at pace.
* Operational Scalability: Automate cross-border and operational processes to scale corridor capacity without increasing overhead friction.
* Risk & Regulatory Oversight: Oversee regional commercial and exposure risks, ensuring full compliance with local regulatory standards across all operating entities.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven Business Development Leader: Track record of driving rapid revenue growth, expanding complex markets, and consistently hitting Volume, Revenue, and PnL targets.
* Expansion & Launch Expertise: Demonstrated experience entering new geographies, launching cross-border payment corridors, and building strategic financial or distribution partnerships across APAC.
* Matrix Leadership: Proven ability to manage direct commercial teams while effectively leading indirect, multi-functional partner teams (Product, Marketing, Operations, Pricing, FX) to execute cross-company initiatives.
* APAC Market Mastery: In-depth knowledge of APAC financial markets, payment infrastructure, local regulatory environments, and consumer payment preferences.
* Dealmaking & Negotiation: Exceptional skills in sourcing, structuring, and closing complex, first-in-kind commercial agreements.
* Strategic Drive: An autonomous, highly energetic self-starter with a bias for action and the strategic vision to build a dominant market presence in high-volume corridors.
* Cross-Border & FX Commercial Knowledge: Solid understanding of FX mechanics, cross-border payment rails, and currency spread optimization across APAC corridors.

**AI Literacy & Tools**  
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  

* A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The UAE Services Business Execution & Strategy Analyst / Associate plays a central role in driving the growth, governance, and operational execution of Citi’s Services franchise in the United Arab Emirates.

  
  

This role blends strategic commercial enablement, product P&L analytics, and sales pipeline optimization with proactive oversight of country governance, regulatory affairs, technology enhancement asks, and executive reporting for UAE leadership.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

**A. UAE Services Strategy & Commercial Growth**

**Strategy Execution:** Execute the comprehensive UAE Services strategy established by Country Management to accelerate business momentum across the franchise.

**Franchise Expansion:** Support growth initiatives across revenue, transaction volume, and balance sheet/asset dimensions across all UAE cash management, payments, and trade lines.

  
  

**B. Product P&L, Financial Analytics & Performance Tracking**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**P&L Management & Measurement:** Monitor, analyze, and report on product-level P&L performance, revenue streams, and expense drivers across all UAE Services offerings.

**Variance & Trend Analysis:** Extract and evaluate financial and balance sheet data from Citi internal systems; compare actual performance against plan and prior periods, pinpointing drivers, growth trends, and outliers.

**Financial Forecasting:** Partner with finance and business managers to assist in quarterly forecasting, annual budget formulation, and productivity reviews.

  
  

**C. Country Governance, Regulatory Affairs & Infrastructure**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Governance Engagement:** Assist the UAE Services Head with relevant data in UAE country governance matters, supporting Services representation on various Country Governance Committees.

  
  

**D. Sales Pipeline & Commercial Enablement**
---------------------------------------------

**Pipeline Coordination:** Coordinate a robust sales pipeline by liaising with coverage bankers, solution sales, and product partners across the UAE.

**Performance Metrics:** Track won/lost deals, deal conversion cycles, and client calling intensity to identify growth bottlenecks and support revenue target achievement.

**E. Executive Presentations, Senior Visits & Action Tracking**
---------------------------------------------------------------

**Executive Decks:** Prepare high-impact PowerPoint presentations and briefing documents for Country Governance Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, and business reviews.

**Senior Leadership Visits:** Coordinate, develop, and synthesize briefing packs and strategic overviews for visiting regional and global executive leaders.

**Action Follow-Through:** Rigorously track and coordinate action items stemming from client engagements, country committee reviews, and regulatory meetings to ensure timely resolution.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

  
  

* Minimum of 3+ years of relevant banking experience (preferably in transaction banking, cash management, trade services, or corporate banking)
* Sound understanding of P&L mechanics, balance sheet analysis, statistical analysis, and variance modeling
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation skills with the ability to synthesize complex commercial, regulatory, and financial data into clean, executive-ready decks
* Strong hands-on proficiency in MS Excel (advanced formulas, data modeling) and MS Word; aptitude for quickly learning internal core banking and CRM platforms
* Fluent written and verbal English communication skills; confident in liaising with cross-functional internal stakeholders and senior management
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail; able to work independently, manage multiple time-sensitive deliverables, and drive tasks to completion
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.
  

  

**What We Offer:**

**Direct Country Franchise Exposure:** High-visibility role with direct access to UAE Services leadership and country governance bodies.

**Workplace Flexibility:** Business casual environment with a hybrid work structure (up to 2 days/week working from home).

**Competitive Package:** Annually reviewed base salary alongside a comprehensive suite of health, wellness, and savings benefits for you and your family.

jobs.description:
**Senior Auditor**
==================

Date: Nov 10, 2026

Location:
Abu Dhabi, AE

Company: Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A.

.

**Overview**
------------

You will work as Senior Auditor under the direction of the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit and the Head of IMI-CIB Foreign Network Audit. Either independently or collectively with the MEA Audit team and with HO auditors, you will carry out or lead internal audit engagements covering different areas; you will evaluate internal controls of the audited organizational structure process, document audit test work and communicate audit issues to management. You will adhere to the obligatory IIA Standards, as well as the methodology standards of the ISP Chief Audit Officer. You will be responsible for the preparation of ad hoc and periodic reports, as requested, and you will be the official point of contact for the Internal Audit function with the local Regulators.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

You will have the opportunity to support the following activities:

* Develop comprehensive and detailed audit program, based on the HO Chief Audit Officer methodology framework, to support the execution of audit tests and verifications
* Conduct audit engagements, in line with the instruction from the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit team and from the Head of IMI CIB Foreign Network Audit
* Collaborate with other Head Office Chief Audit Officer specialist functions
* Ensure the preparation of diligently audit products (reports, work papers, etc.)
* Ensure that the audit reports are prepared in a timely manner and that they clearly present the identified weaknesses and formulate effective recommendations for mitigation action
* Ensure the efficient monitoring of the resolution of the identified weaknesses and the implementation of mitigation actions
* Follow the evolution of the business and operational activities and of the credit portfolio of the Branch, as well as the changes in the related internal (local and HO) and external regulations
* Maintain solid working relationships with relevant Branch counterparties and stakeholders
* Manage the relationship with the local Regulators, answer their enquiries in collaboration with the Head of MEA Region Internal Audit and with the Head of IMI CIB Foreign Network Audit
* Perform the annual and continuous risk assessment
* Assist with other ad-hoc tasks and projects as required

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

If you want to turn your passion into a career and you have the following characteristics, we are waiting for you:

* At least 5 years of experience in the role
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or Risk Management
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of credit analysis standards and techniques, non-performing loan management practices, asset classification, provisioning and related accounting treatment
* Experience in auditing the areas of AML, Sanctions and Operations
* Broad knowledge of banking services, corporate governance and risk management best practices (incl. the Basel framework and ICAAP & Pillar 3 processes)
* ability to audit multiple areas of the Branch
* good knowledge of English
* ability to write clear and detailed reports
* relevant professional certifications (CIA, CISA, CAMS, etc.)
* availability to travel within UAE and to different countries especially in MEA Region

**About us**

We are the leading banking group in Italy and one of the Top Tier in Europe. Join us and be part of our successful story!

With over 20 million customers in Italy and abroad, we are a true engine of sustainable growth, with a strong commitment to the environment and a tangible impact on society. People are our driving force. We take care of them and foster an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

The Chief Audit Officer Area aims to ensure independent and continuous oversight of the Bank’s and Group’s processes and operations, in order to prevent or detect anomalous and risky behaviors or situations. Through advisory activities, it supports corporate structures in strengthening the internal control system and improving process effectiveness. The Area also supports governance by providing Top Management and Corporate Bodies with a clear and structured view of the state of controls and the findings emerging from audit activities, with a focus on transparency, soundness, and sustainable value creation.

jobs.title: Sales, Trading and Structuring Off Cycle Internship Programme 2027 Dubai
jobs.description:
Date live: 11/10/2026

Business Area: See job description

Area of Expertise: Early Careers

Contract: Intern

Reference Code: JR-0000125149

  

**Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.
* Identification of opportunities, development of business cases, management of the deployment and launch of new products and services for the global markets division.
* Management of client relationships and provision of customer service support to clients and customers, under steadily decreasing supervision, responding to questions about products and services, processing of transactions.
* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.
* Training and mentoring of junior colleagues.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisation’s products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
