jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
* Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
* Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
* Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.

**Team Leadership**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager ( Dostt )
jobs.description:
**About Lokal:**

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a  **house of focused apps,**  many products, one mission:   
 to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the  **Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts**  they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

* **Emotional Well-being Peer Support**  - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt Eaze)
* **Astrology Guidance**  - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* **Edutainment Skill Learning**  - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* **Matrimonial Matchmaking**  - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* **Agri Consulting**  - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* **Local Jobs**  - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* **Social Community**  - Place to find post social updates (Lokal app)
* **Advisory Services**  - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a  **discovery and access platform**  : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:   
 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre -  **access changes lives**  .

**We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.**

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

**About the Team:**  The Product Team at Lokal operates as the engine driving our house of apps model. We work at the intersection of deep Bharat user insights, cutting-edge AI, and business strategy. As a Group Product Manager, you will lead a squad of Product Managers and Product Analysts, taking end-to-end ownership of a major product vertical or portfolio of apps to scale engagement, monetization, and user retention.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Product Manager / Senior Product Manager to lead key initiatives. Youll own high-impact projects across pricing, growth, user retention, expansion, and platform strategy-working closely with cross-functional teams to scale Products at Lokal.

**Responsibilities:**

+ **Drive product strategy**  to maximize conversion and retention through data-driven analysis of supply-side levers and their business impact.
+ **Own and enhance payment systems**  by improving payment success metrics, optimizing payment gateway (PG) integrations, and elevating the overall checkout experience.
+ **Design and run pricing experiments**  including default pricing, cohort-based pricing, discounting models, and repeat-user strategies to optimize revenue growth.
+ **Collaborate with Marketing**  to unlock and scale new acquisition channels while continuously optimizing performance.
+ **Strengthen trust and user satisfaction**  by defining and improving profile verification workflows and customer support processes.
+ **Partner cross-functionally**  with design, engineering, analytics, and business teams to execute, measure, and iterate on impactful solutions.
+ **Own the product roadmap**  , prioritizing initiatives based on business impact and user needs.
+ **Conduct market research**  to stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate insights into product strategy.
+ **Develop retention strategies**  to increase repeat revenue and long-term user engagement.
+ **Analyze user behavior**  and implement gamification mechanics to enhance user motivation and platform stickiness.

**What We re Looking For:**

+ 5 - 9 years of experience in product management, preferably in consumer internet or marketplace products.
+ Strong background in data-driven decision-making; must be mathematically sharp and investigative in approach.
+ Educational background from top-tier institutes preferred.
+ Prior experience in marketplaces or platforms with demand-supply matching problems is a strong plus.
+ Ability to think strategically and also roll up your sleeves to execute.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* At Lokal, we act like owners who take initiative beyond job descriptions, get things done despite obstacles, and maintain a growth mindset focused on learning. Were outcome-driven with bias for action, believing speed matters in building products for billion Indians. Decision-making involves open debate followed by full commitment, and we operate on context rather than control - managers share the "why" while you own execution. We aim to be an all-star team that thinks big and takes calculated risks to achieve ambitious goals.
* Be part of a fast-growing startup with 100M+ downloads and a footprint across 1000+ towns 250+ districts - huge scope for impact and learning.
* Opportunity for fast growth, professionally and personally, as you help expand into new areas and build things from scratch.
* Access comprehensive benefits, including insurance coverage, generous leave policies, ESOP buybacks, flexible work-from-home options, and more.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager (AI)-2
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Product Manager (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for an AI agent platform that serves
  
  
Mastercard issuers and acquirers - enabling non-technical financial operations teams to surface insights, investigate anomalies, and act on reconciliation data through natural language. You will define what gets built, sequence when it gets built, and ensure every decision is grounded in measurable customer and business value. You work at the intersection of customer discovery, AI capability, and compliance - and you are comfortable making hard prioritization calls in all three dimensions simultaneously.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for the AI agent platform: define the vision, articulate the roadmap, and maintain a prioritized backlog that reflects real customer need, business impact, and delivery

feasibility.
  
  

* Drive customer discovery alongside forward deployed engineers - conduct structured interviews with issuers and acquirers, synthesize operational workflow pain points into validated product requirements, and

distinguish symptoms from root causes.
  
  

* Translate PoC findings and field signal into scoped, shippable product briefs: clearly written requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that engineering teams can build against without returning to you

for clarification.
  
  

* Define and own the agent capability roadmap - which workflows get automated, in what sequence, at what level of AI autonomy - balancing customer readiness, data availability, and compliance constraints.
* Set and track outcome-oriented success metrics for each agent and platform capability; ensure the team is measuring actual customer impact (time saved, errors reduced, queries resolved) not just activity.
* Partner with engineering leads to make build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions; understand enough about how AI systems work to evaluate feasibility claims honestly without being captured by engineering

enthusiasm or conservatism.
  
  

* Own the compliance and governance interface: work with legal, security, and risk teams to ensure product decisions account for data classification, audit requirements, and approval gates - and translate those

constraints back into product requirements without losing velocity.
  
  

* Manage stakeholder expectations across business, technology, and customer-facing teams; communicate roadmap trade-offs clearly and defend prioritization decisions with evidence.
* Define the agent maturity model - the progression from informational to insight to recommendation to action - and own the criteria that determine when a capability is ready to advance to the next tier.
* Identify platform-level patterns across individual agent builds and advocate for shared infrastructure investments that accelerate future delivery rather than optimizing only for the next release.
* Contribute to pre-sales and commercial conversations as the product authority - set honest expectations on what AI can deliver today, what requires a roadmap investment, and what is out of scope.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience in product management for data, analytics, or AI products.
* Proven track record owning and shipping AI or data products in enterprise B2B environments - you can point to products you defined that are in production and delivering measurable value.
* Deep understanding of the AI product lifecycle: from discovery and PoC through productization, compliance review, and post-launch iteration. You know which phase you are in and what the exit criteria are.
* Strong customer instinct: you have run discovery sessions with non-technical domain experts, translated messy operational workflows into clean product requirements, and caught requirements that sounded right but would not generalize.
* Comfortable with the economics of AI products - inference cost, latency trade-offs, model capability ceilings, evaluation rigor - well enough to make roadmap trade-offs without deferring every technical question to engineering.
* Experience managing products in regulated industries (financial services, payments, or comparable); you understand what compliance and data governance constraints actually mean for product scope, not just as a checkbox.
* Strong written communication: your PRDs, briefs, and roadmap documents are clear enough that stakeholders and engineers reach different parts of them for different reasons - and both find what they need.
* Sharp prioritization discipline: you can say no to a well-articulated customer request, explain why, and offer a path forward that serves the underlying need without expanding scope.
* Experience working in a platform-and-application product model: you understand the tension between shipping agent-specific features and investing in platform capabilities, and you make that trade-off deliberately.
* Collaborative leadership style with an ability to influence without authority - across engineering, design, data science, sales, and compliance functions that each have their own priorities.
* Familiarity with agentic AI concepts (tool use, retrieval, reasoning loops, guardrails, safety) at a level sufficient to write meaningful acceptance criteria and evaluate whether an implementation actually

meets the product intent.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**5. Retail & Channel Management**

* Develop retail merchandising standards and in-store visual experiences.

jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Vice President, Technical Lead(FIX Order)- Equities
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate IT Equities Technology
  
  
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting. Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores—often developing new platforms from the ground up with clear ownership and impact. Role Overview
  
  
The Connectivity team is seeking a Vice President to lead the regional FIX Order and Execution Systems team based in Pune. This is a hands-on team leadership role with responsibility for setting priorities, allocating work, developing engineers, and coordinating the team’s delivery and production support. The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style. The team’s technical scope includes FIX configuration, sell-side broker connectivity, messaging and system-performance analytics, automated testing, and CI/CD implementation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the local Pune regional team day to day: set priorities, allocate work, balance delivery and production-support demands, and maintain clear ownership and escalation paths within the team.
* Develop team capability through coaching, regular feedback, knowledge sharing, and delegation; build a supportive environment where engineers raise risks early and take ownership of outcomes.
* Represent the Pune team in global planning and incident coordination, communicating the local team’s capacity, dependencies, risks, and commitments and coordinating handovers with peer teams in other regions.
* Lead the design, implementation, certification, and production support of FIX order and execution systems.
* Translate front-office trading requirements into FIX session configurations, message mappings, validation rules, and routing logic.
* Configure and support sell-side broker FIX connectivity, including new sessions, client migrations, and production changes.
* Analyze FIX messages and application behavior across the complete order lifecycle.
* Diagnose session management, sequence, validation, order-state, reject, routing, and downstream processing issues.
* Build or enhance tools for connectivity configuration, certification, monitoring, and operational support.
* Analyze message volumes, latency, throughput, burst patterns, queue behavior, and capacity.
* Develop AI-assisted models or tools for generating and prioritizing test scenarios for FIX order and execution systems.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for configuration, code, testing, and deployment.
* Develop applications and automation using Java or Python.
* Define production-readiness criteria, monitoring requirements, support procedures, and rollback plans.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis for significant connectivity issues.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* Generally, 10 years of FIX engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on hands-on engineering of FIX order and execution systems, together with demonstrated experience leading a technical team.
* Proven experience leading a local technical team, including work allocation, coaching, delivery oversight, and production-support coordination, while collaborating with peer teams in other locations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve outcomes through others: delegate effectively, give constructive feedback, resolve competing priorities, and build team capability rather than rely on individual intervention.
* Extensive experience with electronic equities trading and front-office FIX order and execution systems.
* Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers.
* Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity.
* Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.
* Experience diagnosing FIX rejects, session failures, sequence issues, mapping problems, and routing defects.
* Experience analyzing messaging performance, latency, throughput, and system behavior.
* Intermediate or stronger development skills in Java or Python.
* Experience with automated build, test, deployment, and CI/CD tooling.
* Strong production-support, incident-management, leadership, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Familiarity with FIX Orchestra, FIX dictionaries, custom tags, and venue-specific extensions.
* Experience with QuickFIX/J, proprietary FIX platforms, ULLINK product suite, or comparable FIX technology; experience with Verifix or other FIX simulation tools.
* Experience with Solace, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning to test generation, failure analysis, or operational analytics.
* Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Assistant Vice President (IC) - Specialized Analytics** is a developing professional role within the QATV team. This role applies specialized expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, data science, and advanced AI technologies (including Generative AI and Agentic AI) to revolutionize how regulatory testing is executed, analyzed, and governed.

The Data Science Analyst will partner with QATV testing and reporting teams to identify high-impact opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent reporting. Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

jobs.title: Chief Data Office - Data Management & Governance Lead - Vice President
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.**

As a Data Governance Lead (Vice President) within the Chief Data Office, you will lead Markets data quality and data lineage initiatives, partnering across business, control functions, and Technology to deliver measurable risk reduction, operational efficiency, and regulatory-ready outcomes.

**Job Responsibilities :**

* Lead discussions with technology teams to agree and implement technical solutions for data quality remediation, including control automation/industrialization, monitoring, and evidence generation where appropriate.
* Discover and document end-to-end data lineage, tracing data from creation to consumption to support regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239 and internal standards for critical data elements and critical data flows.
* Partner with Markets operations, technology, and product control teams to establish and document data quality controls across critical data flows, including control points, thresholds, exception workflows, and ownership.
* Implement and champion Data Quality practices across the Commercial & Investment Bank, supporting firmwide regulatory and strategic objectives by defining and driving adoption of data quality standards, thresholds, remediation SLAs, and control expectations.
* Provide advisory services on high-profile data initiatives, leveraging project management and business analysis expertise to embed data quality, data lineage, and control requirements into strategic change (e.g., platform migrations, new product initiatives) from inception.
* Influence and guide stakeholders at all levels to drive adoption of data quality standards and best practices, and lead stakeholder forums to drive decisioning, escalations, and risk acceptance where required.
* Represent the Chief Data Office in cross-functional forums, contributing to the development of data management strategies and frameworks, including data quality strategy, issue management cadence, control documentation standards, data lineage documentation standards, and executive-level materials for senior stakeholders.
* Define and maintain management reporting (KPIs/KRIs) for data quality performance, including issue aging, defect recurrence, lineage completeness, and control coverage, to support senior decision-making.
* Apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate data quality investigations and delivery (e.g., drafting lineage/control documentation, synthesizing investigation findings, generating validation logic/test cases), ensuring appropriate data handling, human oversight, and adherence to firm policies.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Significant experience in financial services, with a background in operations, finance, program management, data analytics, or business analysis, and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across business and Technology stakeholders.
* Proven track record leading projects or business-as-usual initiatives focused on data quality, data lineage, control documentation, and metadata management, with clear accountability for outcomes, issue management cadence, and closure discipline.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and connect detailed analysis to broader business objectives, including translating complex investigations into executive-ready options and recommendations.
* Proficiency in manipulating and analyzing large data sets using Excel (pivots, formulas, charts) and other data tools to validate issues, quantify impact, and evidence remediation effectiveness.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across business and technology, including chairing working groups and contributing to senior steering forums.
* Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes under pressure while operating with strong risk discipline and attention to controls.
* Deep understanding of business practices and products within the Commercial & Investment Bank, with a focus on Markets.
* AI/LLM experience (required): demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to improve productivity in data quality and data lineage documentation, analysis, and/or control design, with strong judgment around confidentiality, appropriate use, and required human review/validation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Expertise in data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and data control concepts, including standards and control frameworks.
* Experience in a Chief Data Office or Data Quality organization within an investment bank or large financial institution.
* Proficiency in querying databases or data stores for advanced data analysis.
* Skilled in producing executive-level PowerPoint presentations for senior audiences.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as BCBS 239 and industry best practices in data management, and ability to translate regulatory expectations into practical data quality, data lineage, and control outcomes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Jr AppSec Engineer
jobs.description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Application security assurance, governance and risk decisions**

**Job Posting Title**

**Jr AppSec Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 3

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

This AVP3 position is a senior individual-contributor role focused on consistent, risk-based application security assurance across a large application estate. It covers application discovery and classification, proportionate security reviews, evidence quality, exceptions and a clear view of coverage and residual risk.

Although the posting title is Jr AppSec Engineer, the management level requires mature judgement, credible stakeholder leadership and the ability to quality-review assurance decisions. The role remains technically grounded and must recognise when manual testing or specialist review is required.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead application and API discovery campaigns with technology, business and governance stakeholders; reconcile inventories, identify ownership gaps and define the population requiring AppSec oversight.

* Apply and improve risk-classification criteria using criticality, data, exposure, users, transactions, technology, regulatory relevance, threat and change to determine assurance depth and cadence.

* Review existing security evidence for control intent, scope, recency, testing method and applicability; reuse credible evidence and identify requirements that still need review or testing.

* Create proportionate assurance plans that combine existing evidence, questionnaires, design review, threat modelling, automated control results and specialist testing based on risk.

* Direct proportionate application security reviews, track completion and quality-review decisions with explicit conditions, assumptions and validity periods.

* Coordinate with AppSec testing, Red Team and DevSecOps colleagues when technical depth is required; ensure their output is incorporated into the assurance decision.

* Collaborate with architecture teams on security requirements and risk challenge without taking ownership of target architecture, solution design or design-authority decisions.

* Support threat-modelling and secure-design discussions, ensuring actions have owners and are reflected in delivery plans and acceptance criteria.

* Govern exceptions and risk acceptance: confirm accountable ownership, rationale, risk statement, compensating controls, remediation plan, expiry and required approval.

* Challenge weak or incomplete evidence and prevent administrative completion from being treated as security effectiveness.

* Maintain clear review records, decision logs and evidence traceability for governance, audit and regulatory review.

* Define metrics for population coverage, risk tiers, assessment status, evidence reuse, gaps, findings, remediation, exceptions and overdue decisions; explain trends and limitations.

* Prepare concise governance reporting and facilitate decisions with application owners, engineering leaders, Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Audit.

Coach junior assurance staff, calibrate decisions across reviewers and improve standards, templates and playbooks using lessons from delivery.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in application security assurance, technology risk, product security, security governance or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience delivering risk-based application security assurance across multiple applications and stakeholder groups.

* Strong judgement in evidence sufficiency, control effectiveness, risk classification, exception quality and review conditions.

* Working knowledge of application architectures, web and API risk, threat modelling, secure development and automated security testing.

* Ability to translate between technical findings, control requirements, business impact and accountable risk decisions.

* Experience producing governance metrics and evidence that can withstand audit or regulatory challenge.

* Confident stakeholder facilitation and escalation, including the ability to challenge senior owners constructively.

* Strong written documentation, attention to traceability and ability to manage a sizeable portfolio.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated global organisation.

* Familiarity with control frameworks and secure development standards such as NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM, ASVS, ISO 27001 or similar.

* Experience with GRC platforms, application inventories, work-management tools or evidence automation.

* Evidence of practical capability improving application security assurance or secure development practices.

Experience improving an assurance operating model or rationalising duplicate controls.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Be rigorous about evidence while making assurance proportionate to actual risk.

* Do not confuse process completion with an effective security outcome.

* State assumptions, gaps, conditions and decision ownership clearly; avoid ambiguous conclusions.

* Use metrics to support decisions and improvement, not to create false precision.

* Build trusted relationships and lead governance activity from the Hyderabad office.

Disclaimer : Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

jobs.description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Sr DevSecOps Engineer**

**Security engineering for Azure DevOps, CI/CD and scalable controls**

**Job Posting Title**

**Sr DevSecOps Engineer**

**Department**

Information Security - Application Security

  

**Employment Type**

Permanent

  

**Management Level**

Assistant Vice President 3

  

**About Apex**

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 50 offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients and family offices.

The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry, including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll, and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. We value people who work hard, care about what they do and are prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today. As we grow, that contribution becomes even more important. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to help you thrive.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior DevSecOps security engineer to design and lead scalable security controls across source, build, artefact and deployment workflows, with a strong focus on Azure DevOps. The role turns AppSec policy into reliable engineering guardrails that provide fast feedback and progressively prevent material risk.

You will own the technical integration and operating quality of security capabilities in CI/CD. You will partner with AppSec, platform and product engineering teams, but you will not take ownership of application or enterprise architecture decisions.

  

**Location:** Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role.

  

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Define and implement the DevSecOps control architecture for Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, including reusable templates, service connections, permissions, policies, artefact handling and evidence capture.

* Integrate and operate SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container scanning, DAST and API security testing at appropriate pipeline stages.

* Design a staged report-to-blocking rollout: baseline current exposure, tune results, define risk thresholds, pilot with representative teams, measure disruption, establish exception paths and expand safely.

* Create policy-as-code and quality-gate logic that accounts for severity, exploitability, asset criticality, reachability, fix availability, new-versus-existing debt and approved risk decisions.

* Build reliable result ingestion, deduplication, ownership routing, suppression governance and links back to source, build and deployment context.

* Partner with AppSec engineers to align pipeline rules with secure development requirements, review evidence and remediation validation.

* Engineer controls for pull requests, dependencies, secrets, build provenance, container images and infrastructure definitions without creating avoidable delivery bottlenecks.

* Monitor scanner availability, agent capacity, latency, licensing, coverage, false-positive rate and integration failures; define support procedures and service objectives.

* Design controlled bypass and exception mechanisms with expiry, approval, rationale, compensating controls and complete audit trails; do not allow silent bypasses.

* Automate dashboards and evidence for coverage, policy outcomes, blocked builds, ageing findings, exceptions and adoption while protecting sensitive finding data.

* Lead structured tool evaluations and proofs of concept covering detection efficacy, language and platform coverage, API quality, deployment model, usability, scalability, security and cost.

* Provide developer-facing documentation, reference pipelines, troubleshooting guides and enablement; use feedback to reduce friction without weakening risk controls.

* Collaborate with architecture and platform owners on design constraints and integration patterns without assuming their decision accountability.

Coach DevSecOps and AppSec engineers, review changes, and apply secure engineering practices to the security automation itself.  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Typically 6+ years in DevOps, platform engineering, software engineering or security engineering, including substantial ownership of CI/CD security controls.

* Deep practical experience with Azure DevOps repos and pipelines, YAML templates, service connections, agents, permissions and branch or pull-request policies.

* Hands-on integration experience across several of SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API security capabilities.

* Strong scripting or programming skills and experience building maintainable automation using APIs, version control, testing and peer review.

* Understanding of software supply-chain risk, dependency and licence risk, secrets handling, artefact integrity, container security and cloud infrastructure definitions.

* Experience tuning tools and designing risk-based gates that developers can understand and operations teams can support.

* Ability to diagnose pipeline failures across network, identity, agent, tool and configuration layers.

* Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to lead adoption across multiple engineering teams.

Fluent English, spoken and written.  

  

**Additional Practical Experience**

* Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, registries, signing or attestation, SBOMs and software supply-chain frameworks.

* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM, Helm or similar.

* Experience with commercial AppSec platforms, vulnerability-management integrations or enterprise developer portals.

* Hands-on experience operating Azure DevOps, cloud or Kubernetes security controls at enterprise scale.

Experience in financial services or another regulated, high-availability environment.  

  

**Candidate Expectations**

* Optimise for reliable controls and developer adoption, not tool deployment alone.

* Use data and pilots before introducing blocking changes that could disrupt delivery.

As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).

This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.

* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.

* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and document negotiation and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit & Lending (C&L) tasks, creating a single control point. We are currently seeking an ambitious professional to join the team as an Assistant Vice President who will provide credit advisory and support services to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage. This includes facilitating client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process

  

**In this role, you will:-**

* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs

• Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders• Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds
* Drive continuous improvement in productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recommendations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators

**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**

  

* Proven expertise in corporate lending with strong analytical skills
* Must possess sound credit knowledge with proven skills of writing credit proposals
* Strong understanding of financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Tenacious with numbers – aptitude for analyzing and interpreting data.
* A trust earner – can listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* Committed to quality – high standards for work, solve problems so they are fixed and stay fixed.
* A critical thinker – can operate independently and use judgement in a dynamic environment.
* Attentive to detail and can apply professional skepticism – not afraid to challenge the status quo.
* Degree in Business, Finance or related field is highly desirable
* A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and/or work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.
