jobs.title: Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates within one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Extended Leadership Team, and report directly to the Senior Director and Head of Specialist & Consulting Delivery, VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Director, Consulting Delivery will lead the consulting delivery team within VCA-X and will be responsible for ensuring consulting resources are effectively deployed, developed, and supported across the portfolio. They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.
  
  
This leader will ensure VCA-X engagements have the consulting capacity, expertise, and leadership required to deliver high-quality client outcomes. Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Of The Role Include**
Specialist & Consulting Organization Leadership
  
  

* Build and manage a flexible consulting delivery pool that can be deployed across priority use cases, Regions, and multidisciplinary engagement teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing specialist and consulting talent.
* Partner with Program Management to forecast consulting resource needs and ensure sufficient consulting delivery capacity to support engagement demand.
* Foster a culture of intellectual rigor, collaboration, learning, and client impact.

Consulting Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Ensure engagements are staffed with the appropriate consulting capabilities and delivery support required to achieve engagement objectives.
* Provide oversight for complex, high-impact, or strategically important engagements.
* Lead deployment of consulting delivery resources across the VCA-X portfolio, balancing expertise, capacity, development opportunities, and delivery priorities.
* Coach teams in structured problem solving, insight development, recommendation formulation, and executive communication.
* Serve as an advisor and first escalation point for delivery teams.

Delivery Quality & Client Readiness
  
  

* Establish delivery standards, quality expectations, and review processes across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Ensure outputs are commercially relevant, supported by sound specialist judgement, and appropriate to client and market context.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Partner with Regional VCA teams to ensure outputs support successful client engagement.

Practice Area Partnership & Methodology Enablement
  
  

* Partner with Practice Areas to operationalize established methodologies into scalable delivery approaches.
* Lead validation of new use cases and delivery approaches before they are scaled broadly across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Capture delivery feedback and provide structured input to methodology evolution and improvement.

Expertise Development & Continuous Learning
  
  

* Define the specialist expertise and consulting capabilities required across the portfolio.
* Establish learning pathways and leadership development approaches.
* Capture specialist, consulting and quality learnings from engagements and translate them into improved methodologies, delivery approaches, training and reusable assets.
* Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to strengthen multidisciplinary delivery.

Why this is important to Visa
  
  
Scaling VCA-X is central to VCA's strategy for expanding delivery capacity, accelerating execution, and creating greater impact for clients globally.
  
  
The ability to scale delivery successfully depends not only on capacity but on maintaining the quality, expertise, and consulting rigor that clients expect from VCA.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring that VCA-X delivers consistent, high-quality outputs while building the specialist and consulting capability required to support future growth. The Director will play a key role in strengthening delivery excellence, accelerating learning, and increasing the impact of VCA across Regions.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**What You Will Need**

* 15+ years of experience in consulting, advisory services, professional services, specialist delivery, or related fields.
* Demonstrated success leading complex client engagements and ensuring executive-level quality standards.
* Strong consulting toolkit including structured problem solving, analytical reasoning, synthesis, storylining, and recommendation development.
* Experience scaling consulting organizations across multiple markets or regions.
* Ability to translate methodologies into repeatable and scalable delivery approaches.
* Executive presence and strong stakeholder-management skills.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build partnerships across matrixed organizations.
* Strong academic credentials with an undergraduate or advanced degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* What will also help:
* Expertise in one or more VCA domains such as portfolio optimization, risk, or digital.
* Experience operating within global consulting, managed-services, or professional-services organizations.
* Knowledge of payments, financial services, or adjacent industries.
* Experience building new capabilities, operating models, or delivery organizations from the ground up.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender

jobs.description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing, and tax advisory services. The company’s philosophy prioritizes planning before execution and places client interests first, combining professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions.

* Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation, and relationship management.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate, and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in building and scaling advisory businesses in competitive markets.
* Deep understanding of digital tools and technology-enabled advisory workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, and operations teams.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Opportunity to build a trusted, high-performing, and profitable advisory business in Bengaluru.
* Focus on establishing a strong local presence, creating a consistent acquisition engine, growing AUA and long-term advisory relationships.
* Culture that values ownership, ethical advice, and measurable outcomes.
* Support to develop a capable team and build operating systems that support the next stage of expansion.

* Collaborate effectively with stakeholders and leaders across multiple organizations to achieve objectives

* Demonstrate problem-solving and analysis skills with attention to detail
* Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, problem solving and influencing skills across various levels of the organization
* Actively support internal and external audits and exams
* Balance multiple priorities to help drive business value and support team objectives, while managing tasks and activities related to risk management initiatives in a well-managed capacity
* Lead a team of professionals to advise and consult key stakeholders to drive effective risk identification, assessment, and disposition.
* Set direction, manage expectations, and lead cross-functional teams
* Foster an environment of trust, collaboration & belonging while leading a team

* At least 18 years of experience in risk management

**Location: Bengaluru, India**

**Who We Are**

Robert Walters is the world’s most trusted talent solutions business. Across the globe, we deliver recruitment, outsourcing, and talent advisory services for businesses of all sizes, opening doors for people with diverse skills, ambitions, and backgrounds.

Our Outsourcing service delivers recruitment for some of the world’s top employers, and we are currently recruiting on behalf of one of our clients, which is a leading international banking group, with a presence in 54 of the world’s most dynamic markets. Our purpose is to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, and our heritage and values are expressed in our brand promise, here for good.

**The Role**

Our client is seeking a
**Head, Credit Risk Review, Specialised Finance**
in the
**Banking**
division.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a global team, providing top-tier service to existing and prospective clients while expanding the business on a product and global level.

**Job Description:**

**Job Summary:**

* Lead independent, technical, and forward-looking assessments of the credit quality, risk governance, and control environment across the Group's global Specialized Finance portfolio.
* Exercise independent challenge and escalation authority under the Credit Risk Review mandate while maintaining clear separation from first-line credit and business decision-making.
* Conduct independent reviews that drive strategic and business outcomes, including decisions on portfolio growth, risk appetite, sector and country concentrations, capital deployment, hold levels, and distribution strategy.
* Identify emerging and systemic risks, influence improvements in underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management, and ensure timely remediation of material weaknesses.
* Provide senior management, risk committees, and regulators with independent assurance on underwriting, structuring, portfolio quality, risk appetite alignment, lifecycle monitoring, and problem-credit management.
* Perform Business Credit Application and portfolio reviews across Project Finance, Sponsor Finance, Private Credit, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Infrastructure & Power, Natural Resources, Transportation (Shipping/Aviation), Export Finance, Structured Asset Finance, and other asset-backed or cash-flow-based lending.
* Focus on Credit Risk and its interaction with ESG, climate, and country risks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategy
:**

Maintain awareness of the Group's Specialized Finance strategy and assess whether growth priorities, sector and country concentrations, tenor, leverage, distribution assumptions and originate-to-distribute activity remain aligned with approved risk appetite. Specifically the role requires:

* Served as the senior independent reviewer for Specialized Finance, providing oversight and escalation of key credit and portfolio risks.
* Advised leadership on portfolio strategy, risk appetite, growth priorities, capital deployment, and concentration limits.
* Identified emerging and systemic risks across sectors and regions, recommending risk mitigation and control enhancements.
* Assessed portfolio sustainability under stressed conditions, balancing risk, return, capital, and concentration exposures.
* Independently challenged underwriting, portfolio management, and strategic decisions to ensure compliance with approved risk appetite.
* Monitored portfolio vulnerabilities and concentrations, ensuring timely identification and remediation of material risks.

**Business**
:

* Provided strategic oversight of Specialized Finance portfolios, aligning growth, capital allocation, sustainability objectives, and distribution strategies with risk appetite.
* Assessed macroeconomic, sector, sovereign, commodity, and market risks impacting portfolio performance and resilience.
* Evaluated portfolio exposures to concentration, refinancing, interest rate, inflation, and other emerging risk factors through forward-looking reviews.
* Led independent assessment of complex project and structured finance transactions, including cash flow analysis, ESG/climate risks, and distressed assets.
* Translated portfolio and thematic review findings into strategic recommendations to enhance underwriting, structuring, and portfolio management practices.
* Influenced senior stakeholders to strengthen credit governance, risk controls, risk appetite adherence, and portfolio resilience through effective challenge and remediation oversight.

**Processes**
:

* Led Specialized Finance credit reviews, ensuring compliance with policies, regulations, and governance standards.
* Enhanced review methodologies, portfolio analytics, and risk assessment frameworks.
* Conducted end-to-end credit reviews, including transaction assessment, model validation, and stakeholder engagement.
* Developed risk-based review programs covering high-risk sectors, jurisdictions, refinancing risks, and portfolio concentrations.
* Evaluated complex financing structures and key legal, ESG, technical, valuation, and financial risks.
* Identified and escalated material underwriting, monitoring, concentration, and control weaknesses, driving timely remediation.

**Risk Management:**

* Conducted end-to-end reviews of Specialized Finance transactions, assessing sponsor strength, project viability, leverage, cash flows, covenants, and refinancing risk.
* Performed stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate repayment capacity, credit quality, and recovery outcomes.
* Reviewed funding structures, covenant compliance, drawdown controls, reserve adequacy, and sponsor support arrangements.
* Assessed risk ratings, expected loss, collateral valuations, and recovery assumptions for accuracy and appropriateness.
* Evaluated distressed credits, restructuring strategies, refinancing options, and recovery plans.
* Identified, challenged, and escalated material credit and structural risks, driving effective risk mitigation and remediation.

**Governance**
:

* Assess the effectiveness of global, regional and country governance for Specialized Finance, including sector oversight, delegated authorities, credit committee challenge, exception governance, portfolio limits, concentration monitoring, model governance and watchlist escalation.
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Deliver effective governance through credible challenge of senior executives on complex Specialized Finance judgements and maintain open, cooperative engagement with relevant regulators.

**Regulatory and Business Conduct:**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group's Valued Behaviours and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Operation of Financial Markets; Financial Crime Prevention; and The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identiW, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

jobs.title: Model Risk Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Role Overview:**

Mizuho America’s Model Risk Management is the firm’s second line of defense and is responsible for managing model risk generated via the firm’s various entities and corporate functions. The group is tasked with establishing and implementing an SR 26-2 consistent risk management framework by which the firm’s model inventory is effectively challenged and validated. The group is also tasked with managing model risk governance, ensuring compliance with policies, procedures, and regulations. Mizuho seeks a highly motivated individual to serve as a Director, responsible for building and leading Model Risk team at the Mizuho Pune office. The role reports locally to the Mizuho Pune Head of Risk and globally to the Head of Model Risk Management within America’s Risk Management department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Establish and lead the Model Risk capability in Mizuho Pune, including operating model, processes and ways of working.
* Build and lead a high-performing Pune Model Risk team and help evolve Mizuho Pune into an active risk-management hub.
* Act as the senior Model Risk point of contact for the Pune site, ensuring effective connectivity with MUSO and global Model Risk teams.
* Manage a team of validation specialists, focusing on Pricing/Valuation models for Equity and Fixed Income Derivatives, XVA and other related models, providing guidance as necessary to ensure that the most robust independent review and challenge is possible
* Train and develop junior team members focusing on overlapping areas of expertise within the team, independence of view, and vocal challenge
* Design, build, and manage Model Risk workflow management, including AI tools, to assist in the efficient execution of the group's framework.
* Assist in maintaining a strong model governance framework, working with management and model owners to ensure maximum alignment with regulatory and policy requirements

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience Qualifications:**

* 18-20+ years of experience in financial services with specific experience in Model Risk
* Solid understanding of risk management concepts
* Working knowledge of SR 11-7 and SR 26-2 guidance on model risk management
* Strong management skills with experience in managing quants while maintaining strong relationships with management and business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience in responding to audit and regulatory requests
* Impeccable attention to detail and a high standard of polish with regards to documentation and presentation materials

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

jobs.title: Business Head
jobs.description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Business Head?**

As a Business Head at SmartQ you will be spearheading the development of new business, setting the course for other business verticals to follow, executing high-level business strategies, and championing the pursuit of organizational excellence. Your expertise will be crucial in defining and realizing our global aspirations, driving sustainable growth, and ensuring our position as a leader in the industry.

We are looking for a dynamic professional with strong operational expertise and proven leadership

experience who can make a meaningful impact on our expanding business presence. If you are eager to contribute to the evolving world of food and technology and possess the skills to lead with excellence, we would be delighted to have you join our team.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive business strategies aligned with the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth plans within the F&B industry.
* Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer preferences, and new business opportunities, enabling the organization to maintain a strong competitive advantage.
* Manage end-to-end operations of the F&B business unit, ensuring seamless coordination across departments and delivering operational excellence.
* Streamline operational processes and implement efficiency-driven initiatives to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and reduce operational costs.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management to achieve revenue growth, profitability, and financial sustainability targets.
* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams by fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning to ensure individual and organizational success.
* Promote a positive and customer-focused workplace culture that encourage teamwork, innovation, and superior service delivery.
* Identify and pursue new business expansion opportunities across existing and untapped markets while collaborating with sales and marketing teams to strengthen business development and accelerate revenue generation.
* Monitor key business metrics, operational KPIs, and financial performance to ensure continuous improvement and achievement of organizational goals.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, quality standards, food safety protocols, and company policies across all business operations

**Qualifications:**

* Proven 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in the food services or F&B industry, with a strong track record of driving business growth, operational excellence, and profitability in high-performance environments.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Hospitality, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale business operations, managing cross-functional teams, and delivering strategic initiatives in a senior leadership capacity.
* Exceptional strategic thinking, business acumen, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions in fast-paced and dynamic environments.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, partners, and senior management effectively.
* Sound financial expertise with proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, cost optimization, and revenue enhancement strategies.
* Deep understanding of the food services industry, market trends, customer behavior, operational best practices, and competitive business landscapes.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

JOB DESCRIPTION Zoho Books Accountant K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons Kasaragod, Kerala Position: Zoho Books Accountant Department: Accounts & Finance Location: Kasaragod, Kerala Employment Type: Full-time Reporting To: Management / Accounts Head 1. About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. The company is engaged in cashew kernel processing, domestic and international trading, procurement of raw cashew nuts and sale of cashew by-products. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

Pay: ₹8,500.00 - ₹42,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About Us**
------------

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.

* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.

* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation

**Head of Treasury - Investment Holding Group**

**The Opportunity**

I am working with a well-established investment holding group in the UAE that is looking to appoint a Head of Treasury. The business has a significant portfolio of investments across multiple sectors and international markets.

As the group continues to grow and diversify, it is looking for someone to take ownership of its treasury function, develop its funding strategy and improve how cash, liquidity and financial risk are managed across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on leadership role with direct exposure to senior management and shareholders. The successful candidate will be expected to bring ideas, challenge existing processes and build a treasury function that can support the group's future investment activity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage the group's treasury strategy, including liquidity planning, funding and capital allocation.
* Advise senior management on the investment of surplus cash, balancing returns, liquidity requirements and financial risk.
* Manage relationships with UAE and international banks, negotiating funding facilities, credit lines, guarantees and deposit arrangements.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing and capital structure initiatives across group entities.
* Oversee FX and interest-rate exposure, including the use of appropriate hedging instruments.
* Lead the implementation and development of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), banking integrations and reporting automation.
* Establish treasury policies, controls and governance frameworks across the group.
* Improve cash visibility and forecasting across subsidiaries, investments and international operations.
* Work closely with investment and finance teams to understand upcoming transactions, funding requirements and capital commitments.
* Provide regular treasury reporting and recommendations to senior management and shareholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve banking terms, reduce financing costs and generate better returns on available cash.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 12–18+ years of experience across corporate treasury, group treasury or corporate finance, with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Background within an investment holding company, family office, conglomerate, real estate investment group or similarly complex organisation.
* Strong experience managing sizeable cash, debt or investment portfolios.
* Proven experience negotiating directly with banks on financing facilities, refinancing, guarantees and other treasury products.
* Good understanding of treasury investments, capital allocation, FX and interest-rate risk management.
* Experience implementing or leading TMS projects, treasury automation and process improvements.
* Strong UAE banking relationships and knowledge of the regional financial market.
* Comfortable operating in a lean team, taking ownership and working directly with senior stakeholders.
* CTP, ACT, CFA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent qualifications would be advantageous.

**The Opportunity Offers**

* A senior role with responsibility for developing the group's treasury function.
* Direct involvement in funding decisions, capital allocation and treasury strategy.
* Exposure to a diversified portfolio of investments across the UAE and international markets.
* The opportunity to lead treasury systems implementation and improve existing processes.
* Regular interaction with senior management and shareholders.

Applications will be treated confidentially. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

jobs.description:
**Ready to shape Islamic finance growth across the MENAT region?**

Working as a subject matter expert, you’ll support business growth through transaction origination, structuring, execution and Shariah governance. You’ll partner with relationship managers and product teams to deliver Shariah-compliant financing solutions that meet client needs while maintaining regulatory, risk and control standards. The role also covers launching new Islamic products across the CIB platform, from due diligence through to implementation. Success means delivering scalable Islamic structures, progressing opportunities from concept to closing and supporting consistent practices across jurisdictions. * Shape and execute the Islamic finance agenda across the HBME MENAT region
* Partner with relationship managers and business heads to identify and convert Islamic financing opportunities across GCC and wider MENAT

* Draft and review Islamic term sheets, indicative proposals, transaction structures and approval papers
* Coordinate Shariah adviser engagement and governance forum approvals to resolve Shariah-related matters
* Oversee transaction progression through credit approval, Shariah approval, documentation, conditions precedent, closing and post-closing requirements
* Develop and launch new Islamic finance products across the CIB platform including due diligence, manuals, processes and client materials

If you want to work at the centre of Islamic finance origination, structuring and product expansion across MENAT, this role offers a rare mix of advisory depth and execution responsibility. The scope spans complex transactions, new product delivery and close partnership with coverage teams and control functions. If this matches the work you’ve done and the impact you want to have, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President – Investments and Funding (UAE National)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

To lead EDB’s investment and funding strategy by managing multi-asset portfolios and optimizing capital deployment across fixed income, equities, and private equity. The role ensures efficient liquidity and cost of funds through structured funding solutions, including public/private issuances and repo facilities. It also involves overseeing portfolio performance, regulatory compliance, and execution of investment and funding activities aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives, while driving cross-functional collaboration and revenue growth.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Formulate, evaluate and implement investment policies, guidelines, asset allocation, selection of external investment managers, risk management, compliance monitoring and rebalancing through advanced planning and management of investment risk at strategic, managerial and operational levels.
* Manage the investment portfolios, analyze market trends and economic indicators as well as execute trades based on their analysis.
* Construct and continuously manage the fixed income portfolios within the approved parameters to generate alpha (risk-adjusted return) for the bank.
* Utilize cash flow planning for the funds and investments across a multi-year time horizon to assist in strategic decision-making.
* Align investment goals with the overall objectives of the bank and position portfolios accordingly.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis of the private equity portfolio, coupled with arranging quarterly performance calls with their senior management teams, attending AGMs, developing exit strategies (where required), and apprising EDB management periodically.
* Assess the funding needs of the bank, develop funding strategies, source potential investors, and formulate capital structure strategies to advise on capital investment decision making and ensure compliance with financial regulation.
* Choose the most cost-efficient effective funding solutions for the bank to minimize CoF while continuously revamping the mix to achieve optimum results
* Grow the short-term financing tools and manage liquidity of the bank by establishing a Repo framework in accordance with GMRA guidelines to optimize returns or to raise funding using fixed income securities
* Execute all tasks related to any existing or new issuances by the bank (public or private), including deliberations with the JLMs (Joint Lead Managers), external counsels and auditors, securities exchanges, regulators, rating agencies, etc.

**Operational Responsibilities:**

* Originate, price, execute, book, manage and monitor investments like Fixed Income securities, Listed and Unlisted Equities, Repo and Reverse Repos and other investments.
* Assess the bank’s cash positioning, including forecasts, and recommend ways to utilize idle funds by identifying potential investment opportunities
* Anticipate interest rate shifts and optimize trade timing to secure favorable terms with brokers and banks while negotiating terms like interest rates, yield, pricing, before making any investment decisions, ensuring alignment with EDB Investment guidelines and objectives.
* Rotate cash across assets classes or within the same asset class to optimize returns in the short term (when required), while focusing on maximizing the annuity income for the bank on a longer-term risk adjusted net-FTP basis
* Manage the private equity portfolio, review and analyze the company’s yearly valuations, attend EGMs & AGMs, report to senior management on company’s performance, manage dividend payouts, capital reductions or injections, including devising exit strategies
* Coordinate with the Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure exposure remains within the limits defined with adherence to CBUAE and Basel regulatory requirements
* Partner with EDB’s Balance Sheet Management function to understand the bank’s funding requirements in the short, medium and long term.
* Perform market scan with banks, investors and other external counterparties to select viable funding solutions for the bank and recommend the same to ALCO
* Work with internal as well as external stakeholders, from origination to completion, to close the selected approved financing solution
* Transact Repo and Reverse Repo trades to manage short-term financing needs in accordance with approved guidelines. This requires the presence of an approved Repo framework, including a Product Manual, Standard Operating Procedure (SoP), and Operational Risk Assessment Plan (ORAP) duly signed off. Additionally, all transactions must be supported by executed GMRA agreements with counterparties, a functional collateral management operation, established counterparty limits, and a pricing mechanism with clearly defined haircuts.
* Draft and submit memos related to the Investment and Funding businesses to the relevant committees of the bank for approvals as per the DoA matrix
* Coordinate with the MIS team/Finance to deliver periodic performance updates as well as reports for senior management’s review and monitoring
* Evaluate and manage the bank’s capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, and other ratios with the Risk department.
* Cultivate strong relationships with external counterparties while managing internal stakeholders with an equal amount of care and responsibility.
* Ensure all revenue, cost, and volume targets are delivered under the stipulated guidelines.
* Be the key driver in delivering a larger share of the P&L responsibility for T&I.
* Conduct constructive and meaningful discussions with senior management, using market knowledge and business expertise to build trust and affinity, leading to better performance results
* Develop and implement sound business practices across all investment as well as funding related activities/operations to promote efficiencies in work processes.
* Maintain a trusted partner status with Middle Office, Market Risk, Finance, and Operations.
* Comply 100% with all Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Operational requirements as well as ensure there are no breaches
* Function within the framework and boundaries of EDB’s policies as well as overall organizational and governance frameworks
* Maintain adherence to Treasury & Investments policies, procedures, and processes that comply with the leading practices, laws, and regulations
* Take decisions as per the approved authorization matrix.
* Always maintain the highest standards of work ethics, making sure that one operates in a professional environment, there are zero compromises on compliance or principles, any breaches of limits, etc. are immediately escalated, and all activities are performed under the approved audit framework

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

jobs.title: Director – Enterprise Applications, Integration, AI & IT Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**About Zeta**
:

**Build the future of banking.**

Zeta
is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today,
**over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts**
across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by
**SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard**
, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of
**$2 billion**
in 2025.

Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:

1.
**Tachyon**
, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems

2.
**Cipher**
, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments

3.
**Digital Credit as a Service**
, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI

4.
**Elena**
, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking.

5.
**Pixel**
, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with
**HDFC Bank**
, for whom we also revamped their
**PayZapp**
mobile app: Winner of the
**Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024.**

6.
**Sparrow**
, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US

…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**

**If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.**
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years,
**watch our journey here**
. You can also explore
**our website**
and follow us on
**LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior technology leader to lead Zeta’s digital transformation across its Enterprise Applications, Software Solutions, Integration, AI, IT Infrastructure, and Operations landscape.

The role sits at the intersection of enterprise applications, software engineering, integration architecture, AI-enabled automation, IT infrastructure, service management, cybersecurity, and technology operations. The leader will ensure that Zeta’s technology ecosystem is integrated, scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.

The primary charter is to connect and optimize the existing technology ecosystem — integrating SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications; building bridge systems and software solutions where required; and selectively applying AI and automation to improve workflows, data movement, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Alongside this, the role provides strategic and operational oversight of IT infrastructure and IT operations, including networks, endpoints, cloud, Microsoft 365, service desk, application support, reliability, security, and technology governance.

**Responsibilities :-**

**Enterprise Applications & Technology Strategy**

* Own the roadmap for the organization's Enterprise Application ecosystem, including SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications.
* Oversee business-critical platforms including Project Management, Collaboration, HRMS, Payroll, ATS, LMS, Telephony, and internally developed applications.
* Evaluate existing technology capabilities and determine whether requirements should be addressed through configuration, integration, automation, AI, or custom software development.
* Drive application lifecycle management, modernization, consolidation, and optimization.
* Lead technology evaluations, vendor selection, RFI/RFP processes, POCs, negotiations, renewals, and vendor performance management.

**Software Development, Integration & Bridge Systems**

* Lead and mentor application and software engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, and supporting business-critical solutions.
* Oversee the complete software lifecycle from requirements and architecture through development, integration, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Define and oversee enterprise integration architecture across applications, including APIs, middleware, data pipelines, SSO, event-driven integrations, and workflow orchestration.
* Identify gaps between existing platforms and oversee the development of bridge applications, middleware, APIs, and integration services to connect disparate systems.
* Ensure new applications and solutions integrate into the broader enterprise ecosystem rather than creating additional technology silos.
* Establish standards for software architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, observability, and maintainability.

**AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, AI agents, LLMs, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration across the existing application ecosystem.
* Use AI to enhance application integration, automate data movement and business processes, and create intelligent interfaces between systems.
* Oversee the development of AI-enabled bridge solutions that can interpret, transform, route, and orchestrate information across multiple applications.
* Evaluate AI solutions alongside conventional integration and automation approaches, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem.
* Establish appropriate governance around AI, data access, security, privacy, and operational reliability.

**IT Infrastructure Strategy & Operations**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, endpoints, cloud services, collaboration platforms, Microsoft 365, identity, and core technology platforms.
* Ensure infrastructure is scalable, resilient, secure, and capable of supporting the organization's application and digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with infrastructure and engineering teams to design and maintain reliable application and infrastructure environments.
* Oversee infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology resilience.
* Ensure infrastructure architecture supports the organization's integration, software, data, and AI initiatives.

**IT Operations, Service Management & Reliability**

* Provide leadership across IT Operations, Service Desk, Application Support, Infrastructure Operations, and technology service management.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and supportability across applications, infrastructure, integrations, and critical technology services.
* Establish and monitor SLAs, operational KPIs, incident management, problem management, change management, release management, and service improvement processes.

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
