**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end ownership of large scale technology programs that focus on secure Azure adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations across all business units and global locations.
* Oversee program planning and roadmap development by defining scope milestones dependencies and resource needs that enable secure and resilient Azure security initiatives across hybrid work environments.
* Guide cross functional teams to integrate Azure security controls into application architectures infrastructure operations and data flows so that business services remain protected and continuously available.
* Coordinate risk assessment activities to identify security gaps within Azure workloads and associated payment services then translate findings into prioritized remediation plans with measurable outcomes.
* Provide direction for establishing program wide security governance structures including policies standards and procedures that embed Azure security practices into everyday operations and decision making.
* Align program deliverables with organizational strategy by ensuring that Azure security investments support long term growth improved customer trust and efficient digital payment experiences.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating program status risks and achievements through concise narratives and dashboards that highlight progress toward secure cloud and payment transformation goals.
* Support development of reusable patterns and reference architectures for Azure security so that project teams can implement consistent controls and reduce time to market for new solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement by analyzing operational metrics incident trends and audit results to refine Azure security capabilities and strengthen resilience of transaction and payment platforms.
* Collaborate with finance and portfolio management partners to optimize program budgets and investment decisions ensuring that Azure security and payment initiatives deliver tangible business value.
* Enable hybrid work effectiveness by promoting secure access models identity controls and collaboration tools that protect program information while supporting flexible working arrangements.
* Mentor senior program managers and technical leads by sharing best practices in strategic leadership Azure security risk management and stakeholder engagement to build strong succession pipelines.
* Advance responsible technology outcomes by ensuring that security design decisions within Azure platforms contribute to safer financial transactions and more trustworthy digital experiences for society.

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Information Technology & Digital

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen. Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
The IT&D SAP Solutions Director is a vital strategic leader bridging the gap between Global Operations (Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement) and the technical SAP ecosystem. This role drives the roadmap for enterprise resource planning, ensuring that the SAP landscape is not just a system of record, but a driver of operational excellence and real-time visibility.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Leading a global team of architects and functional leads, this role leverages S/4HANA, BTP, SAP ECC and integrated AI to streamline the "Core" of the business.
* Defining the multi-year roadmap for SAP migrating from JDE to SAP ECC and to S/4HANA) to ensure scalability and reduced technical debt.
* Identifying opportunities to standardize business processes across global regions to eliminate "shadow IT" and custom-code bloat.
* Exploring Business Technology Platform (BTP) capabilities, including AI-driven forecasting and automated financial closing.
* Architect end to end SAP solutions, ensuring robust integration across core modules (FICO, SD, MM, PP, QM, PM, PS) and connected platforms such as BlackLine, HighRadius, OneSource, Concur, Kinaxis, SAP SAC, HFM & WMS systems.
* Manage global vendors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and offshore delivery teams, driving accountability and adherence to SLAs and quality standards.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 18+ years of experience in building high-quality SAP solutions through disciplined project execution, including estimation, resource planning, scope control, testing strategies, and change management.
* Deep understanding of end to end manufacturing processes including planning, production execution and quality management with proven ability to design and deliver SAP solutions that optimize manufacturing efficiency and operational performance.
* Proven capability to govern system design and configuration, enforce development standards, and minimize technical debt across markets and functions.
* Strong experience collaborating with global process owners and regional teams to deliver compliant global solutions and country-specific localizations.
* Demonstrated success leading end to end S/4HANA migration programs in the role of Solution Architect.
* Proven experience delivering SAP solutions involving Vistex and Trade Promotion Management, ensuring accurate pricing, rebates, incentives, and trade spend governance.
* Deep understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC), and audit requirements within validated or compliance-driven environments.
* Ability to drive performance excellence in BAU operations, Continuous improvements, business enhancements, global business Processes, including monitoring KPIs, managing NPS/SLA adherence, and ensuring 99.9% availability for Platinum-tier systems.

The skills for success
  
  
SAP Solution Design, SAP Implementation, Business Processes, Functional Expertise , Functional Architecture, SAP Digital Transformation, SAP FICO, SAP Supply Chain, S/4 HANA, Migration, Manufacturing process, End to End SAP Implementation
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

===================================================================================

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

**About the Role**
------------------

This role sits within the Corporate Research & Analysis (R&A) team, supporting the International segment and combining portfolio management responsibilities (80%) with people leadership responsibilities (20%).

  

You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of complex corporate and institutional clients, including Group Relationship Point (GRP), Credit Point (CP), and Authorized Point (AP) relationships. The role provides end-to-end exposure across the credit lifecycle, including origination support, risk grading, credit analysis, documentation, portfolio monitoring, and industry research.

  

You will also provide guidance and technical leadership to a team of credit analysts, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, globally consistent, and timely credit outcomes. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management, sound credit judgement, and the ability to balance customer, risk, and business priorities.

  

Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As an Institutional Research & Analysis Associate Director, you will:

  

* Manage a portfolio of complex corporate and institutional clients across multiple industry sectors.
* Support end-to-end credit management activities including origination support, credit analysis, risk grading, documentation, facility monitoring, and portfolio reviews.
* Conduct financial analysis and industry research to identify risks and business opportunities.
* Partner with Relationship Managers, Product Partners, Risk, Legal, and Operations teams to deliver effective credit outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to support customer growth while maintaining alignment with ANZ's risk appetite.
* Provide leadership, coaching, and technical guidance to a team of specialized credit analysts.
* Review and maintain high-quality, globally consistent credit submissions and portfolio management practices.
* Monitor portfolio performance and proactively identify emerging risks and issues.
* Escalate portfolio, credit, and operational issues within required timelines.
* Contribute to credit transformation initiatives, process improvements, testing activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Ensure compliance with internal credit policies, risk frameworks, regulatory requirements, and governance standards.
* Promote a strong risk culture, continuous improvement mindset, and collaborative team environment.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* 10-12+ years of experience in Corporate Banking, Institutional Banking, Credit Analysis, or Portfolio Management.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching and managing high-performing teams.
* Strong credit writing skills with excellent financial analysis and risk assessment capabilities.
* Strong understanding of credit policies, risk frameworks, and end-to-end credit processes.
* Experience managing complex corporate and institutional client portfolios.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across Relationship Management, Risk, Product, Legal, and Operations teams.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and build credibility across stakeholders.
* A growth mindset with the ability to balance risk and reward while driving customer and business outcomes.
* A self-directed and collaborative approach, with demonstrated learning agility and leadership behaviors.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and a commitment to delivering high-quality credit outcomes

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. **Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.

* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*

* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**

* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

jobs.title: Director Development
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**Finastra: Who are we?**

Formed in 2017 by the combination of Misys and D+H, we provide the broadest portfolio of financial services software in the world today—spanning Lending, Payments and Universal Banking businesses.

Our solutions enable customers to deploy mission critical technology on premises or in the cloud. With our scale and geographical reach we drive valued solutions and opportunity for customers regardless of size or geography. Through our open, secure, and reliable solutions, we empower customers to accelerate growth, optimize cost, mitigate risk and continually evolve to meet their changing needs.

  

**Universal Banking business:**

In June 2026, Finastra agreed to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with the sale expected to complete in early 2027. This role is part of the CTO Leadership Team for Universal Banking and will play a critical part in shaping the engineering organization of the new Universal Banking business. You will join Finastra initially and, on completion of the sale, your employment will transfer with the Universal Banking business to its new ownership.

  

**Role Summary**

The Lending Engineering Director is a Grade 9, M4 (Director) leadership role accountable for the engineering of the Universal Banking Lending product line. Managing through others, the Director leads a multi-disciplinary engineering organization of squads and squad leads, and owns end-to-end software delivery, from requirements and design through build, test, release, deployment and production operations, using an agentic AI-first engineering model. Operating independently within business and functional policies, the Director sets engineering direction and allocates resources across programmes and services. As a member of the CTO Leadership Team, the Director partners with Product, GTM and Services, and represents Lending engineering up to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT).

  

**Role Impact**

* **Scope and direction:** Owns the Lending engineering domain and acts independently to set direction and allocate people, budget and capacity across programmes, projects and services.
* **Problem solving and standards:** Resolves complex technical, operational and organizational problems, and recommends standards and operating strategies that mitigate risk and drive growth.
* **Planning and execution:** Develops and executes plans to achieve key Lending business objectives in collaboration with senior management.
* **Influence:** Fosters collaboration across the business, influences more senior colleagues and presents to the management chain up to the ELT when required.
* **Innovation:** Brings forward new ideas, notably in agentic AI engineering, that benefit Universal Banking and Finastra as a whole.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Engineering Strategy and Agentic AI Transformation***

* Define and own the Lending engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with product strategy, architecture and business outcomes, including modernization on Cloud, SaaS, Java and microservices.
* Lead the shift to an agentic AI-first engineering model in which AI agents and engineers work together across the full lifecycle, with clear adoption targets and measurable gains in productivity, quality and cycle time.
* Make and own decisions on resource allocation, investment, tooling and build, buy or partner options, and influence platform and architecture decisions across the CTO organization.

***AI-Enabled End-to-End Software Delivery***

* **Plan:** Use AI agents with Product to refine requirements, generate user stories and acceptance criteria, and improve estimation and backlog prioritization.
* **Design and build:** Apply AI-assisted design reviews, agentic code generation, refactoring, legacy modernization and code review using tools such as GitHub Copilot.
* **Test and secure:** Drive AI-generated test cases, test data and automated regression, with AI-assisted security and vulnerability scanning built into CI/CD (shift-left quality and DevSecOps).
* **Release and deploy:** Own CI/CD pipelines, release readiness, versioning, change approvals and deployment orchestration, including containerized deployments to Kubernetes across cloud and on-premises environments, with a high degree of automation.
* **Document and enable:** Use AI to keep technical documentation, release notes and knowledge bases current for Services, Support and implementation partners.

***SDLC/PMLC and AI Governance***

* Own the SDLC and PMLC for Lending, ensuring rigour, transparency and measurability, in alignment with the Enterprise PMO, Product Strategy and Architecture.
* Establish guardrails for the responsible use of AI agents, including human-in-the-loop review, model and prompt governance, data classification, IP and security controls, and auditability, in line with Finastra policies and regulatory requirements.
* Track delivery, quality and AI-adoption metrics (for example, DORA metrics, defect leakage and AI acceptance rates) and act on trends.

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. jobs.title: Implementation Director
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

jobs.title: Emerging Markets Lead – MENA (Arabic speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
As Column’s Emerging Markets Lead, you will spearhead one of our most strategic international expansion initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving 0-to-1 growth for a new banking product, with a particular focus on building and nurturing relationships with prospective partners and customers in select markets, with a specific focus on markets within MENA. This role combines global expansion strategy, business development with hands-on relationship management, requiring a general business athlete who thrives on networking and executing complex partnerships. This is a unique opportunity to be on the founding team for a new business line, with significant autonomy and direct impact on Column’s global expansion strategy.
  
  
This position will be based in Dubai with regular travel throughout the region and occasional travel to Column’s headquarters in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead regional market development: Own the end-to-end process of identifying, evaluating, and executing on high-value partnerships with banks across a number of international markets.
* Build and maintain key relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for prospective and existing customers, conducting regular in-person meetings, attending local industry events, and managing ongoing partnership development.
* Own partnership execution: Lead complex deal processes from initial outreach through contract signature, working collaboratively with Column’s Legal, Compliance, and Product teams.
* Develop market intelligence: Gather and synthesize insights on local market conditions, regulatory developments, competitive landscape, and customer needs to inform Column’s regional strategy.
* Market expertise and network: Become an expert on the correspondent banking space in our key emerging markets and build an extensive network within their banking and fintech ecosystems.
* Drive operational excellence: Build scalable processes for onboarding, relationship management, and ongoing support that can be replicated as we expand.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 6+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, growth, operations or strategy in a high-caliber environment
* 4+ years of business experience specifically in MENA
* Native fluency in Arabic and experience managing business relationships with Arabic-speaking clients and stakeholders
* Track record of successfully managing complex partnerships and high-value deals with executive stakeholders
* Natural networker who thrives on building trust and long-term relationships with senior executives, market experts and decision-makers
* Strong strategic thinking - ability to assess market opportunities, evaluate potential partners, and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Hyper-organized approach to project management, including coordinating efforts across multiple teams; comfort juggling multiple projects and priorities is critical
* Scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude - we thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa is seeking an experienced payments and public sector business development leader to join the CEMEA Visa Government Solutions team as Director, Government Solutions for UAE, reporting to the Head of Visa Government Solutions for GCC. The role will be responsible for driving Visa Government Solutions growth across the UAE market, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders and partners, and translating public sector priorities into scalable commercial opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Expand and deepen the Visa Government Solutions public sector strategy and commercial pipeline across UAE, developing and maintaining a prioritized portfolio of clients, use cases and solution opportunities.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with key public sector stakeholders across federal and local government entities in UAE, positioning Visa as a trusted partner in payments and digital transformation.
* Identify and engage relevant issuers, program managers, processors, fintechs and FI partners to enable the delivery of Visa Government Solutions to government clients.
* Develop and execute market strategies and account plans to grow revenue, payment volume and market share, while expanding the adoption and visibility of relevant Visa capabilities across government use cases.
* Identify market specific needs, emerging use cases and client requirements, and partner with regional and global solutions teams to help shape proposition and product roadmaps.
* Drive achievement of UAE Visa Government Solutions scorecard metrics and commercial objectives, with clear ownership of pipeline development, execution and business outcomes.
* Maintain close alignment with the UAE Country Manager to ensure Visa Government Solutions priorities and execution are fully aligned with country strategies and broader Visa objectives.
* Create and maintain clear business reporting, pipeline visibility and performance tracking against KPIs and commercial targets, ensuring accountability and timely management of risks and opportunities.
* collaborate with Product, Legal, Solutioning and Government Engagement to coordinate Visa’s approach to government clients and strengthen engagement with key decision makers and stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen Visa’s positioning as a leader in payments and a strategic resource for government entities across UAE.
* Lead and coordinate Visa Government Solutions input into RFPs, proposals and complex commercial opportunities, working across internal teams to ensure high quality responses and effective execution.
* Continuously assess the market and competitive landscape, identify new growth opportunities and recommend creative approaches to expand Visa Government Solutions business across UAE.
* Proactively identify and resolve complex commercial, delivery and stakeholder challenges that may impact government business growth, client relationships or execution.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in government, state owned enterprise or public sector sales and business development, ideally within payments or financial services, with a track record of managing complex opportunities and commercial engagements.
* Strong understanding of how government entities and public sector organizations operate across UAE, including stakeholder dynamics, procurement processes and decision making environments. A strong network across the public sector ecosystem in UAE is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated business development and consultative sales capability, with the ability to translate client needs into compelling propositions, build strong business cases and advance complex opportunities from origination through execution.
* Proven experience engaging senior public sector stakeholders and building trusted, long term relationships across complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a clear focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to negotiate complex commercial agreements while strengthening existing relationships and building new partnerships.
* Proven ability to lead strategic initiatives across cross functional teams, solve complex problems and drive engagements through to completion.
* Knowledge of public sector payments infrastructure and government payment flows is an advantage. Strong collaboration and influencing skills are essential to successfully mobilize cross functional teams and deliver results.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

jobs.title: Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication

**Additional Information**

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.
* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

jobs.title: Intelligent Integration & Transformation Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
The
**Intelligent Integration & Transformation Engineer**
will drive the engineering and modernization of how applications, data, platforms and AI connect across the product lifecycle. The role will
**build and industrialize reusable integration, data and automation capabilities**
across APIs, events, data pipelines and enterprise platforms, while applying
**GenAI, agentic AI and intelligent automation**
to transform end-to-end technology and business workflows.
  
  
The role combines
**hands-on engineering, technical leadership and transformation execution**
, turning emerging technologies and architecture patterns into production-ready capabilities that simplify the technology landscape, accelerate delivery and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Intelligent Integration Engineering-
  
  

* Engineer reusable integration capabilities across APIs, events, messaging, microservices and enterprise platforms.
* Modernize legacy and point-to-point integrations toward API-led, event-driven and loosely coupled architectures.
* Build reusable components, accelerators and implementation patterns that can be adopted across products and engineering teams.
* Enable seamless interoperability across applications, cloud services, data platforms and enterprise technology.

Data & Context Engineering-
  
  

* Engineer scalable patterns for data integration, movement, transformation and consumption across applications and platforms.
* Establish reusable data pipelines, metadata, semantic/context and knowledge integration patterns.
* Enable enterprise data and knowledge to be safely consumed by applications, automation and AI.
* Build the context foundation required for RAG, intelligent workflows and agentic AI use cases.

GenAI & Agentic Engineering-
  
  

* Engineer GenAI and agentic AI solutions that integrate with enterprise applications, APIs, data and workflows.
* Build reusable patterns for RAG, agents, tool/function calling, context management and AI orchestration.
* Move AI capabilities from experimentation into secure, resilient and production-scale implementation.
* Apply AI where it materially simplifies processes, accelerates engineering or improves operational outcomes.

Intelligent Automation & Workflow Transformation-
  
  

* Transform fragmented and manual processes into intelligent end-to-end workflows.
* Combine APIs, events, data, business rules, workflow orchestration and AI agents to automate complex processes across systems.
* Apply intelligent automation across the product lifecycle, from engineering and testing through deployment, operations and support.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate hand-offs, duplicate processing and manual intervention.

Engineering-Led Technology Transformation-
  
  

* Drive modernization of legacy applications, integrations and workflows using cloud-native, data-driven and AI-enabled engineering approaches.
* Translate transformation opportunities into working engineering solutions, rather than stopping at target-state architecture.
* Build proofs of value and accelerators, and then industrialize successful patterns for broader enterprise adoption.
* Simplify technology estates by reducing redundant integrations, platforms and custom implementations.
* Measure transformation through improvements in delivery speed, automation, reuse, reliability and engineering productivity.

Engineering Standards, Resilience & Governance-
  
  

* Establish reusable reference implementations, engineering blueprints and paved-road patterns.
* Embed security, resiliency, observability, scalability, data governance and responsible AI into engineering solutions.
* Ensure intelligent integration capabilities can operate reliably within enterprise control and risk frameworks.
* Promote automation of engineering controls, testing, deployment and operational validation.

Technical Leadership & Adoption-
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical leadership across strategic transformation initiatives.
* Partner with product, engineering, architecture, data, AI, security and platform teams to take solutions from concept through production adoption.
* Mentor engineers and build capability in modern integration, data, automation and AI engineering.
* Influence engineering direction across teams while promoting reuse over reinvention.

**Core Skills & Experience**

* Strong engineering experience in enterprise integration, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, messaging and event-driven architectures.
* Strong understanding of data engineering, pipelines, streaming, metadata and modern enterprise data platforms.
* Practical experience with GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, tool/function calling and AI orchestration.
* Experience engineering workflow automation and cross-platform orchestration.
* Experience with cloud-native engineering and modern platforms such as AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Databricks and API management technologies.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, automated testing, resiliency and engineering controls.
* Ability to convert complex transformation objectives into working, scalable and reusable technology solutions.
* Strong hands-on engineering mindset, complemented by architecture and enterprise-scale thinking.
* Proven ability to lead transformation across multiple engineering teams and technology domains.

**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
