jobs.description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Consultant - Business Analyst is accountable for partnering with Payments Business and Operations teams to elicit, analyze, document, and validate functional and non-functional requirements for payment application upgrades and regulatory initiatives. The role provides subject matter expertise in SWIFT payments, ISO 20022, RTGS, and wire payments to support solution design, project delivery, testing readiness, and operational effectiveness. The job acts as a key liaison between business and technology partners to ensure solutions are delivered seamlessly, compliantly, and in alignment with business objectives.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Requirements Gathering:**

* Design and document end-to-end data flows, Data mapping documents, and data lineage to trace wire payments attributes from source in to central data repository.
* Analyze current and future state processes to ensure requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and suitable for technology implementation.
* Perform Data analysis, reconciliation, and validation to ensure data integrity, and auditability across historical and real-time wire payments stores.
* Partner with solution architects, data engineers, DBA's and QA leads to build scalable data storage, querying and reporting.
* Clarify scope, assumptions, dependencies, and constraints to support efficient project execution and reduce delivery risk.

**Solution Design:**

* Collaborate with Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, developers, and architects to design solutions aligned with business objectives and technical standards.
* Review, and validate solution design documentation to ensure completeness, quality, and alignment with approved scope and requirements.

**Stakeholder Management and Delivery Support:**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners to support effective communication, decision-making, and delivery outcomes.
* Serve as a primary point of contact between business and technology stakeholders for requirements clarification, issue resolution, and delivery coordination.
* Provide regular status updates, risks, issues, and dependency insights to project managers and leadership to support informed decision-making.
* Coordinate with peer technology groups to ensure seamless delivery of changes across dependent systems and teams.

**Testing and Quality Enablement:**

* Support Quality Engineers on Operational Data Store (ODS) initiatives
* Review test scenarios, test cases, test results, and other testing artefacts prior to and during test execution phases to ensure coverage and quality.
* Participate in SIT and UAT support activities, including validation of business scenarios and analysis of defects and gaps.
* Contribute to defect triage discussions and recommend workarounds to support Operations teams in payment processing and settlement activities.
* Perform data analysis using SQL to validate requirements, investigate issues, and support testing activities.

**Compliance and Risk Management:**

* Incorporate regulatory, operational, and control considerations into analysis and solution definition for payments initiatives.
* Identify risks, control gaps, and compliance impacts early in the delivery lifecycle to support effective mitigation.
* Contribute to data governance, metadata, and documentation standards where applicable.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify and implement process enhancements to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of product and platform services.
* Recommend changes to business analysis practices, delivery processes, and documentation standards to enhance quality and consistency.
* Stay current on industry best practices, regulatory updates, and developments in the data warehousing payments landscape to inform solution design and delivery.
* Monitor changes to business processes and systems to ensure downstream data and reporting impacts are identified

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* This job works closely with Payments Business and Operations teams to elicit requirements, clarify process impacts, and validate business outcomes.
* This job collaborates with project managers to provide status updates, requirement insights, risk assessments, and delivery support.
* This job partners with developers, architects, and peer technology groups to translate requirements into effective technology solutions and ensure seamless implementation.
* This job interacts with Vendor Product SMEs to understand product capabilities, regulatory changes, and implementation considerations.
* This job supports Quality Engineering teams by providing subject matter expertise, reviewing testing artefacts, and helping resolve requirement gaps and defects.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Supports data warehouse (ODS) initiatives across Enterprise Payments Technology.
* Provides specialized business analysis expertise for data processed from the wire engine and wire room applications
* Acts as a primary liaison between Business, Operations, Quality Engineering, and Technology partners for assigned projects and enhancements.
* Contributes to delivery of regulatory and operational changes mandated by SWIFT and/or Payments Canada.
* Provides advisory and support services

We are seeking a
**Senior Solution Architect**
to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer-facing, consulting-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Lead pre-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through implementation oversight.

2. Design end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.

3. Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake,

on-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.

4. Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features.

5. Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production-grade ETL with

built-in data quality and lineage.

6. Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources.

7. Serverless Compute (SQL warehouses, jobs, notebooks) for cost and operational efficiency.

8. Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine-grained access control.

9. Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion

10. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

11. Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader

12. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

13. MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads

14. Conduct architecture deep-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modelling roadmaps, runbooks and executive presentations.

15. Produce Client ready deliverables. HLD / LLD documents, reference architecture, migration road maps, runbook and execution presentations

16. Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.

17. Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.

18. Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.

**Qualifications**

• 8+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3+ years hands-on on Databricks in a customer-facing or consulting capacity.

• Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large- scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end to end.

• Strong, fundamentals-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

• Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z- order, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vector, Predictive Optimization)

• Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.

• Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, stor age credentials).

• Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.

• Handson experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Conn ect, and Serverless workloads in production.

• Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance fra meworks.

• Strong SQL and PySpark skills; comfort reading and reasoning about Spark execution plans.

• Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP

including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills able to engage equally with engineers and C- suite.

• Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.

**Required Skills**

• Databricks certifications: Certified Data Engineer Professional, Certified Machine Learning Pr ofessional, or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect Professional.

• Experience with DR architectures (Delta Deep Clone, cross-region replication, RPO/RTO design).

• Exposure to MLOps / GenAI patterns on Databricks (MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Mosaic AI Agent Framework)

• Familiarity with legacy ETL/ELT platforms (Informatica, ODI, SAS DI, DataStage, Talend) for migration credibility.

• Experience with Terraform / Databricks Asset Bundles for IaC and CI/CD.

jobs.title: Associate - Cash Apps
jobs.description:
**At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

  

**We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy**

  

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.

 **Job Description**

**Job Title: Medical Writer – CDMA**

**Department:** Medical Affairs / Scientific Communications  
**Education:** MBBS / BDS / PhD / Master’s in Pharmacy or a related field  
**Scope:** Global

**Role Objective / Purpose**

* To develop high-quality scientific content and documentation across therapeutic areas by conducting in-depth literature reviews, synthesizing data, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials.
* The role involves contributing to both short- and long-term projects in the consumer healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors, including medical, safety, pre-clinical, clinical, regulatory, educational, and promotional content.
* Additional responsibilities include editing, proofreading, reviewing, referencing, and verifying content to ensure adherence to high medical writing standards.
* The role ensures timely delivery of project milestones while maintaining quality, compliance, and business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Literature Reviews and Evidence Mapping**

* Conduct comprehensive secondary research/literature reviews and prepare overarching summaries using effective search strategies across scientific databases (e.g., PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library) and open-source platforms.
* Analyze and interpret clinical and scientific data to extract actionable insights.
* Stay current with trends, treatment guidelines, and regulatory updates in both OTC and Rx domains.

**Medical and Scientific Content Development**

* Leverage scientific expertise to create high-quality communication materials in the OTC and Rx space.
* Research, write, edit, organize, interpret, curate, and quality-check various types of scientific content across multiple formats and channels.
* Prepare, review, and edit a range of scientific documents, including:
  + Literature reviews
  + Manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
  + Abstracts, posters, and slide decks for scientific conferences
  + Treatment guideline summaries
  + Publication summaries and white papers
* Ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and compliance with applicable guidelines (e.g., ICMJE, CONSORT).

**Content Review and Quality Assurance**

* Review medical, promotional, and scientific materials in accordance with internal SOPs and external guidelines.
* Verify references and ensure content is plagiarism-free.
* Ensure clear, factual, and effective presentation of data and discussions.
* Maintain and apply templates, formats, and styles to ensure compliance with industry and client standards.

**Project Execution**

* Understand and define client requirements during project initiation, including objectives and timelines.
* Develop scientifically accurate and medically relevant content across therapeutic areas, adhering to branding and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring quality and client satisfaction.
* Respond to and deliver ad-hoc client requests within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with medical writing colleagues, the graphics team, and clients as needed.

**Other Responsibilities**

* **Mentorship:** Actively mentor team members to support effective task execution and goal achievement.
* **Values and Behaviors:** Consistently demonstrate WNS values and foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Personal Development:** Identify learning and development needs in collaboration with the line manager and pursue relevant training opportunities.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Process-Related**

* **Domain Expertise:** Quickly build subject matter expertise in assigned therapeutic areas.
* **Efficiency:** Develop effective search strategies, organize data for analysis, and prepare medical and scientific content.
* **Accuracy:** Validate sources, identify data gaps, and ensure scientific rigor.
* **Quality:** Deliver well-structured, grammatically sound, and visually engaging documents using appropriate templates and tone.

**People-Related**

* Demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and professionalism.
* Actively participate in team meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and training initiatives.

**Required Competencies & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, OTC, and consumer healthcare landscape.
* Clear grasp of medical, scientific, and statistical terminology and concepts.
* Robust knowledge of various types of clinical studies, the structure, and formats of different manuscript types (e.g., SLR, TLR, Meta-analysis), along with their relevance and application in evidence synthesis and utilization.
* Proven experience in scientific writing and literature analysis.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and online research tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking abilities, and the capacity to work independently.
* Demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and effective time management.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with regulatory documentation and compliance in US/EU markets.
* Exposure to text mining, data visualization tools, and scientific storytelling.
* Experience with reference management (e.g., EndNote, Zotero, Mendeley) and statistical (e.g., RevMan, SPSS, GraphPad Prism, R, SAS) tools.
* Knowledge of proprietary tools such as DataVision, PubPro, and Veeva Vault.

  
**Qualifications**

• BDS/ MDS/PhD with 6-8 years’ experience• Understanding of any specialty area of medicine (preferred Oral health) or an overall understanding of the medical field.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

The primary purpose of an SAP HR / SAP Human Capital Management for SAP S/4HANA (H4S4) Consultant is to design, implement, and maintain a modernized, on-premise or private cloud core HR and payroll transition solution that bridges legacy SAP ERP HCM systems to the next-generation SAP S/4HANA architecture. They act as the bridge between business HR, payroll, and compliance requirements and technical execution within the SAP H4S4 and SuccessFactors ecosystem.

  

Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high-level design documents to implement identified components. Ensure implemented components are documented appropriately, unit tested, and ready for integration into the final product. Present/demonstrate implemented product features through playback sessions and system walkthroughs as required. Provide fixes to defects identified during pre-production and post-production phases in the software development life cycle. Provide work estimates for assigned development work. Guide and explain features, functional objectives, or technologies that are being built to interested parties.

  

Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization—experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build, and optimize enterprise core HR and payroll foundations while modernizing legacy HCM systems to seamlessly transition into next-generation S/4HANA and cloud architectures.

  

**What you will do**

* **Lead Solution Design & Workshops:** Drive requirements-gathering workshops, conduct fit-gap analyses against standard SAP H4S4 and SuccessFactors functionalities, author configuration workbooks, and document business processes and approval workflows.
* **Configure Core HR & Master Data:** Configure and maintain Personnel Administration (PA) and Organizational Management (OM) structures, employee infotypes, hiring/termination actions, and global/local assignments.
* **Manage Time & Payroll Processing:** Design and troubleshoot work schedules, shift planning, absence/attendance recording, and time evaluation rules, while overseeing country- or region-specific payroll runs, wage types, off-cycle workbenches, Payroll Control Centers, and statutory tax/benefit compliance.
* **Enable S/4HANA, Fiori & Talent Modules:** Implement role-based SAP Fiori apps, Employee/Manager Self-Service (ESS/MSS) portals, and SuccessFactors prototypes, while supporting qualification matching, compensation management, learning solutions, and succession planning within H4S4.
* **Execute System Migrations & Data Conversion:** Lead brownfield, greenfield, or selective data transitions from legacy SAP ERP HCM (EhP) systems to H4S4, managing extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) using tools such as LSMW, BDC, or MDG.
* **Build HR Reporting & Analytics:** Develop custom and standard SAP queries, HR Information Systems (HIS), and analytical Fiori dashboards leveraging HANA views.
* **Drive Testing, Cutover & Hypercare:** Author functional specifications, build test scripts, execute unit, SIT, and UAT cycles, manage defect resolution, coordinate cutover planning, and provide post-go-live hypercare and application maintenance support.
* **Deliver Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:** Draft configuration guides and process flows, train key business end-users, and conduct knowledge transfer with developers, project managers, and onshore/offshore teams.

You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on functional experience in SAP HR/HCM, SAP ERP, or SAP SuccessFactors, including full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or migrations.
* At least 3–5 years of experience operating specifically in a senior consultant, technical lead, solution designer, or architectural leadership role.
* Deep functional mastery of Core HR (Personnel Administration and Organizational Management), Personnel Time Management, and regional Payroll processing (wage types, Payroll Control Center, and statutory compliance).
* Hands-on experience executing legacy SAP ERP HCM (EhP) upgrades and transitions to SAP H4S4 deployment models.
* Strong proficiency in SAP Fiori role-based HR applications, ESS/MSS portals, HR Information Systems (HIS), and HANA-based analytical reporting.
Proven track record authoring functional specifications, managing ETL/data migrations (LSMW, BDC, MDG), and leading SIT, UAT, cutover, and hypercare phases across the full project lifecycle.  

  

**Preferred skills and experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Hybrid Cloud & Talent Integration:** Practical experience prototyping, configuring, and integrating SAP SuccessFactors modules with on-premise/private cloud H4S4 environments.
* **Professional Certifications:** Relevant SAP certifications in SAP HCM, SAP S/4HANA (H4S4), or SAP SuccessFactors.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

An SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO) acts as the central connective tissue of an enterprise’s IT ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining seamless end-to-end data flows and process integrations between SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C/4HANA, Ariba) and non-SAP cloud or on-premise applications.

With your vast knowledge of SAP and industry, you assist top-tier clients in their SAP digital transformation efforts. Your role entails providing guidance and executing SAP digital transformation initiatives. You also conceptualize, create, improve and optimize solutions using SAP development tools and platforms. Additionally, you work alongside global teams and partners across various functions to deliver solutions. You define and update solution and technology roadmaps, and architecture documents.

  

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput interfaces running on SAP Process Orchestration (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Concurrently, you will lead the refactoring and modernization of legacy interfaces to modern APIs, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns, enabling seamless data flow between core SAP S/4HANA systems and broader cloud or third-party enterprise platforms.

  

Lead enterprise integration assessments, interface architecture, and migration of legacy middleware to modern cloud integration platforms. Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective integration solutions. Own interface development from design through implementation and transition to operations, balancing long-term integration strategy with day-to-day stability, maintainability, and business continuity.

  

Professionals in this role author and leverage detailed technical design documentation, mapping specifications, and interface runbooks to build robust data flows across hybrid landscapes. Ensure all integration components are thoroughly documented, rigorously unit-tested, and validated for seamless end-to-end processing across connected systems. Lead interface walkthroughs and playback demonstrations with functional teams and client stakeholders. Triage, isolate, and remediate integration defects during pre-production testing cycles, cutovers, and hypercare support. Provide precise development effort estimates and guide project teams on integration patterns, BTP capabilities, and technical trade-offs.

  

Bring your deep integration engineering background to an organization modernizing enterprise application ecosystems, playing a central role in connecting critical business processes. You will collaborate alongside a global community of SAP and cloud specialists driving the future of hybrid connectivity—professionals who value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and open collaboration.

  

**What you will do**

* **Integration & Modernization Strategy:** Lead discovery and assessment of legacy PI/PO landscapes, evaluate interface technical debt, and build migration roadmaps to transition workloads toward SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Architecture & Interface Governance:** Establish enterprise integration guidelines, select optimal communication patterns (hub-and-spoke, API-led, event-driven), enforce error-handling standards, and ensure interface compliance with corporate security mandates.
* **Cloud & Hybrid Integration:** Architect, develop, and tune end-to-end integration flows across SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors, Event Mesh).
* **Core SAP & Third-Party Connectivity:** Build and support mission-critical interfaces linking SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and C/4HANA with third-party SaaS and on-premise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).
* **Protocol, Mapping & Security Management:** Implement data transformations using Groovy Script, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping; configure enterprise security standards including OAuth 2.0, SAML, Principal Propagation, SSL/TLS, and Keystore management.
* **Technical Leadership & Delivery:** Lead client design workshops, conduct code and mapping reviews, manage cutover/go-live risks, mentor junior developers, and coordinate interface testing between functional consultants and external partner counterparts.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a structured pathway to expand your career, from Integration Consultant to Principal Integration Architect. We provide unique opportunities to engage with hybrid architectures and hyperscaler-connected ecosystems, paired with dedicated learning resources and support to achieve professional certifications across modern SAP and cloud platforms.

You will partner with top-tier clients across a wide range of industries—from banking and retail to manufacturing and healthcare. Whether your ambition is to deepen your focus on enterprise iPaaS architectures or broaden your leadership across complex multi-cloud digital transformations, you can build that trajectory here. You will contribute to critical business initiatives, influence technology roadmaps, and cultivate relationships with diverse technical communities while mastering modern integration practices.

**Who You Are**

You bring seasoned hands-on technical proficiency in SAP integration and possess the delivery track record to back it up. Equally critical: you possess a continuous learning mindset, an analytical approach to solving complex interface issues, and a customer-first focus dedicated to operational resilience. You thrive in open, globally distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8–10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP integration engineering, middleware architecture, and interface delivery.
* **4+ years** of dedicated design and development experience on **SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)** .
* Proven track record in full-lifecycle **SAP PI (7.3/7.4) and PO (7.5)** implementations, dual-stack/single-stack administration awareness, and interface remediation.
* Solid experience delivering integration architecture for **SAP S/4HANA implementation and roll-in projects** , including legacy-to-cloud migrations.
* Deep proficiency in advanced mapping techniques: **Groovy Scripting, XSLT, Graphical Mapping, Value Mapping, and Custom Functions** .
* Comprehensive expertise across standard integration protocols and data structures: **OData (V2/V4), REST, SOAP/WSDL, IDoc, RFC, EDI/EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, AMQP, JSON, and XML** .
* Strong grasp of BTP platform connectivity, including **SAP Cloud Connector** , Destination Services, Cloud Integration Automation Framework, and multi-tenant subaccount structures.
* Solid background in integration security: certificate and key lifecycle management, **OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, mutual TLS, and Principal Propagation** .

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Hands-on implementation experience with **SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh, and SAP Integration Advisor** .
* Familiarity with non-SAP enterprise ecosystems and SaaS platforms such as **Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, and hyperscaler services (AWS, Azure, GCP)** .
* Experience establishing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated interface

jobs.title: ASIC CAD Technical Leader (9-15 Years| Bangalore)
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco’s Silicon One Optics Group (S1O) designs& delivers the high-speed optical transceivers, and platforms that power Cisco's core data center networking solutions. We specialize in the design and integration of cutting-edge IM/DD optics and silicon photonic platforms that enable customers to deploy industry-leading optical technologies within data center with unprecedented speed, capacity, and reliability. Come join us and take part in shaping S1O’s ground-breaking optical solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most advanced pluggable, Near Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-packaged Optics (CPO) being developed in the industry.
  
You will drive the India CAD operations working closely with the US CAD team to build the methodologies and tools that enable complex products. Because we work across the full product lifecycle, we have a unique opportunity to influence architecture, establish design methodologies early, automate repetitive engineering processes, and drive predictable design closure. A significant new focus for this role is the deployment of AI tools, when possible, to enhance productivity, quality, and development cycle times.
  
We value technical depth, innovation, ownership, and collaboration. Join us to build the CAD infrastructure and methodologies that will power the future of optical connectivity and high-performance computing.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a CAD Engineering Leader, you will drive the development and deployment of design automation and EDA infrastructure supporting next-generation silicon photonics and optical networking products. You will work across architecture, RTL, physical design, DFT, verification, packaging, and silicon design teams to establish scalable methodologies that enable first-pass design success and predictable full-chip closure.
  
You will provide technical leadership in design methodology and CAD automation while driving improvements in design quality, productivity, and time-to-market across multiple silicon programs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
In addition to providing technical leadership, you will be responsible for:
  
EDA Vendor Engagement
  
  

* Serve as a primary technical contact for EDA vendors, working directly with application engineers to resolve tool issues and escalate blocking defects.
* File, track, and drive bug reports and feature requests to closure, maintaining visibility of open items with internal stakeholders.
* Evaluate and benchmark new tool releases, assessing runtime, accuracy, capacity, and regression risk before deployment.
* Qualify tool and flow readiness for new process nodes in coordination with vendors and foundry partners.
* Participate in vendor roadmap reviews and early-adopter or beta programs to influence future tool capabilities.
* Support license and tool-access planning with vendors to align capacity with project demand.

Design Team Support and Enablement
  
  

* Act as a front-line technical resource for design and layout teams, providing hands-on debug support for tool and flow issues.
* Author and maintain clear flow documentation, quick-start guides, and best-known methods for supported toolsets.
* Develop and deliver training sessions and onboarding materials to accelerate adoption of new tools and flows.
* Drive adoption of AI tools to enhance productivity, quality, and development speed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams — design, CAD, and IT — to keep the design environment stable and productive.

CAD Infrastructure and Automation
  
  

* Lead the development of reusable automation and design infrastructure across product generations to improve design quality, productivity, and consistency.
* Lead cross-functional technical initiatives, resolve complex design-flow issues, and communicate methodology and execution risks to senior engineering leadership.

Minimum Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 10+ years of ASIC, CAD, EDA, or semiconductor design experience, or Master's degree with 8+ years, or PhD with 5+ years.
* Demonstrated experience leading CAD, design methodology, or ASIC design-flow initiatives.
* Deep understanding of device modeling, analog design, and layout.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Pegasus, Quantus, Innovus, Genus, Siemens Calibre or equivalent technologies.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Tcl, Perl, or equivalent languages.
* Fluency in Linux, including shell usage, scripting, and general system navigation.
* Experience with job scheduling and workload management systems such as LSF, SGE, or similar, including job submission, resource allocation, and batch job debugging.
* Experience with design management and design management tools such as Keysight SOS, IC Manage and DesignSync.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical projects across multiple engineering organizations.

Preferred Qualification
  
  

* Experience leading CAD/EDA methodology teams or serving as a technical lead for silicon design infrastructure.
* Experience developing automated CAD infrastructure, flow orchestration, design-quality dashboards, and methodology qualification frameworks.
* Experience with Agentic-AI Mixed-Signal ASIC flow development
* Experience partnering with EDA vendors and defining tool, flow, and methodology requirements.
* Proven track record of mentoring engineers, influencing architecture, and driving organizational adoption of new methodologies.

Why Cisco?
  
  
WE ARE CISCO, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference. Here’s how we do it.
  
We embrace digital and help our customers implement change in their digital businesses. Some may think we’re “old” (30 years strong!) and only about hardware, but we’re also a software company. And a security company. A blockchain company. An AI/Machine Learning company. We even invented an intuitive network that adapts, predicts, learns and protects. No other company can do what we do – you can’t put us in a box!
  
But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.)
  
Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, we give our egos a break and we give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, we take bold steps, and we take difference to heart. Because without diversity of thought and a commitment to equality for all, there is no moving forward.
  
So, you have colorful hair? Don’t care. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That’s cool.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Fimple is a product company building a cloud-native, highly composable and extendible platform. It covers the full platform needs of digital, disruptive and new financial players who need to move fast. Our solution is modern, API-native and built around an ecosystem with strong marketplace support, so financial institutions can grow in a fast-changing market.
  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Fimple Delivery team in Dubai, UAE. Your main goal will be to set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, first during the implementation and then as the bank’s needs grow after go-live. You will be Fimple’s face to the bank’s business teams: working closely with them to understand their business needs, set up the platform to match their banking products and processes, and help them go live successfully.
  
  
You don’t need to know everything on day one. Working closely with and be supported by Fimple’s core banking experts, and learning our platform and Islamic banking products on the job.
  
  
We are not looking for a traditional core banking implementer. We are looking for agile, open-minded people who are curious to learn and improve, don’t just repeat old methods, and always look for a better, faster way to get things done. You should use AI tools in your daily work and turn complex banking needs into simple, practical solutions.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Open to innovation: you enjoy new technologies and new ways of working, and you don’t cling to old methods
* AI-savvy: you already use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to analyze requirements, write documents, prepare test scenarios, investigate issues and speed up your work
* Solution-oriented: you focus on solving the problem, not on listing obstacles
* Flexible and practical: you adapt quickly when priorities change and look for the simplest solution that works, not the most complicated one
* Ownership mindset: you take responsibility and carry things through to the end
* Fast learner: you pick up new products, domains and tools quickly

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, both during the implementation and after go-live
* Act as the day-to-day contact for the bank’s business teams and Fimple’s face to the bank
* Take part in end-to-end core banking implementation projects, from requirement gathering to go-live and post-go-live support
* Run workshops with clients to understand their banking products, business processes and regulatory needs
* Perform gap analysis between client requirements and Fimple platform capabilities, and suggest practical solutions
* Configure and set up banking products and parameters on the platform, such as Islamic financing and deposit products, customer onboarding, limits, fees and charges, and accounting rules
* Use AI-powered tools and automation to speed up analysis, documentation, testing and issue resolution
* Write clear, concise functional documents, including business requirements, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and process flows
* Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT phases with clients
* Work with Fimple’s product, development and QA teams to deliver solutions and handle change requests
* Train client users and create user guides
* Analyze and troubleshoot functional issues during implementation and after go-live
* Suggest improvements to our delivery processes and help build a faster, smarter way of implementing core banking

**Qualifications**

* Fluent English– must
* Arabic – strong plus
* Turkish – plus
* Must be currently living in Dubai, UAE or willing to relocate
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Banking, or a related discipline
* 3+ years of experience in banking, in banking operations, core banking, loan, trade finance or treasury implementation functional consulting or business analysis
* Solid knowledge of banking business processes, such as retail and/or corporate banking, deposits, lending, payments, general ledger, accounting, customer lifecycle, Trade Finance and Treasury.
* Understanding of how banking systems work, including products, parameters, end-of-day processes and integrations
* Core banking business knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more core banking systems is a must
* Previous Experience in implementing core banking solutions in GCC is a must
* Experience with Islamic banking products is must
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work
* Examples of how you used AI or automation to improve a process or save time
* Basic technical skills: reading APIs (REST/JSON), writing SQL queries, understanding system integrations
* Experience with Agile delivery and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to turn business needs into clear functional requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with a client-focused approach
* No travel restrictions; willing to travel when needed

**Why Join Us**

* Work on modern, cloud-native Islamic core banking implementations in UAE
* Be part of a team that uses AI in daily delivery work
* Freedom to bring new ideas and shape how core banking is implemented
* Be part of Fimple’s international team with growth opportunities across the region
* Hybrid working model
* A growth mindset culture where challenges are learning opportunities

Job Details
  
  
Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://fimple.co.uk/ Job Function: Engineering Company Industry/

* Establish security frameworks based on NIST, ISO 27001, and industry best practices.

**Cloud And API Integration**

* Architect cloud-native, highly available, scalable, and resilient digital asset platforms.
* Define end-to-end infrastructure architecture covering HA, DR, performance, security, and elimination of single points of failure.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance.
  
  

* Ensure compliance with CBUAE regulations, AML/KYC requirements, and applicable international digital asset standards.

Operations & Vendor Management.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or related field.

jobs.title: Manager, IT Business Analysis (UAE National)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Manager, IT Business Analysis turns business needs into well-defined digital solutions across EDB’s priority programmes. Working with Business, IT and enterprise functions such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and HR, the role leads business analysis from discovery to Go-Live with a product owner mindset: framing work around customer and business outcomes, crafting end-to-end digital journeys and prioritizing what delivers the most value. It works within EDB’s change-governance standards, reports against agreed metrics and raises risks, issues and blockers early. In line with EDB’s agentic-AI-based delivery model, it uses AI to produce requirements, workflows and indicative UI wireframes, and sets the standard for business analysis across the bank.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Business Analysis Responsibilities:**

* Lead business analysis on assigned programmes from discovery to Go-Live: elicit and analyze requirements through workshops and interviews, and produce BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Work iteratively with the business – draft early, review while gathering requirements, refine to sign-off – and stay engaged through design, build, SIT, UAT and Go-Live rather than handing over at sign-off.
* Map as-is and to-be processes; identify bottlenecks, control gaps and manual effort; and recommend simplification, automation and straight-through processing.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business objective to requirement, design, test case and defect; review vendor specifications and test coverage; and support SIT, UAT and business sign-off.
* Work across Business, IT and enterprise functions – Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Operations, HR and Audit – to align requirements and secure timely decisions and sign-offs

**Product Ownership Responsibilities:**

* Bring a product owner mindset to every initiative: frame it around the customer and business outcome, the problem it solves and how its value will be measured.
* Craft end-to-end digital journeys for customers, Relationship Managers and operations teams – mapping today’s pain points and designing target journeys that remove manual steps, handoffs and re-keying.
* Shape scope into MVPs and phased releases, write epics and user stories, and own and prioritise backlogs with business owners on value, risk, regulatory need and effort.
* Define journey success measures such as turnaround time, straight-through-processing rate and adoption, and track them after Go-Live.

**AI-Assisted Delivery Responsibilities:**

* Use EDB-approved AI tools to accelerate the drafting of requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios, verifying and owning every output.
* Build AI-assisted workflows, BPMN process flows and indicative UI wireframes that let the business picture the end result early, and iterate them with stakeholders before build.
* Apply responsible-AI practice: approved tools only, data kept within approved boundaries, and human review and sign-off before any AI-drafted content is final.
* Contribute reusable prompts, templates and agent workflows to EDB’s agentic-AI delivery model.

**Governance, Reporting and Risk Responsibilities**

* Adhere to EDB’s change-governance standards – stage gates, change control, approvals and documentation – and apply BA and project management principles consistently across programmes.
* Manage requirement changes, decisions and dependencies through formal change control, and ensure solutions meet regulatory, compliance, risk, control and audit requirements.
* Provide regular, structured status reporting and track delivery and BA metrics – requirements progress, sign-offs, change volumes, defect trends and benefits – for programme leadership.
* Highlight risks, issues and blockers early, before they become serious, with their impact and a recommended mitigation, and escalate them through the right forums.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About VISO TRUST**

VISO TRUST is an AI-powered third-party risk management (TPRM) platform used by more than 100 enterprise customers. Our AI agents collect and analyze vendor security evidence, so customers get fast, accurate risk assessments without questionnaires. Our Managed Services team of security auditors reviews assessments for customers who want expert human review. VISO TRUST is part of Protecht, a global risk management software company.

**About the Role**

You will lead our India-based Managed Services team. You own delivery quality, turnaround, capacity and hiring for a team of auditors and analysts, led through a team manager who reports to you. You are also the senior face of Managed Services to customers, and you work with Sales and Customer Success to grow and retain those accounts.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Managed Services team through its manager: set goals, coach, review performance and build the next layer of leaders.
* Own delivery: assessment quality, time in review, auditor productivity and SLA adherence.
* Run capacity planning: forecast assessment volume, plan staffing and flag constraints early.
* Hire: define roles, run hiring and onboard new auditors to our methodology and platform.
* Improve how the work gets done: refine review standards and QA, and partner with Product and Engineering to feed auditor insight into our AI agents and evaluation process.
* Work with customers: lead service reviews, handle escalations and explain our methodology to security and risk teams.
* Support growth: join sales and renewal conversations to scope, price and position Managed Services alongside Sales and Customer Success.
* Report on team performance, utilization and customer outcomes to leadership.

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years in information security, IT audit or third-party risk, including 4+ years managing teams and at least one role leading managers.
* Hands-on knowledge of vendor security assessments: SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001, penetration test reports and security policies.
* Experience delivering for US or global enterprise clients in a managed service, consulting or audit setting. Big Four experience is a plus.
* A track record of capacity planning and hiring for a delivery team.
* Confidence in client-facing conversations, including escalations and commercial discussions.
* Clear, concise written and spoken English.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CTPRP or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are preferred.

**Working Arrangement**

This is a fully remote role on mostly standard India business hours. It also requires a few hours a week in the evening (IST) to overlap with US-based customers and colleagues.

**Why VISO**

* Competitive fixed salary plus performance-based variable pay
* Employment through our global employer partner, with statutory benefits including PF and gratuity
* A fully remote team, with flexibility on evenings when you join US calls
* The chance to shape how AI and human expertise work together in TPRM, inside a growing global risk software company

VISO TRUST is now part of the Protecht Group, a global leader in risk management solutions. Together, we provide a comprehensive platform for managing risk across the enterprise, helping organizations move faster while maintaining strong security and regulatory standards.

**Description**
*Great People Work Here.*
BizTX: Co-Creating WOW Through Digital Innovation
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be part of BizTX at Twinings Ovaltine. At the heart of this iconic brand, we’re on a mission to drive exponential growth and productivity through cutting-edge technology to transform the business globally.
  
  
We’re not here to simply provide IT services. We’re technology leaders and strategic partners, co-creating innovative solutions that help the business run, grow, and transform. Everything we do is guided by our commitment to ‘WOW’ our consumers, customers and colleagues. WOW experiences, WOW solutions, and WOW impact.
  
  
Our people think differently. We have an exponential mindset that helps us push boundaries and shape what’s next. The future at Twinings Ovaltine is full of possibility and we’d love you to be a part of it.
  
**Role Purpose:**
To create one clear infrastructure roadmap across cloud and hosting, networks, workplace, site and manufacturing technology, resilience and automation as well as roadmap into a prioritised, funded programme of projects and lead delivery from business case and initiation through execution, go-live, benefits realisation and transition to operations.
  
**Scope:**
Global infrastructure strategy, standards, operational performance, site infrastructure and end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure project portfolio.
  
  
**Travel:**
Occasional international travel required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the Global Infrastructure Strategy and Roadmap, aligned to business priorities and the BizTX technology strategy.
* Own the end-to-end global infrastructure project portfolio, including demand intake, prioritisation, business cases, funding, resource planning, delivery governance and benefits realisation.
* Translate the roadmap into a sequenced annual and multi-year project plan covering cloud, hosting, networks, workplace, sites, manufacturing and operational technology (OT), resilience, lifecycle and automation.
* Ensure every project has clear sponsorship, accountable project leadership, scope, outcomes, architecture, budget, resources, milestones, dependencies, risks and stage-gate approvals.
* Lead infrastructure portfolio reviews and provide concise executive reporting on project health, budget, schedule, risks, decisions, capacity and benefits.
* Hold direct accountability for infrastructure operations, lifecycle, resilience, investment planning and project delivery across UK and India sites.

* Remotely lead the UK site infrastructure agenda from India through a structured operating cadence covering service performance, site risks, lifecycle, investment and project delivery, supported by effective UK on-site capability and targeted travel when required.
* Provide functional leadership to site infrastructure leads in all other geographies. Local leads retain direct reporting to geography leadership but take functional direction from this role on infrastructure strategy, standards, architecture and governance.
* Define and drive global infrastructure standards and guardrails across network, hosting and cloud, workplace, meeting rooms, site and manufacturing operational technology (OT) infrastructure, resilience, monitoring, lifecycle and automation.
* Monitor adoption of global standards, govern justified exceptions, identify technical debt and agree remediation plans with geography and site leadership.
* Ensure local infrastructure investments and projects align to the global roadmap and architecture, avoiding unnecessary local variation while accommodating justified regulatory, manufacturing or business needs.
* Provide senior accountability for the capacity, availability, recoverability and performance of the global infrastructure estate, including proportionate disaster-recovery testing for critical services.
* Own infrastructure operating expenditure (Opex) and capital expenditure (Capex) planning, forecasting, investment cases, project financial control and benefits realisation.
* Build an automation-first capability using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated provisioning, patching, monitoring, recovery validation and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Build a connected global infrastructure community across directly managed and dotted-line teams, developing engineering, commercial, programme and delivery capability.

* 10+ years in enterprise infrastructure, including significant leadership responsibility in a complex, multi-site or global organisation.
* Proven ownership of a multi-year infrastructure strategy, investment roadmap and complex transformation portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid hosting, enterprise networks, workplace and site infrastructure, observability, resilience and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing significant operating expenditure (Opex) and capital expenditure (Capex) budgets and strategic suppliers or shared-service organisations.
* Commercial strength, with the ability to translate technical complexity and risk into clear investment and sourcing decisions.
* Credibility with senior leaders and the ability to lead globally through influence, matrix relationships and partners.
* Proven ability to lead geographically distributed teams remotely, combining direct line management with functional leadership through a matrix operating model.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including concise executive reporting.
* Experience of infrastructure in manufacturing and operational technology (OT) environments.

* ITIL 4, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent practical experience.

* Background in consumer goods, FMCG or manufacturing.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

**Head of Project Delivery**

A particularly important aspect of the position is experience in setting up, mobilising and overseeing Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) / Joint Ventures (JVs) for major infrastructure or energy projects. The role will work closely with SPV CEOs, Project Directors, JV partners, EPC contractors, lenders and other key stakeholders.

* Support projects during earlier development/investment stages by providing practical input on constructability, execution strategy, resources, risk, contracting and delivery timelines.

Qualifications;

* **10+ years' project management / project delivery experience**
  , ideally within renewable energy, power, utilities or major infrastructure.
* **Strong construction experience is essential**
  , with proven responsibility for major projects during the execution/construction phase.
* Demonstrable experience
  **setting up and mobilising project SPVs/JVs**
  , not simply working within an already established SPV.

  **Master's/MBA and PMP are advantageous**
  .
