We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help.*
**About Capco**
Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.
  
  
**We Are**

* Experts in capital markets, banking and payments, insurance and wealth and asset management
* Deep knowledge in financial services offering, including e.g. Finance, Risk and Compliance, Financial Crime, Resilience etc.
* Committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent to help us get there
* Focus on maintaining our nimble, agile and entrepreneurial culture

**Role Description**
We are looking to recruit Financial Crime, Sanctions and Fraud transformation candidates across different senior levels into our growing Financial Crime, Risk, Regulation and Finance capability.
  
  
**Requirements**
Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives. This would range across:
  
  

* Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews.
* Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients.
* Analysing our clients’ capabilities and finding opportunities to save costs and improve risk management through innovation within existing anti-financial crime and anti-fraud functions
* Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements.
* Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts).
* Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud.

**Skills & Expertise**

* A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence.
* Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI
* Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD),
* Fraud (detection, prevention, response)
* Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes

This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.
  
  

* This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.
* An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry.
* Proven expertise delivering change and lead transformation programmes
* Self-starter and strong team player.
* Strong interpersonal & written communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set.
* Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships.
* To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility.
* The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.

**Other Expectations**

* To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team.

jobs.title: Accordion India - Director - Data & Analytics Consulting
jobs.description:
**Company overview**

Accordion is a global financial consulting and technology firm helping CFOs and their teams drive value creation. Rooted in private equity rigor and powered by data, analytics, and AI, we partner with companies across industries to turn insight into impact.

Accordion works at the intersection of Private Equity sponsors and portfolio companies’ management teams across every stage of the investment lifecycle. We provide hands-on, execution-oriented support, driving value through the office of the CFO by building data and analytics capabilities and identifying and implementing strategic work, rooted in data, analytics and AI.

Accordion is headquartered in New York City with 10 offices worldwide, including the India office

based out of Hyderabad. Join us and make your mark on our company.

**Data & Analytics (Accordion | Data & Analytics)**

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) practice in India delivers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

D&A team members deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.

Working at Accordion in India means joining 800+ analytics, data science, finance, and technology experts in a high-growth, agile, and entrepreneurial environment to transform how portfolio companies drive value. It also means making your mark on Accordion’s future—by embracing a culture rooted in collaboration and a firm-wide commitment to building something great, together.

Join us and experience a better way to work!

**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana

**Role Overview:**

The Business Director at Accordion will own multiple client relationships and provide analytics- oriented thought partnership. (S)he will oversee multiple project teams to facilitate delivery of high-quality analytics services and identify opportunities for deeper client engagement.

**What You will do:**

* Develop a thorough understanding of client's business challenges to proactively recommend analyses that can deliver results for the client.
* Facilitate value addition to the client's business by driving the problem-solving process and bringing an independent perspective based on domain knowledge and past experience.
* Regularly engage in peer level discussions with the C-Suite of client companies, to partner with them as a trusted analytics advisor.
* Develop a robust knowledge of functional areas (Marketing, Finance, Pricing, Supply Chain etc.) across a diverse set of industries to provide relevant and actionable insights backed by robust analytics.
* Facilitate people development and proactively ensure that development agenda is fulfilled for all.
* Think from a company point-of-view and take up additional responsibilities outside of regular client projects to support the growth of the company.

**Ideally, you have:**

* Undergraduate degree (B.E/B.Tech.) from tier-1 colleges
* MBA degree from top tier colleges is preferred
* Should have 6 - 9 years of experience
* Strong analytical reasoning & problem-solving capabilities to identify patterns, draw insights and recommend solutions live
* Ability to share complex thoughts and tailor written and verbal communication based on the context
* Strong multi-tasking skills to manage multiple projects across diverse industries
* Experience in client facing/professional services environment

**Why Explore a Career at Accordion:**

**A Culture of Impact & Excellence**

* **A culture of merit & recognition:**
  Thrive in a meritocratic, high-growth environment with semi-annual performance and promotion cycles.
* **Multi - dimensional exposure**
  : Navigate complex, high stakes workstreams across diverse industries and domains. At Accordion, you will engage with varied intellectual challenges that keep your perspective sharp, and your curiosity fuelled.
* **Entrepreneurial environment:**
  Exercise the intellectual freedom to make definitive decisions and the autonomy to own their outcomes. We reward initiative, encouraging you to expand your influence and assume larger responsibilities.
* **Collaborative vitality**
  : Experience a non-bureaucratic, high-energy culture alongside high-calibre peers. Our environment is designed to challenge your thinking and accelerate your growth through shared expertise and collective ambition.

**Our Commitment to Your Well-being**

We believe that our collective success is rooted in the personal well-being and growth of our people. We have curated a suite of benefits designed to support you and your family’s health, celebrate your milestones, and empower your professional journey.

* **Comprehensive health & security:**
  We provide fully covered Health and Group Term Life Insurance for you, with health insurance coverage extending to your immediate family.
* **Care on your terms:**
  Access expert medical guidance through on-site health camps or our integrated tele-health services. This ecosystem includes free professional consultations alongside discounted healthcare services including dental and vision care.
* **Integrated family support:**
  We support working parents with a fully sponsored, premium on-site Day Care facility.
* **Empowering leave structures:**
  Our robust leave policy is an intentional commitment to work-life integration, featuring dedicated maternity and parental support designed to help new parents through life’s major transitions.
* **A culture of recognition:**
  We believe every breakthrough deserves an audience. Through our dedicated rewards platform, we pause to celebrate both your professional triumphs and your most meaningful personal milestones.
* **Architecting your growth:**
  Thrive in a positive & transparent environment designed for the continuous evolution of your craft. We provide the infrastructure - through learning programs and engagement initiatives - to bridge the gap between your personal aspirations and professional mastery.

jobs.title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Manager / Senior Consultant – FP&A (Finance Strategy & Transformation)**

**Job Locations:**
Hyderabad / Bengaluru

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**

* Manager: 8+ years
* Senior Consultant: 3–6 years
* **Notice Period:**
  Immediate to 60 days

**Job Description:**

We are looking for experienced finance professionals for the positions of
**Manager and Senior Consultant – FP&A**
with strong expertise in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Finance Strategy, and Finance Transformation.

The ideal candidates should have hands-on experience in FP&A, financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance management, and finance transformation initiatives. Candidates from leading consulting firms, Big 4 organizations, and reputed Tier 1 consulting companies are preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Drive FP&A strategy, finance strategy, and finance transformation initiatives.
* Lead and support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance management.
* Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, operating models, and reporting frameworks.
* Drive finance transformation initiatives, including process optimization and operating model transformation.
* Work on strategic finance initiatives involving GBS, P2P, R2R, and Finance ERP transformation.
* Leverage financial analytics and technology solutions to enhance planning, forecasting, and decision-making.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders to deliver strategic finance and transformation engagements.

**Eligibility Criteria**

**1. Manager – FP&A**

* Full-time MBA from a Tier 1 institution OR Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
* 8+ years of relevant, hands-on FP&A experience.
* Prior team handling and people management experience is mandatory.
* Strong consulting background or significant finance transformation experience preferred.
* Candidates from industry may also be considered, provided they have strong core FP&A experience.

**2. Senior Consultant – FP&A**

Candidates must meet either of the following criteria:

**Option 1:**

* Full-time MBA from a Tier 1 institution.
* 3–5 years of relevant, hands-on FP&A experience post-MBA.

**Option 2:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
* 4–6 years of relevant, hands-on FP&A experience post-qualification.

**Preferred Industry & Consulting Experience**

* Candidates from Big 4 firms, Accenture, and other Tier 1 consulting organizations are preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience in FP&A is essential.
* Exposure to Finance Transformation, GBS, Operating Model, P2P, R2R, and Finance ERP transformation will be an added advantage.
* Prior consulting exposure is preferred, particularly for Manager-level candidates.

**Technology Exposure**

Experience with any of the following platforms will be an added advantage:

* Anaplan
* SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
* OneStream
* Oracle EPM

Candidates should have broader FP&A and finance transformation capabilities in addition to technology exposure.

**Note:**
Pure technology implementation profiles or candidates primarily focused on Anaplan/Oracle Planning technical implementation will not be considered.

**Important Screening Criteria**

* Strong core FP&A experience is mandatory.
* Professionals primarily working in internal finance or EFA roles are not the target audience.
* Broader finance transformation experience is desirable but cannot substitute for hands-on FP&A experience.
* Team management experience is mandatory for Manager-level positions.

**Interested Candidates:**

Candidates meeting the above criteria are encouraged to apply with their updated CV.

**Work Locations:**
Hyderabad / Bengaluru

jobs.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous

jobs.title: Director-Process Mining & Process Intelligence (Celonis Implementation-Healthcare)
jobs.description:
**About Sutherland**

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

**About the Role**

**This role leads Sutherland's Process Mining / Process Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE) for healthcare payer and provider operations, using Celonis or any other technology as the core platform.**
The leader in this seat owns the practice end to end - governance, delivery playbooks, the flagship client engagement, and the scaling of process intelligence into a grounding layer for Sutherland's agentic AI portfolio (including the METTLE platform and Smart-branded product suite).

**This is a leadership role, not a maintenance role. The person in this seat will define how Sutherland deploys, sells, and delivers Celonis-based process intelligence across payer and provider accounts, working closely with vertical leadership, solution architects, and client delivery teams.**

**Hands-on experience deploying Celonis (or a comparable process mining platform) in a healthcare or healthcare-adjacent environment - direct implementation experience is required, not just familiarity with the category.**

**What You'll Own**

\*\*COE leadership \*\* Lead the Process Mining COE - governance model, delivery playbooks, data pipeline standards, and reusable accelerators for healthcare use cases.

\*\*Flagship pilot delivery\*\* Lead the first proof-of-concept engagement (claims adjudication cycle time, provider data management, or a comparable payer/provider process) from data connector design through insight delivery and executive readout.

\*\*Platform depth\*\* Serve as Sutherland's internal subject matter expert on the Process Intelligence Platform - object-centric process mining (OCPM), the Process Intelligence Graph, Context Model / Agent Toolkit (MCP-based), Data Core, and Orchestration Engine.

\*\*Healthcare use case design.\*\* Translate payer and provider operational pain points (claims, credentialing, enrollment, utilization management, contact center) into process mining use cases with clearly defined KPIs and ROI targets, defined before implementation begins.

\*\*Executive narrative and sponsorship.\*\* Partner with vertical and account leadership to secure executive sponsorship for each engagement and manage the governance and change-management challenges that come with process transparency (process ownership conflicts, cross-BU data access, political friction).

\*\*Integration with agentic AI roadmap.\*\* Position and build process mining as the grounding/context layer feeding Sutherland's broader agentic AI and automation offerings - not a standalone analytics exercise.

\*\*Presales support.\*\* Support RFP responses, orals presentations, and client workshops as the technical authority on process intelligence, working alongside solution architects and bid managers.

\*\*Team build.\*\* As the COE scales, define staffing needs and build out a small core delivery team (data engineers, process analysts) under this function.

**Qualifications**

10+ years in healthcare operations, consulting, or technology delivery, with deep familiarity with payer and/or provider workflows (claims, credentialing, provider data management, utilization management, RCM, or contact center operations).

**Hands-on experience deploying Celonis (or a comparable process mining platform) in a healthcare or healthcare-adjacent environment - direct implementation experience is required, not just familiarity with the category.**

Track record of leading or scaling a process mining or process intelligence practice/COE, including governance design, use case prioritization, and ROI measurement.

Comfort operating in both a technical delivery capacity (data connectors, process models, KPI design) and a client-facing capacity (executive workshops, presales support, orals presentations).

Experience translating process mining outputs into automation, RPA, or AI/agentic use cases - understanding of how process intelligence feeds downstream AI systems is a strong plus.

BPO, shared services, or outsourcing delivery experience is a plus given Sutherland's operating model.

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a relevant field a plus. Celonis certification(s) preferred.

jobs.title: Sr Domain Sales Engineer - Tech & Business Transformation
jobs.description:
**This role is for a former strategy consultant who wants to stay in front of C-suite problems and see their thinking built, not just recommended.**
You will be the business lead for our team of Domain Sales Engineers (DSEs) in India. You define the client’s problem and the value at stake, decide what is worth building, and coach a team of early-career engineers to turn that into demos and proofs of concept that win executive decisions.

**Why this role exists**

Our DSEs build hands-on demos and proofs of concept (POCs) for enterprise clients, each within an industry or domain. They are capable builders and early in their careers. Where they need help is upstream of the build: understanding how the client’s business makes money, which problem is worth solving, how to size the value, and what story the demo has to tell a CFO or COO. A technically impressive demo that answers the wrong business question does not move a deal.

You will close that gap. You will work directly with our Account CTOs and Industry CTOs, who own the client relationships and technology direction, and you will make sure every demo and POC starts from a sharp business problem and ends with a value case the client can act on.

**What you will do**

**1. Frame the client’s problem and the value at stake**

* Work with Account and Industry CTOs ahead of client engagements to define the business problem, the decision-makers involved and what a good outcome looks like for the client.
* Lead executive discovery sessions and workshops with CXOs and business unit heads, using structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving.
* Build value driver trees and size the value at stake (revenue, cost, working capital, risk, customer experience) from client data, benchmarks and industry economics.
* Turn the value hypothesis into a business case with ROI, TCO and KPIs that a client CFO will accept.

**2. Decide what gets built, and make sure it lands**

* Translate the value case into a demo or POC scope: which use case, which process step, what data, and what result would prove the point.
* Write the executive storyline before the build starts, so the team knows what the demo has to show and why it matters to the audience.
* Review demos and POCs for business realism: the process reflects how the industry actually works, the KPIs are the right ones, and the numbers hold up under questioning.
* Present alongside the CTOs in executive briefings and steer the conversation toward a clear decision and next step.
* Shape proposals and RFP/RFI responses: problem statement, value case, roadmap and commercial logic.

**3. Lead and coach the DSE team the way you would run a case team**

* Act as engagement manager for the DSEs on each opportunity: frame the problem, split the work, review output and raise the bar.
* Teach the skills that separate a good builder from a trusted advisor: structured problem solving, industry economics, business case thinking, executive communication and storyline writing.
* Run regular problem-solving sessions and work reviews, and give direct, specific feedback.
* Build reusable assets the team can draw on: industry value driver trees, use case libraries with sized benefits, KPI benchmarks, discovery guides and storyline templates.
* Contribute to hiring and developing DSEs as the team grows.

**4. Build our industry point of view**

* Develop points of view on where AI changes the economics of specific industries and functions, and test them with clients.
* Run client workshops, webinars and executive sessions on AI-led business transformation.
* Bring what you hear from clients back to the CTOs, sales and engineering teams so our offerings reflect real business demand.

**How the work flows**

Every opportunity follows the same logic. You own the business reasoning at each step; the DSEs own the build.

**Business Problem → Value at Stake → Prioritized Use Cases → Demo / POC That Proves the Value → Executive Storyline → Business Case & Roadmap**

**What you bring**

**Consulting and business**

* 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years at a top-tier strategy or management consulting firm, ideally McKinsey, BCG or Bain.
* A track record of leading engagements end to end: scoping the problem, running the analysis, forming the recommendation and presenting it to the C-suite.
* Deep knowledge of at least one industry: how it makes money, its value chain, the KPIs that matter, its regulatory pressures and where margin is won or lost.
* Strong financial and analytical judgment. You are comfortable building a business case, a value driver tree or an ROI model, and defending the assumptions.
* Executive presence. You can run a CXO workshop, hold a point of view under challenge and recognize when to change it.
* Experience leading and developing junior consultants. You have run case teams and you enjoy making people better.

**Technology and AI fluency**

* A working understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI: what they can and cannot do, where the value comes from, and what data and integration they depend on.
* Enough familiarity with cloud, data platforms and enterprise architecture to judge feasibility, ask engineers the right questions and spot a demo that would not survive a real client environment.
* Experience on digital, analytics or AI transformation engagements (strategy, use case prioritization, operating model, value capture) is a strong advantage.
* **Hands-on coding is not required.**
  The DSEs and engineering teams build; your job is to make sure they build the right thing.

**Nice to have**

* MBA from a leading business school.
* Time in a consulting firm’s digital or AI practice (for example McKinsey Digital / QuantumBlack, BCG X, or Bain’s advanced analytics practice).
* Post-consulting experience in business development, pre-sales, or a client-side strategy or transformation role.
* Experience working with or building teams in India-based capability or delivery centers.

**Why consultants take this role**

* **You keep what you valued in consulting:**
  C-suite access, hard problems, structured thinking and a team to lead.
* **You see your recommendations built.**
  Instead of handing over a deck, you put a working demo in front of the client and see whether it changes the decision.
* **You build something that lasts beyond one engagement:**
  a team’s capability and an industry playbook that every future opportunity draws on.
* **You go deep on AI where it is being applied to real enterprise problems**
  rather than discussed in the abstract.

*This role is probably not the right fit if you are looking for a purely hands-on engineering or architecture role, or a strategy role without client contact.*

**A note on the title**

Domain Sales Engineer is the role family of the team you will guide. The work itself is closer to an Engagement Manager or Principal role at a strategy firm: you own the problem definition, the value case and the client story, and you direct the team that builds the proof.

Preferred / Advantageous

jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 10+ years of experience in a client-facing, pre-sales, or consulting role within the information services, data analytics, or enterprise software industries
* Proven technical expertise in third-party risk management, supplier risk management, AML/Financial Crime compliance or enterprise risk data solutions
* Demonstrated experience in solution architecture, including end to end data workflow design and multisource integration
* Deep understanding of structured and semi-structured data and formats including JSON, XML and CSV and past experience with SQL, Python, or APIs for data integration is encouraged
* Proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with a strong understanding of GenAI. Hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows is highly desirable
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure, deadline-oriented environment
* This position offers a dynamic work environment, requiring up to 50% travel to engage with clients face-to-face, while also providing the flexibility of hybrid working

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required as a minimum

**Responsibilities**
Serve as the functional and technical expert and design the solution to address client needs through Moody’s products and capabilities in AML/KYC and Data Management and AI solutions. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert, designing solutions that address client needs using Moody’s AML, KYC, data management, and AI capabilities
* Partner with frontline sales teams and Industry Practice Leads as the pre-sales lead for Moody’s data, KYC, and third-party risk solutions
* Track evolving global and regional regulatory requirements related to third-party risk management and KYC, translating them into solution-led client strategies

By joining this team, you will work in a high-impact, collaborative environment at the forefront of innovation, helping clients navigate complexity while driving sustainable growth for Moody’s. The team designs data-driven risk intelligence solutions and partners closely with Industry Practice Leads to deliver technically executable, commercially viable outcomes.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Senior Director, Head of M&A Advisory
  
- Responsible for originating, winning and executing M&A and private capital advisory mandates
  
  
- Focus on converting Mashreq’s existing financing relationships into broader trusted-advisor relationships.
  
  
- Combine strong transaction execution capabilities with a highly commercial and proactive approach to origination and client development.

- Origination & Franchise Building: Proactively identify M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across Mashreq’s client base and originate new mandates in partnership with relationship managers and sector teams.

* Lead, mentor and develop managers and consultants, setting performance objectives and supporting career progression.
* Build the capability and capacity of the practice through recruitment, training, knowledge management and succession planning.

**Skills :-**

* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27005, and CIS Controls.
* UAE Information Assurance (UAE IA) Standards and applicable UAE Cybersecurity Council guidance.
* TDRA cybersecurity guidelines and other relevant UAE sectoral regulations.
* Cyber maturity models and quantitative cyber risk methodologies (e.g., FAIR).
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and business-development skills.
* Strong technical command across governance, enterprise risk and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including board-level reporting and presentation.

**Qualifications**
Tools Experience : -
  
  

* GRC platforms (e.g. ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer or equivalent).
* Enterprise reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) for executive and board reporting.
* Risk and compliance management, audit and workpaper tooling.
* Standard productivity and collaboration suites (Microsoft 365 or equivalent).

**Education & Minimum Work Experience : -**

* Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in governance, risk and/or compliance, including significant experience in a professional service / consulting environment.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role with delivery, P&L and business-development accountability.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and growing a practice or large engagements across regulated sectors.

jobs.title: Microsoft and Databricks Practice Lead
jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
  
  
Your profile
  
  

* 18+ years of experience in consulting and technology, including substantial leadership experience across Data, Analytics, AI and Cloud transformation.
* Prior senior leadership experience with a Big 4 consulting firm or leading Global System Integrator is mandatory, with evidence of building or scaling a Data & AI, Microsoft, Azure or Databricks practice.
* Proven ownership of practice growth, P&L or commercial targets, including large-deal origination, strategic sales, pipeline creation and executive client engagement.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Power BI, Purview, Azure AI, Azure Databricks and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
* Credible understanding of Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data engineering, analytics, ML/AI, GenAI, security, governance and platform modernization. Able to guide Fabric versus Databricks positioning, integration and coexistence decisions, and challenge architecture choices against scalability, operating cost, data quality and business requirements.
* Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft and/or Databricks alliances and converting partner relationships into joint opportunities, offerings, certifications and revenue.
* Strong executive presence, consulting orientation and ability to lead large, diverse teams across geographies.

**Preferred**

* Middle East market experience, especially UAE and KSA, with strong regional client and partner relationships.
* Relevant Microsoft Fabric/Azure and Databricks certifications or demonstrable oversight of certified practices.
* Industry experience in Financial Services, Government, Energy & Utilities, Telecom, Manufacturing or Retail.

Your role
  
  
Own the strategy, growth and operational leadership of the Microsoft and Databricks practice. The role carries accountability for bookings, revenue, pipeline, offerings, alliances, delivery governance, talent and market positioning across the Data & AI portfolio. Translate platform capabilities into commercially viable transformation programmes, working with sales, industry and delivery leaders to shape client investment priorities and build a sustainable services business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the practice strategy and multi-year growth plan across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Governance, AI/ML and Generative AI.
* Own or materially influence bookings, revenue, qualified pipeline, margin and utilization; lead strategic pursuits, proposals, solution shaping and C-suite presentations. Establish account growth plans, review opportunity qualification and commercial models, and maintain disciplined sales forecasting with account leaders.
* Build executive relationships and joint go-to-market plans with Microsoft and Databricks, including co-sell pipeline, partner funding, certifications, events and joint offerings. Align partner and account teams around priority clients, joint campaigns and opportunity conversion, with clear ownership and regular business reviews.
* Develop differentiated, repeatable propositions such as Fabric adoption, Databricks/Lakehouse modernization, data platform migration, AI-ready data foundations, GenAI and managed data services.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Data & AI strategy, platform choices, architecture, governance, investment roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.
* Provide executive governance for major engagements, ensuring delivery quality, architecture integrity, responsible AI, security, profitability and customer satisfaction. Sponsor architecture and delivery reviews, resolve escalations, and ensure proposals translate into achievable scope, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.
* Build and lead a high-performing, multi-location team of practice leaders, architects, engineers, data scientists and governance specialists; drive hiring, certifications and succession planning.

jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas**

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

This isn't just a management role; it's a chance to be a pivotal member of the EMEA Go-To-Market and EMEA Presales leadership teams. You will be the architect of our regional success, empowering a team of up to 8 brilliant individuals to push boundaries, challenge the status quo, and drive customer success. If you thrive in a culture that embraces diverse perspectives and rewards bold ideas, we want to hear from you.

You won't just be managing a team; you'll be building a legacy. As a business partner to our sales leaders, you will:

* **Lead with Agility:**
   Proactively partner with regional sales teams to strategically allocate Presales resources, pivot engagement strategies, and drive a winning momentum.

**Your Qualifications**

You are a leader who can both strategise from 30,000 feet and execute flawlessly on the ground. You bring:

* **Deep Domain Expertise:**
   Hands-on knowledge of SaaS applications.
* Specific experience in EPM/CPM-based technologies, preferably around FP&A or Supply Chain platforms (preferred).
* **Proven Presales Leadership:**
   Demonstrable experience managing and inspiring a team of individual Presales contributors while navigating a complex, multi-stakeholder sales environment. Ideally you will have grown and managed a team in the region.
* **Regional Experience:**
  A track record of successfully managing a team in UAE or the middle East.
* **A Change-Maker's Mindset:**
   You have led teams through transformation and are comfortable driving and managing change.
* **A Player-Coach Mentality:**
   The ability to both lead and execute, rolling up your sleeves to help your team win.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker**
  required for this role.

If you're ready to make your mark and lead a team at the forefront of business transformation, let's talk.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Notice**

C

andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled

in accordance with

our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to

assist

our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
- To prospect, identify, and on-board new to bank borrowing corporate relationships within Middle Market Segment in-line with Mashreq Bank’s growth strategy.
  
- Help the Business Segment in managing proposition for Middle Market including Business development, client acquisition, service quality, client survey, value proposition & analytics
  
- Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal & external campaigns and alignment with other Products & proposition including Risk policies, Payment & Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking and SMEs.
  
- Be an ambassador for Mashreq bank and develop the bank’s profile in the local business and wider community by originating and delivering Mashreq Bank products and services for corporate banking customers (annual revenue exceeding AED 250MM up to AED 1BN).
  
- Identify key contacts at potential client companies to establish and foster a relationship.
  
- Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
  
- To build a proprietary understanding of each client’s financial needs/issue agenda; originating and assisting in the execution of innovative deal solutions with and through sector and product partners.
  
- Fully dimension the client’s wallet and identify/create opportunities for Mashreq to deliver customized solutions.
  
- Structure the client’s requirement ensuring optimum Return on Risk Capital performance across business and credit cycles, while setting and meeting Mashreq’s revenue, cross-sell and capital management objectives.
  
- Owning the entire credit process from timely preparation of the credit proposal to obtaining the credit approvals and subsequent documentation and onboarding.
  
- Adhere to structures and processes in place for the management of credit, operational, reputation, financial crime and regulatory risk.
  
- Achieve business targets for new-to-bank, profitability, deposits growth, income growth and cross-selling.
  
- Ensure all relevant control measures are undertaken to minimize the risk exposure.
  
- Track and monitor deal flows, liaising such that vital business reports are prepared and available on a timely basis.
  
- Maintaining close contact with coverage, product and risk specialists within Mashreq Bank.
  
- Build a network of business introducers in the local professional and business community
  
- Help in development of client value proposition, innovative acquisition proposition tailored as per identified market / segmental needs.
  
- Help business manage in implementing new offerings via different tie up’s and strategic partnerships
  
- Support in set up of referral model with different partners inside/outside of bank and manage referral / intermediaries
  
- Work on creating the quarterly/annual strategy for the business on Proposition, tactical campaigns for sales force and for clients
  
- Coordinate with all business owners and product managers to create cross cross sell opportunities
  
- Support in formulating relevant policy / program guidelines to ensure proper controls are in place and work within the overall compliance policies
  
- Carry out competitor intelligence on regular basis and find opportunities of enhancement in existing proposition
  
- Work closely with the process and system development team to ensure the systems and processes are geared to cater to the ongoing business requirements, product parameters and evolving customer needs.
  
- To help ensure control requirements of the business are adhered to in line with bank policies to ensure good growth in a sustainable, profitable and predictable manner.
  
- Review of various plan and ensure management reporting to Business Manager of the same in conjunction with the relevant business development initiatives / product launches.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
- At least 8 years of relevant banking experience in Business development as well as in credit and customer relationship management in banking sector out of which at least 2 years in a similar position in UAE
  
- Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
  
- University level education preferably in business, finance or related discipline
  
- Sound credit analytical skills and profound knowledge in various corporate banking products
  
- Strong networking, leadership and management skills
  
- Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
  
- Strong working knowledge in MS office, web content and analytics
  
- Innovative – willing to develop a detailed understanding of client issues/needs and develop ideas/solutions in response
  
- Strong work ethic; high energy levels; results oriented – a self-starter prepared to take the initiative to identify and/or follow issues through, whilst exercising judgment as to when to seek assistance.
  
- Natural Team Player - Having an adaptable/flexible approach; willing to work in a co-operative manner to fulfill client and internal requirements

jobs.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your
